description.en: The mysterious shopkeeper signed a dream-like agreement with the young lass, Amiya, hoping that she would be able to deliver love and piping-hot food to every customer.
description.zh: 神秘店主和少女阿米娅签了一个梦想协议，希望她能将热食与爱送到每位顾客手中。

dialog.en: Test Collection Series/Fresh Fastener. An outfit worn by Amiya while working for a Rhodes Island restaurant. This poofy coat is cold-resistant, and has enough room to hold something penguin-sized.
dialog.zh: 忒斯特收藏系列/见习联结者。阿米娅在罗德岛餐厅打工时的穿着。蓬松外套很防寒，也能装进一只企鹅大小的东西。

description.en: Planting, fostering, all for tomorrow.
description.zh: 栽种，培育，便是为了明日。

dialog.en: Test Collection Series/Seedsower. A loose yet comfortable outdoors fit. Comes with an exclusive miniature mountain-grade rucksack and an agricultural nursery kit. The designer has one small wish of her own, and hopes that we can all help to realize it.
dialog.zh: 忒斯特收藏系列/播种者。宽松舒适的出游配搭，独家附赠小型登山包与一个育苗套装。设计师有一个小小的愿望，她希望大家能够帮忙实现。

description.en: The sky of Londinium is always gray.
description.zh: 伦蒂尼姆的天空总是灰色的。

dialog.en: Test Collection/Newsgirl. Available only in certain regions, this remake of a classic design utilizes the best materials and contains carefully-sewn details. An extra custom-made letter opener is included.
dialog.zh: 忒斯特™收藏系列/报童。限定区域供应。经典款式复刻，采用绝佳材质，附加特别缝纫细节。附带特别设计的开信刀。

description.en: She once dreamed of what the stars looked like. Perhaps one day, her footprints will be left on the far side of deep space, where those stars rest eternally.
description.zh: 她曾梦见过星星的模样。那群星长眠的深空彼岸，或许有一日会留下她的足迹。

dialog.en: CASC Collaboration Outfit/Touching the Stars, co-designed by Amiya. Equipped with a precise life support system, it balances survival performance with comfort, making it fully capable of handling the extreme environments of outer space.
dialog.zh: 由阿米娅参与设计的CASC合作服装/触及星辰。配备精密的生命保障系统，兼顾维生性能与舒适性，足以应对外层空间的极端环境。

description.en: 'Doctor, time still flows as I move forward. I don't yet know what the outcome will be, but I trust that with you, we will reach the most perfect one.'
description.zh: “博士，时间在我前进时仍旧在流淌，我还不知道结局会是什么样，但我相信有你在，我们一定能达成最完满的那一个。”

dialog.en: Test Collection Series/In A Myriad of Universes. A journey of pursuit embarked upon by Amiya. Perhaps uncontrolled Originium destroys an entire world, but across countless universes, she will ultimately find you, find hope.
dialog.zh: 忒斯特收藏系列/于万千宇宙之中。阿米娅踏上的一段追寻之路。或许有失控的源石将整个世界毁灭，但于千千万万个宇宙之中，她终会找到你，找到希望。

description.en: She draws the bow slowly, gently whispering her wishes. Though not a single note has ever changed, her audience, her stage, and she herself have been constantly evolving. She will not stop playing, until this land and sky hold her music in their memory.
description.zh: 她缓缓拉着琴，将那愿望细细倾诉。她的曲子从未变化过，但她的心性、听众、舞台都已经更替多次。她还不想就此停下，直到大地与星空，都记住这曲旋律。

dialog.en: Test Birthday Collection 1101/Solo Around The World. The Ark cradling the cocoon of dreams sailed into the galaxy, dissolving into millions of threads. With love as their needle, the many hands crafted a one-of-a-kind garment for Amiya. The remaining threads, intertwined with wishes, were fashioned into a violin.
dialog.zh: 忒斯特华诞珍藏1101/寰宇独奏。方舟载起梦茧，化入星河凝结成丝，众人的爱噙住针线，为阿米娅织就独一的衣裳。余下丝线伴着愿望，编成一把提琴。

description.en: 'I'm Kal'tsit, a doctor of Rhodes Island, and also the companion of Amiya and the Doctor. You have long been worthless to me.'
description.zh: “我是凯尔希，罗德岛的医生，阿米娅与博士的同伴。你对我而言早已一文不值。”

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Remnant. Originium has taken over the land, and what she envisioned has become a reality. She has enumerated and entrusted everything else to the others, leaving only her name as she hones her mission into a sharp blade.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/残余。源石已将大地同化，内在宇宙正化为现实。她将一切悉数寄托于人，只留下自己的名字，将使命磨成利刃。

description.en: She walked the mountain called Time, calling into the eternal, empty valley, and found an echo of life. 'Kal'tsit, have you found yourself?'
description.zh: 她在名为时间的山上留下足迹，对着永恒的空谷呼喊，得到了生命的回声。 “凯尔希，你找到你自己了吗？”

dialog.en: Test Collection Series/The Remains of Time. An outfit worn by Kal'tsit while in disguise. Countless times, in this manner, she influenced the course of Terra's civilization—ripples in the great river of time, a fleeting mark on her endless journey.
dialog.zh: 忒斯特收藏系列/时遗。凯尔希隐藏身份时穿过的服装。她曾无数次以这种方式拨弄过泰拉文明的走向，那是时间长河中的涟漪，是她来时长路的一抹。

description.en: Defeating the passage of time is harder than defeating foes on the battlefield.
description.zh: 总有那么几小时，比战场上还难熬。

dialog.en: 0011 New Arrivals/Ageless Afterglow. Handcrafted by Lungmen artisans, this tailor-made dress is comfortable, beautiful, and accentuates one's figure. By popular request, it has been made to be a bit sportier than the standard line.
dialog.zh: 0011™新款/岁红霞。龙门手工匠制，量体裁衣，舒适美观，凸显身形。在顾客的强烈要求下进行了改良，使其比普通款拥有更好的运动性。

description.en: The warm sun pierces through the clouds, and what were once the vestiges of frost have now, with the advent of spring, become the first sign of the nurturing land nourishing its children.
description.zh: 和煦的阳光穿透云层，曾经的霜痕化作春天到来的第一抹征兆，滋润着这片大地哺育的孩子们。

dialog.en: Test Collection Series/After Storm. Frost inevitably gives way to a clear day. Ch'en Hui-chieh patrols the city in her first L.G.D. uniform, re-inspecting the metropolis both familiar and foreign to her.
dialog.zh: 忒斯特收藏系列/初晴。曲终人散，霜后初晴。陈晖洁身着自己在近卫局的第一套制服，绕城一周，重新审视这座熟悉但又陌生的城市。

description.en: Percussion's suited to those spirits born to be wild, just because when they hit it, you know it'll be with all their strength.
description.zh: 打击乐器适合交由那些生来狂野的灵魂敲打，只因他们每次挥动，必定全力以赴。

dialog.en: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Burst Feline. Stage clothing picked by drummer Blaze herself. There might not be much material, but it's breathable, sweat-absorbent and flame-resistant, ensuring no outfit malfunctions will affect Blaze's performance.
dialog.zh: 音律联觉特供款/爆裂菲林。鼓手煌自己选配的演出服。虽布料不多，但材质透气吸汗抗燃，保证煌不会因服饰问题影响发挥。

description.en: Some have noticed a set of suspicious inky footprints on Rhodes Island. They go from the rest area to the control center, leading the curious to see Blaze dragging Amiya along on her pawprint seal playtime.
description.zh: 有人在罗德岛发现了一串可疑的墨迹脚印，从休息区一路延伸到了控制中枢，最后发现煌正拉着阿米娅在玩爪印火漆印章。

dialog.en: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Grimoire of Dark Law' Custom Line/Explosive Blue Flame. She plays the role of the hero seeking the grimoire said to have been born amidst the Everlasting Flame. Whichever brave soul claims it can break through all rules and bindings.
dialog.zh: 巫异盛宴角色扮演剧本“暗律魔典”定制服饰/易爆蓝焰。扮演者将是追寻魔典的勇者。传说魔典诞生于不灭的火焰，得到它的勇者可以斩断一切规则与束缚。

description.en: Who ever said that pop singers can't grasp vintage classics from distant lands?
description.zh: 从来就没人能够断言流行歌手掌握不了上了年份的异国经典。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Melodiosa. Sora's outfit in her time studying and performing at Siracusa's Teatro di Milano. Siracusan musical productions have a unique cultural flair, which in turn calls for accessorizing to match.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/如歌。空在叙拉古米兰剧场进修与表演时的服装。叙拉古歌舞剧有其独特的文化符号，因此也必须穿上符合身份的服饰。

description.en: Wherever you are is a live show.
description.zh: 走过之处皆是LIVE现场。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA361. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]夏卉系列泳衣361款。参考少女的身材和体质，采用天然材质制成。追求今夏最领先的设计潮流。

description.en: After parting ways with Kroos, Lava prepared several outfits to make it easy for her to traverse the land, and this is one of them.
description.zh: 和克洛丝分别后，炎熔给自己准备了多套行头以便行走江湖，这是其中一套。

dialog.en: 0011 New Release / Dusk Wisteria. Handmade in Lungmen, tailor-fitted with special consideration to exotic design elements. The outfit has been improved in accordance with the customer's preference to incorporate Yan's novel trends.
dialog.zh: 0011新款/暮影藤萝。龙门手工匠制，经过考量的异域元素搭配贴身裁剪，根据顾客个人喜好结合炎国潮流制作的改良型服饰。

description.en: It's not just the clothes that Lava likes. She's even more intrigued to the righteous warriors in Yanese stories who smite evil and restore order. This is presumably the reason why ever since she put on this outfit, she has been hard at work practicing Yanese swordplay.
description.zh: 炎熔喜欢的不止是服装，她更中意炎国故事里，那些锄恶扶正的有义之士。自穿上这套衣服起，她就苦练炎国剑术，想必正是因为如此。

dialog.en: 0011 Tempest Series New Arrivals/Purifying Flame. Yanese-style clothes that show off the wearer's blazing spirit. Ebon garments adorned with flame patterns make one's stalwart righteousness all the more eye-catching.
dialog.zh: 0011子品牌，飙系列新款/镇邪焱。能彰显出穿戴者凛然气概的炎国风格服装。玄色衣装配上焰形纹样，散发出的一身正气令人瞩目。

description.en: As He decided this body was perfect and sublime, so the Seaborn would ascend from Terra, their destination the infinite sea of stars above the skies.
description.zh: 当祂决定将这幅躯体臻至完美时，海嗣就将自泰拉飞升，前往天空之上的无尽星海。

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Sublimation. In the ocean-soaked wreckage of this great Iberian chapel rests He, and His song comes from the efferent throat, to reach the ears of every Seaborn.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/升华。祂栖息在被大海浸漫的伊比利亚大教堂残骸内，歌声从喉中传出，进入每位海嗣的耳中。

description.en: 'Then soar, soar to my side.'
description.zh: “翱翔吧，就在我身边。”

dialog.en: Iteration Provident/Red Countess. Skadi the Corrupting Heart's iteration from decision point F/3019226. Confusion and impulse have begat the sole master of the Crimson Plain. With these emotions, she fashions her beloved creations.
dialog.zh: 命途迭代系列/红女爵。浊心斯卡蒂在决策F/3019226中的迭代。混沌与冲动带来了赤红原野独一的主人。借着这样的情感，她创造出了心爱的造物。

description.en: 'My thanks to you two Tianshi for accompanying me on my journey so far, but it's about time we went our separate ways.'
description.zh: “辛苦二位天师一路相送，咱们就在前面作别吧。”

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Ten Thousand Mountains. Ch'en Hui-chieh entered the capital on a starry night, and left before sunrise after settling matters. She bid farewell to old friends and took a sampan down the river, the lamp on the prow crashing through the fog and night.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/万重山。陈晖洁星夜入京，事了后又于同样的夜晚离开。她辞别故人，轻舟顺江而下，船头的行灯撞破无数雾与夜。

description.en: Still very much enjoying her holungday. Mind the bubbles. Caution: Wet Floor.
description.zh: 仍在假日，仍是威龙，注意泡泡，小心地滑。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HD79. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]悠然假日系列泳衣79款。舒适放松，透气轻盈。让您可以在闲适的环境中享受最完美的沙滩体验。

description.en: Nearl has been prepared, since the very outset of her competition participation, to serve as the lighthouse that shines through Kazimierz's night sky. The torrents of time have not sufficed to quench this flame, instead only allowing her to burn brighter.
description.zh: 从参加竞技比赛之初，临光便准备要成为照亮卡西米尔夜空的灯塔。时间没能成为浇灭火焰的雨水，反而让她越燃越旺。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Relight. One of the many suits of armor worn by Nearl in her debut competition season, this one a modification of a campaign knight suit.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE子品牌 [昔时/Passe]系列精选款/复现荣光。临光初次参赛时使用的数套铠甲中的一套，由征战骑士铠修改而来。

skinName.en: A Picnic Before A Long Trip

description.en: 'Where's our next stop, little lamb? The ocean of pink? The erupting volcano? There's still lots of places I'd love to go. Once we're done with this cake, we can head off~'
description.zh: “小羊，我们下一站会去哪里？会是那片粉色的海吗？会是那座正在喷发的火山吗？我还有很多地方想去呢，吃完这块蛋糕，我们就出发吧~”

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/A Picnic Before A Long Trip. Bam! Everyone's become teeny-tiny, must be another one of Dolly's pranks! Good thing the cream didn't stain her dress, because Eyjafjalla will need it for a dance of azure blue.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/远行前的野餐。嘭！一定是多利的恶作剧，所有人都变小了！好在奶油没有弄脏衣裙，艾雅法拉正准备穿着它跳一支天蓝色的舞呢。

description.en: "Mom, Dad, please sit down with me. These are all stories I wrote down myself, and now I'm going to tell them to you."
description.zh: “爸爸，妈妈，一起坐下吧。这些都是我自己记录下的故事，现在就讲给你们听。”

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrival/Tales After. Adele's favorite casual outfit. The comforting feel brought by the soft, cozy loungewear and fluffy slippers evokes her most cherished memories.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/后来的故事。阿黛尔最喜欢的一套便服。柔软舒适的居家服和绵绒拖鞋所带来的令人安心的触感，能唤起她最珍视的回忆。

description.en: Atop the stairs, her figure, sword in hand, is as pure and dazzling as the morning light.
description.zh: 踏上阶梯，她执剑而立的身姿，恰如此时纯净而耀眼的晨曦。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection/Glorious Path. Ceremonial clothes worn by Vina Victoria. The natural combination of black and white is contrasted with golden ornamentation, granting the wearer majesty and unbridled charm.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/光耀之途。维娜·维多利亚参加典礼时的装束。自然调和的黑白礼服配以金色装饰，让穿戴者散发出威严与洒脱的魅力。

description.en: The will of the Texas family she should have enforced.
description.zh: 她本应贯彻德克萨斯家族的意志。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Line [Passe] Series Selects/Willpower. Classic Siracusan womenswear. By request of Texas, all parts once white have been dyed completely black.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE子品牌 [昔时/Passe]系列精选款/意志。经典的叙拉古女性装扮，按照德克萨斯的要求，把曾经白色的部分全部染黑了。

description.en: Life, is all about doing whatever you want.
description.zh: 生活，就是随心所欲。

dialog.en: Cambrian 1096 Winter New Arrivals/Winter Messenger. Waterproof with handmade details, it includes special sleeves, detachable parts and zipper pockets.
dialog.zh: 寒武纪™1096冬季新款/寒冬信使。特别手工细节填充，使用防水材质，含袖口部拉链与可拆卸帽子、拉链口袋。

description.en: 'You know that every collection has its own fairy tale. That's part of its history.'
description.zh: “拉芙希妮，你已知道每一件藏品都有自己的童话，那也是它们的历史。”

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Curator. Scholar's garb straight from a fairy tale. Stuff your magic, knowledge, and curiosity in the pockets, and take notes with Reed.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/博物。极具童话感的学者服饰，把魔力、知识和好奇心，都塞进风衣口袋和兜帽里。苇草流连在博物馆，记录每一件藏品的故事。

description.en: To warm hearts and show the road ahead. Her light now shines for this purpose.
description.zh: 照亮前路，温暖心房，她的光芒，此刻正为此闪耀。

dialog.en: Reed the Flame Shadow's festive attire/Glowing Flame in the Night. Don a white sweater and thick boots, drape yourself in a red cloak, heft up bundles of presents and brightness, then step into the tranquil night sky.
dialog.zh: 焰影苇草在节日外出时的穿着/闪焰之夜。穿上白色毛衣和厚实靴子，披起红色的披风，带着所有礼物与光亮，走进这片宁静的夜空。

description.en: The blazing sun treads the waves, the flame shadow cleanses the heart.
description.zh: 骄阳踏浪，焰影澄心。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA075. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]夏卉系列泳衣075款。参考少女的身材和体质，采用天然材质制成。追求今夏最领先的设计潮流。

description.en: After they started playing 'Destiny Quest', Kroos set up an adventurer's guild with her friends called 'Here We Are' and started planning big plans for some large-scale hunting quests. However, looking at guides wasn't a part of those plans.
description.zh: 开始游玩《命运追索》后，克洛丝与伙伴们成立了名为“可堪大用”的冒险公会，为大型狩猎任务制定全方位的战略规划，然而熟读攻略并不在规划之内。

dialog.en: Achievement Star Collection/The Apprentice and Her Aura. Clothes Kroos wore when receiving an award at a game expo. She'd just cleared some quests with her friends when she was picked as the lucky player. Wearing the dev-provided costume, she smiled widely at the camera.
dialog.zh: 成就之星系列/新手光环。克洛丝在电玩展领奖时穿的服饰。刚和朋友们完成新手任务，就被选为幸运玩家，克洛丝换上官方准备的服装，对着镜头粲然一笑。

description.en: Green tiles in the morning mist, warm freeze on yellow flowers. Step through the halls, step with the song. —Kroos' first Yanese poem, translated
description.zh: 晓雾藏青瓦，暖风撷黄花。泠泠穿廊去，款款踏歌来。——克洛丝第一次试写的炎国诗。

dialog.en: 0011 New Arrivals/Along the Corridor. Made by Lungmen craftsmen from premium Shangshu silk. Elegant and classical patterns with cyan lining make for a dignified outfit.
dialog.zh: 0011新款/廊下游。龙门手工匠制，选用尚蜀特产锦缎制作而成，裙面上的暗纹典雅古朴，缀以青蓝色内衬，穿在身上更显气质落落大方。

description.en: 'Step aside. The silence and blood won't bother me one bit, and I need to get the others back to the ball ASAP.'
description.zh: “让开些吧，静谧与血都影响不了我，而我还得赶紧把其他人带回舞会呢。”

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Born as One. An engraving leaves a shadow, like two sides of a coin, or the cycle of day and night. When both are aware of their dual nature, Laurentina possesses a soul most complete, like unto the twin moons.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/生而为一。雕刻留下阴影，正如硬币正反，日夜双分。当彼此都意识到自我的两面性时，劳伦缇娜便拥有双月般最完整的灵魂。

description.en: It's true that Hibiscus is happy to wear such pretty clothes, but what makes her even happier is being afforded the opportunity as both a Sarkaz and an Infected. Their struggles have meant something, she thinks.
description.zh: 对芙蓉来说，穿上漂亮的衣服固然让人高兴，但她更欣喜于自己作为萨卡兹和感染者能获得这个机会。她们的努力是有意义的，她想。

dialog.en: Unveiling of Devotion Series New Arrivals/Romance Overflow. Elaborate dress Hibiscus wore to promote a sightseeing train. Brilliant purples, beautiful hem, and delicate ornamentation—a perfect union of elegance and romance.
dialog.zh: 待予花冠系列新款/浪漫满厢。芙蓉为节日观光列车做宣传时所穿的华服。鲜艳的紫色，华丽的裙摆，精致的装饰，典雅与浪漫完美结合。

description.en: To get her tail nice and evenly tanned, or to enjoy chopping through waves with her axe? That is the question.
description.zh: 去晒出一条色泽均匀的漂亮尾巴，还是享受挥舞巨斧劈开波浪的乐趣，这是一个值得嘉维尔思考的问题。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HD26. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]悠然假日系列泳衣26款。舒适放松，透气轻盈。让您可以在闲适的环境中享受最完美的沙滩体验。

description.en: The mad doctor orders the nurse to start the lab's high-power shock machine! The detective rises once more from the operating table that prophesied his death! Will he be able to escape this deadly experiment? To Be Continued, in the next issue!
description.zh: 疯医师让护士启动了实验室的高能电击器！从预示着死亡的手术台上苏醒过来，侦探究竟能不能从这场夺命实验中逃离？未完待续，请看下一卷！

dialog.en: Storyboard Breaker Serialized Comic [Beyond Redemption] Final Character Art/Biochemical Submergence. Outfit of the detective who snuck into the Hospital of Horror. Falling into a mysterious liquid, his back laden with a biochemical tank that may serve as key evidence. Can he uncover the terrifying truth?
dialog.zh: 破格视界连载漫画《无从救赎》角色定稿/生化沉溺。故事中潜入恐怖医院的侦探的着装。落入神秘液体，身背可作为关键证据的生化罐体，他能否揭开恐怖的真相？

description.en: At the 1st-anniversary performance commemorating the premiere of the Rhodes Island-version of The Nutcracker, Greyy takes the stage again amidst the cheers of the crowd, closing the curtains on today's show along with the 'musicians' on stage.
description.zh: 在纪念罗德岛版《木果夹子》上演一周年的演出结束后，格雷伊在观众们的欢呼声中再度登台，与舞台上的“乐师”们一起，为今晚的剧目划上了个圆满的句号。

dialog.en: Greyy festival costume/Aftershow. Finely-crafted costumes and props made by the Operators are very popular amongst the Rhodes Island audience.
dialog.zh: 格雷伊在节日庆典上穿着的戏服/演出后的王子。诸多干员倾力打造的舞台戏服和道具，做工考究，深受罗德岛观众们的喜爱与欢迎。

description.en: Though he has already flown past countless islands and mountain peaks, his desire to explore is far from satisfied. Turning the control wheel of the balloon, he records the scenery of one last woodland before night falls.
description.zh: 虽然已经飞过了数不清的岛屿和山头，但他的探索欲望还远没有被满足。转动一下控制气球的舵轮，夜幕降临之前，再记录一片林地的风景吧。

dialog.en: Pioneer Series Classic/Thousand-Foot Overlook. Made from special materials with functional designs, it can adapt to various environmental changes and satisfy all kinds of needs.
dialog.zh: 生命之地[识荒者/Rewilder]系列经典款/千尺俯瞰。采用特别材质制作，包含各项功能性设计，足以应对多种自然环境变化，满足各类需求。

description.en: Yet another Carnevale, and all Texas wants is to relax, but her annoying boss has hidden himself in every balloon, telling her to get back to work. Nothing she can do except step on each and every one of them.
description.zh: 又是一年狂欢节，德克萨斯只是想好好休息一下，但恼人的老板藏在每个气球里催促她干活，没办法，她只能见一个踩一个。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Il Segreto Della Notte. A form-fitting combination of tailored clothes and exquisite accessories, displaying one's status without drawing too much attention. Comes with a VIP Carnevale invitation and too many balloons.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/幽兰秘辛。修身合体的定制衣装加以考究配饰，既能彰显身份，又不显得夺人眼球。随衣附赠狂欢节贵宾请帖，以及大量气球。

description.en: 'But Wingbreaker, did you know that behind the seven layers of golden gates remain only shepherds of demons, and nothing more of your old friends?'
description.zh: “但破翼者呵，你可知道，这七重金门之后，已只余恶魔的牧者，不再有你的故交？”

dialog.en: Iteration Provident Series/Wingbreaker. Texas the Omertosa's iteration from decision point F/3019226. The hunter shot down the great demon Vermithrax, but was betrayed by the Lone Wolf Emperor and banished to the barrens.
dialog.zh: 命途迭代系列/破翼者。缄默德克萨斯在决策F/3019226中的迭代。猎人将大恶魔威尔迈瑟拉克斯从天空击落，那落单的狼帝却背信弃义，将她流放荒野。

description.en: She might have forgotten that she's making a delivery.
description.zh: 她有可能会忘了自己在送外卖。

dialog.en: Rhodes Kitchen Collection/City Rider. Designed by Exusiai herself, 'I didn't think too much about the design, actually. I just made something that I'd like to wear.'
dialog.zh: 由能天使本人设计的KFC合作系列服装/城市骑手。实际上只是参考了自己喜欢的服装风格，并没有考虑很多。

description.en: The night before the Doctor's team arrives at Lungmen, Exusiai and Texas have gathered all the intel needed. Before going back to rest, however, Texas forced her to put on this partner-provided uniform and rehearsed multiple courses of action.
description.zh: 博士一行人抵达龙门的前夜，能天使和德克萨斯已经收集完了所需的情报。然而在回去休息前，德克萨斯逼着她穿上合作方提供的制服并预演了多种行动方案。

dialog.en: Test Collection Series/Midnight Delivery. As part of our cooperation agreement, Rhodes Island ordered this operator uniform for Exusiai. She can be seen wearing it, from time to time, during operations in Lungmen.
dialog.zh: 忒斯特收藏系列/午夜邮差。考虑到合作需要，罗德岛为能天使订做了这套罗德岛干员制服。偶尔能看到她穿着这套衣服在龙门城内行动。

description.en: Armed to the teeth.
description.zh: 整装待发。

dialog.en: Vitafield [Rewilder] Series Classics/Wild Operation. Made with special materials, it has multiple functions that can meet the needs in all kinds of natural environments.
dialog.zh: 生命之地™[识荒者/Rewilder]系列经典款/野地秘行。采用特别材质制作，包含各项功能性设计，足以应对多种自然环境变化，满足各类需求。

description.en: All foresight needs a place to rest, and that habitat is where all living things stand.
description.zh: 一切远见都需要栖息之处，那是属于芸芸众生的立足之地。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Habitat. Silence's dress for public events. She's been busy of late, and drifts to sleep in front of the camera. Luckily, she has Ifrit's handmade alarm clock to help her stay awake.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/栖息。赫默的礼服，用于出席公开场合。赫默变得相当忙碌，面对摄像机几乎令她立盹行眠，还好有伊芙利特的手工小闹钟帮她提神。

description.en: He sees a Laterano: united, efficient, serene. Under absolute rationality, the individual is but a gear in the machine, and he is its core.
description.zh: 他见到了一个拉特兰，统一、高效、平静。在绝对的理性下，个体如齿轮般拼凑起这个机器，而他便是核心。

dialog.en: Test Collection Series/Allmind As One. A possibility derived from when Executor connected to the Law: connected consciousnesses tend towards unity, all to achieve one goal. Exsequi. Exsequi. Exsequi.
dialog.zh: 忒斯特收藏系列/众志归一。送葬人连接律法时所推演出的可能：通连的意识趋于统一，为了实现目标，执行，执行，执行。

description.en: Though often the mysteries of fate and the journey ahead are unknown, his resolve to unveil time's secrets and uncover the truth has never wavered.
description.zh: 虽然很多时候，命运的谜题和奔波的前路都是未知，但他揭开时光的面纱，寻出谜底的决心从未改变。

dialog.en: Brand Collaborative Series/The Train Runner. As a child, dressed in pristine clothes, he too chased the shadows of trains out of curiosity. Now, stepping onto exotic platforms, his goals are far clearer.
dialog.zh: 品牌合作服装/蒸汽寻踪者。儿时身穿纯净衣装的他也曾因为好奇去追逐列车的影子，而如今踏上异国风情的站台时，他已经有着更加明确的目标。

description.en: To ensure the music video would go off without a hitch, Swire prepared as much as she could. Her group dances amidst the flickering lights, their voices carrying their song to the sky. She sets aside all titles and pretense, her only hope being that this will be an unforgettable performance.
description.zh: 为确保这支MV拍摄万无一失，诗怀雅认真准备了一些时日。搭档们在闪烁跳动，歌声正飞向云霄，她暂时放下一切头衔，只希望这场表演足够令人难忘。

dialog.en: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Rhythmic Blocks. Swire's chic and breezy concert outfit, showcasing all her vivacity and cuteness. She leads the choreography, gladly accepting the applauses and affection from her stans.
dialog.zh: 音律联觉特供款/律动方格。诗怀雅的演出服，潇洒灵动，尽显活泼可爱。她主导着跃动的节拍，将那些代表了陶醉与赞美的红心欣然收下。

description.en: "The ancients compiled classics to record knowledge, while modern people inherit wisdom. What I need to do is integrate it all, apply the past to the present, and bring a new look to Lungmen! How about that? Not bad, right?"
description.zh: “古人编纂典籍记录知识，今人承继智慧，我要做的就是贯通融会，古为今用，让龙门再多点新光景！怎么样，不赖吧？”

dialog.en: National Library Collaboration Outfit/Age of Prosperity. The outfit Swire wore when attending a cultural festival. Medicine, technology, art, and craft—she decorated each booth with brilliant displays, wearing history on her shoulders to grandly welcome guests from all over the world.
dialog.zh: 国家图书馆合作服装/盛世之象。诗怀雅在参加文化庆典时穿着的服装。医、技、艺、工，各个展位被她装点得琳琅满目，她将历史穿在身上，盛迎天下贵宾。

description.en: 'Y-You're threatening me because I'm a new actress?' 'Uhh, Laura, your butt won't hurt any longer.' 'We must learn to get along with these Laterans. We don't have a choice—' 'D-Director Nian, how was that?'
description.zh: “新、新人演员就要被人拿铳指着？”“呜，罗拉，屁股不痛了啊。”“拉特兰人，任何时候都要相亲相爱，不相亲相爱不行——”“年、年导，是这样吗？”

dialog.en: Collaborative Series/'Ride to Davistown'. Clothes the rookie actress Jessica wore for her audition. Whether pointing a gun at someone else or at herself, she'd immediately tear up. Director Nian was real pleased.
dialog.zh: CFA合作服装/《上任达维镇》。新人演员杰西卡在试镜时的穿着。不论是用铳指着人还是指着自己，她都会立刻眼泪汪汪。这一点让年导非常满意。

description.en: By her own assessment, this is the most bizarre character design in history.
description.zh: 据她本人评价，这是有史以来最诡异的角色设计。

dialog.en: Achievement Star Series/Absolute Protagonist. Wis'adel's altered appearance in a special gaming event. Judging from her temper, you can tell she is still very much the same Wis'adel.
dialog.zh: 成就之星系列/绝对主角。维什戴尔在特别游戏活动中的变格形象。从脾气上能看得出她确实还是那个维什戴尔。

description.en: 'We're finally here, Doctor. Is this ship floating out in space supposed to be an old haunt of yours? What, feeling anxious? Well too bad, you don't have a choice. 'Wiš'adel', here to destroy your Originium project now that it's running wild.'
description.zh: “终于上来了，博士，这艘漂在太空里的船算是你的老家？心疼了吗？不过也由不得你了。‘维什戴尔’，来摧毁你们疯狂的源石计划了。”

dialog.en: Test Collection Series/Supernova. Clothes Wiš'adel wears when stepping into the unknown of space to corral Originium run wild. According to her, since she's here to clean up the trash, she should wear something suitable for the occasion.
dialog.zh: 忒斯特收藏系列/超新星。维什戴尔为了解决失控的源石而踏足未知空间时的装扮。按本人的说法，既然是来清理垃圾的，那就要有相应的仪式感。

description.en: This gentle melody, she gives to her fellow teammates, her gathered friends, and to all who hope for a peaceful holiday season.
description.zh: 这段温柔的曲调，送给相伴的队员、共聚的朋友，还有每一位在这节日里期盼着平静与安宁的人。

dialog.en: Fang the Fire-Sharpened's performance outfit for holiday celebrations/A Pure Pianissimo. The black-and-white performance wear is outlined with neat contours. It is a design Fang is fond of, a symbol of the festive melody she is about to compose.
dialog.zh: 历阵锐枪芬在节日庆典上的演出服/纯净乐段。黑白相映的演奏服上有着规整的线条，这是芬喜爱的设计，也是即将谱写出的节日旋律的象征。

description.en: She will satisfy your every whim, free of charge, just like how you are doing your best to please her.
description.zh: 她将无偿满足你的渴求，正如你竭力取悦她那般。

dialog.en: Test Collection Series/Unruly Humbleness. Bartender and bar-owner Lappland, with some of her colleagues in tow, happily welcomes in tonight's employer and Boss.
dialog.zh: 忒斯特收藏系列/无序的谦卑。酒吧的仆人兼所有者拉普兰德，携其同僚，竭诚欢迎今晚的雇主与老板。

description.en: If all of existence is boundless, then his heart shall be as a boundless sail. Unperturbed by the billowing waves, he sails forward, sword in hand.
description.zh: 若天地浩瀚无边，他的心便做无际的帆，波澜不惊，执剑向前。

dialog.en: MARTHE Sports Line New Arrivals/Boundless Sail. Exercise attire based on a fencer's protective clothes. Offers both comfort and fashion alongside all-day defense.
dialog.zh: MARTHE运动系列新款/无际之帆。参照剑术家的专业防护服制成的运动装束，在融合了时尚元素的同时保持了良好的舒适性，并且提供全天候防护能力。

description.en: Following the descriptions in the book, crossing mountains and rivers across five regions and sailing beyond the four seas, Blaze finally saw the legendary creature. "Your name should be... uh... how do you pronounce this ancient word again?"
description.zh: 顺着书上的描述，跨越五方山川，渡去四海之外，煌终于见到了传说中的生物。“你的名字应该是，呃......这个古字怎么念来着？”

dialog.en: National Library Collaboration Outfit/Nocturnal Flame. The outfit Blaze wore while traveling through various exotic lands of Yan. The book holds a myriad of landscapes, her hands hold a blazing light, and with auspicious beasts by her side, she steps forward through the flames.
dialog.zh: 国家图书馆合作服装/夜行烛火。煌在游历炎国各方异域时所穿的服装。书中山海万象，手中炽焰长明，奇珍瑞兽相伴身侧，她踏焰前行。

description.en: The Feline woman rushes home. There is someone waiting to cook with her back at their warm, candlelit home, after all. This time, she wants to be around for prepping the dumpling skins.
description.zh: 菲林女子归心似箭。亮着温暖烛光的家里还有人在等她回去一起做饭，这一次，她要从饺子皮开始做起。

dialog.en: Cambrian 1102 Winter New Arrivals/Homecoming Night. Made from multiple layers of multifunctional materials. A light down coat to keep warm, a silver coating to ward off rain and wear. Perfect for both lounging at home and riding a steed of steel.
dialog.zh: 寒武纪1102冬季新款/夜归人。采用多层复合功能性面料制成，羽绒夹克轻便保暖，银点涂层防雨耐磨，无论是休闲居家还是摩托骑行都很适用。

description.en: She does not know, nor will anyone know, that years later, the melody she once hummed offhand in a tavern would be passed down as 'the first angel's song.'
description.zh: 她不知道，也没有人会知道，多年之后，她曾在酒馆里随口哼出的旋律，会被传颂为“第一天使的歌谣”。

dialog.en: Iteration Provident/The Legend Seeker. Exusiai the New Covenant's iteration from decision point F/3019226. Legend has become a joke on everyone's lips, but the bard in the red cloak has never stopped seeking the truth.
dialog.zh: 命途迭代系列/寻翼之歌。新约能天使在决策F/3019226中的迭代。传说已经变成众人口中的笑谈，只有红披风的吟游诗人，不曾停下追寻真实的脚步。

description.en: You suddenly forget why you came here, nor can you recall your original intention of watching this performance under the sun. But this is a journey to find the true self, and inadvertently, the voice of one of his selves reaches your ears.
description.zh: 你突然忘记了自己为何来到此地，也想不起在阳光下注视这场表演的初衷。但这就是寻找真我的旅程，不知哪一个他的声音，在不经意间传到了你的耳中。

dialog.en: PhaseZero Collection Special/Self-Restraint. Under the blazing midday sun, amid the warbling of liberi on Olive Square, a dazzling art that bestows philosophy upon onlookers is being performed.
dialog.zh: 错位巡礼新定义[第零位相/PhaseZero]系列特别款/真我自扼。正午的烈阳之下，橄榄广场的羽兽鸣啭中，上演着让围观者通晓哲理的夺目艺术。

description.en: If you wish to uncover the secrets of the ancients, if you wish to obtain power sealed away, you must be of tremendous courage and inordinate resilience. In this inescapable, ultimate trial, she shall be your opponent.
description.zh: 想要揭开远古的奥秘，获得被封印的力量，就必须拥有超凡的勇气和强大的韧性。这场无法逃避的终极试炼，由她来做你的对手。

dialog.en: Achievement Star Collection/The Bloodwing Rose. Leizi's character in 'Dark Age of Terra'. Amidst bloodwing's roar, twisting, thorned peals of thunder descend. Of all the challenges the adventurers have faced, she is the prickliest by far.
dialog.zh: 成就之星系列/血翼蔷薇。惊蛰在游戏《苍影历年纪》内的角色形象。缠绕荆棘的雷霆在血翼的嘶吼声中现身，她正是冒险者能遇到的最棘手的挑战。

description.en: Fancy a street-car chase, or a duel of martial skills in the park? You choose the challenge, but whether to show mercy is up to her.
description.zh: 想来一次街头飙车追捕，还是一场公园武艺死斗？挑战由你来选，但是否留情由她来决定。

dialog.en: 0011 Sub-brand Speed Series New Arrival/Glinting Determination. Designed for those with an awe-inspiring presence who can sweep away evil on the streets. The exorcism talismans stand out even more under the glow of the blue flame, reflecting her heroic and fearless Oni demeanor.
dialog.zh: 0011子品牌，飙系列新款/一闪极意。为能在街头一扫邪气的凛然之人所设计的服饰。镇邪符纸在蓝焰的光芒下更加显眼，映照出她快意无畏的鬼族英姿。

description.en: Bringing a soul-soothing hymn and the announcement of light's return to those trapped in the haze and blizzard, unable to move forward.
description.zh: 为困于阴霾与风雪中无法前进的人们，带来抚慰心灵的颂歌，和光明再临的宣告。

dialog.en: Ambience Synesthesia Special/Dawn Hymn. The layers of dark clouds lingering over time have finally broken apart. The cloak lining adorned with morning stars symbolizes the purified sky, while the headdress she wears blossoms with a radiant dawn.
dialog.zh: 音律联觉特供款/曙光祝颂。笼罩在时光之上的层层阴云已然破开，装饰着晨星的披风内衬象征着得到净化的天际，而她佩戴的头饰绽放出了灿然的曙光。

description.en: Swing once, send five fowlbeasts scampering. Swing twice, make a blue fowl land on the fingertip. Swing three times, make the teacher's pet hysterical again.
description.zh: 晃一下绳索荡起秋千，能惊动五只小异兽。晃两下绳索，藤蔓随风飞舞，一只湖蓝色的羽兽轻停指尖。晃三下绳索，优等生小姐会不会又要大呼小叫了？

dialog.en: Brand Collaborative Series/Rainforest, Me, Rainbow. The waterproof, breathable fabric comes in handy for rainforest work. Lightweight, wear-resistant, and protects from the sun. Tail attachment optional.
dialog.zh: 品牌合作服装/林虹之间。防水面料支持雨林环境中的各项任务作业，透气耐磨，防晒轻便。如有特殊需要，还可根据体型自行加购尾部防护组件。

description.en: Beauty is also important in battles.
description.zh: 即使是作战也不能舍弃美观。

dialog.en: 0011 New Arrivals/Spring Vouivre. Handmade by Lungmen craftsman, this stylish outfit combines comfortable materials with cutting-edge tech and traditional handicraft. Custom-made services are also available.
dialog.zh: 0011™新款/春竜。龙门匠制，尖端科技和传统工艺的完美结合。搭配私人作战装备配套定制服务。

description.en: An arc and thunder, dividing ally from enemy.
description.zh: 一道奔雷，区分友人和敌人。

dialog.en: Striker Series/Overload. A product of Raythean Industries, a combat outfit fully tailored to exceptional specialist personnel. Offers reliable defense in all environments, further supports the Operator's own Originium Arts.
dialog.zh: 推进者系列/超载。雷神工业出品，为特殊专业人员量身定制的作战服饰，在全环境下都能够提供稳定防护，并支持干员自身源石技艺的施展。

description.en: She spends more time in her work attire than normal.
description.zh: 比起日常穿着，她穿工作服的时间更长。

dialog.en: Pioneer Series/Lacquer. Raythean Industrial's new product is fully sealed and made with special fabrics that are resistant to even the harshest environmental conditions. Its dust-proof design is suitable for researchers who enter and exit dangerous areas.
dialog.zh: 开拓者系列/漆匠。雷神工业出品，全覆式，采用特制面料，对粉尘等恶劣环境拥有极高抗性，面向需要出入危险区域的研究人员。

description.en: Cold cannot hinder the thirst for knowledge.
description.zh: 寒冷阻碍不了对知识的渴求。

dialog.en: Cambrian 1097 Winter New Arrivals/Frosted Breath. Layered insulating design, free to be mixed and matched to individual taste. Catered to the client's personal needs, this fit has been altered by hand, adjusting the left sleeve's opening and adding an arm guard.
dialog.zh: 寒武纪1097冬季新款/霜息。多层防寒设计，可按个人喜好自由拆装。照顾到客人个人需求，本款经过手工修改， 调整左袖开口的同时加装了护臂。

description.en: Set the crystal ball aside - traveling is all about looking forward to the unknown.
description.zh: 旅行就是期待未知，让水晶球暂时成为装饰吧。

dialog.en: EPOQUE New Arrivals/Unknown Journey. Trendy, made for the spring season, well-fitting and comfortable, comes with a choice of accessories that can be mixed and matched to suit your style.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/未知的旅行。春季潮流款，合身且舒适，另有数种配饰可供选择，自由搭配，每个人都能装扮出不同的风格。

description.en: Deepcolor describes epic scenes while fiddling with the strange terminal. Gradually, you begin to see visions of a silhouette fighting strange foes. You do not know if this came from reality, or fiction.
description.zh: 深海色一边绘声绘色地向你描述着波澜壮阔的情景，一边调试着手中的怪异终端。一段时间后，你觉得自己好像看到了一个与奇异敌人战斗的身影。你也不知道这源于她真实的生活还是纯粹的创作。

dialog.en: Cambrian 1099 New Winter Collection/Melodic Portrayal. Stylishly loose-fitting, comfortable and mobile. The waterproof surface keeps it from being stained by paint, making it the ideal outfit for artists.
dialog.zh: 寒武纪1099冬季新款/绘声绘影。极具设计感的宽松版型便于行动且不失个性，高分子防水面料不会沾上一点颜料，非常适合作画时穿着。

description.en: She will forever stand before her followers, and she will lead them forward, back to their homeland.
description.zh: 她将永远站在追随者的身前，带领她们前进，带领她们，回到故土。

dialog.en: Striker Series/City Destroyer. A product of Raythean Industries, this defensive gear is designed for robust combat, with additional high-density shock-absorbent elements present in the lining that answer the impact of attacks, while simultaneously tailored in parts to ensure high flexibility.
dialog.zh: 推进者系列/摧城。雷神工业出品，针对强对抗性作战而设计的防护服，内衬中添加了高密度减震单元，足以抵御冲击，同时局部剪裁保证了高机动性。

description.en: Already used to the strange life.
description.zh: 早已熟悉的陌生生活。

dialog.en: Vitafield [Rewilder] Series Classics/Legacy. Made with special materials and designed to be functional, perfect for coping with various needs and weathering even the roughest outdoor conditions.
dialog.zh: 生命之地™️[识荒者/Rewilder]系列经典款/遗石。采用特别材质制作，包含各项功能性设计，足以应对多种自然环境变化，满足各类需求。

description.en: After hearing of Theresa's past deeds, for just a moment, W was truly lost thinking about it: 'Are there really people who'd go and put childlike ideals like that into practice?'
description.zh: 在听闻特蕾西娅的事迹后，有那么一刻，W确实在思考这个问题：“真有人会去实践那样幼稚的理想吗？”

dialog.en: EPOQUE Line [Passe] Series Selects/Fugue. Ordinary Sarkaz mercenary wear. Easy to mend, protective, and carries even more explosives after simple modification.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE子品牌 [昔时/Passe]系列精选款/恍惚。普通的萨卡兹佣兵装扮，便于修补，防护性良好，经过简单改装能携带更多爆炸物。

description.en: The Ursus people never hide their leading views on fashion trends.
description.zh: 乌萨斯人从不掩饰自己对时尚潮流的引领性见解。

dialog.en: I.T Brand UNDER GARDEN Collab Outfit/Ursus IO79. A black and red base. A compact design, drawing from casual accessories to give a boost to color variety, bringing about a brand new fashion experience.
dialog.zh: I.T旗下品牌UNDER GARDEN合作款服装/乌萨斯IO79。黑红基础配色，紧凑型设计，借助随性装饰提升色彩丰富度，带来崭新穿搭体验。

description.en: The right temperament and clothing converge in just the perfect manner.
description.zh: 合适的气质与衣装，造就万中无一的焦点。

dialog.en: MARTHE New Arrivals/Ready to Go. Inspired by traditional Ursus school uniforms, this season's most successful iteration is fine-tuned to capture the trends of today's youth. Top seller in Ursus.
dialog.zh: MARTHE系列新款/整装待发。以乌萨斯传统学校制服为底，搭上本季最受欢迎的大衣款式，加以微调，使其更符合青年的穿着习惯。乌萨斯地区热销中。

description.en: Hard work always pays off.
description.zh: 有所付出有所得。

dialog.en: Vitafield [Rewilder] Series Classics/Bitter Herbs. Made with special materials, it has multiple functions that can meet the needs in all kinds of natural environments.
dialog.zh: 生命之地™[识荒者/Rewilder]系列经典款/辛味。采用特别材质制作，包含各项功能性设计，足以应对多种自然环境变化，满足各类需求。

description.en: 'Execute without pardon.'
description.zh: “斩无赦。”

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Wind of Breaking Blade. Shirayuki's combat attire in her confrontation with Samuraitaisho serving the North, during the Northern and Southern Courts Battle of Echigo. The head orders: sight enemy, see blood.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/曲刃晴风。白雪在南北朝越后合战与北朝侍大将交锋时的武装。家主有令，见敌，见血。

description.en: To give the most beautiful smile to the last sleepless night of the year.
description.zh: 给一年中的最后一个无眠之夜最美的笑容。

dialog.en: 0011 New Arrivals/Night Watcher. Handmade by Lungmen craftsman, this stylish outfit combines comfortable materials with cutting-edge tech and traditional handicraft. Custom-made services are also available. Fireproof.
dialog.zh: 0011™新款/守岁人。龙门匠制，尖端科技和传统工艺的完美结合。提供个人定制服务。防火。

description.en: May you always look toward the bright future as these flowers do.
description.zh: 愿你如这花朵一般，总是满怀对明日的企盼。

dialog.en: Test Collection Series/Bunch of Sunlight. Outfit specially designed for going out. It uses the operator's main color as basic tone and matches it with a different-colored jacket for a vivid contrast.
dialog.zh: 忒斯特收藏系列/一束阳光。经过设计的出行搭配，以干员的个人主色为基调，配以异色外套做点缀。

description.en: 'I... knew you'd be here. Sorry, but I won't let you pass. No matter what.'
description.zh: “我……猜到会是你。对不起，我不会让路。我绝对不会。”

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Dreadnaught. The attire worn by the elite operator, Beagle, when serving as rearguard during the Great March of Bolívar. This is her final test.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/无畏。精英干员米格鲁在玻利瓦尔大行军负责殿后时穿着的装束。这是她最后的考验。

description.en: I wish I could spend every day in peace.
description.zh: 想要平稳度过的每一天。

dialog.en: Cambrian 1096 Winter New Arrivals/Cruciata. Waterproof with handmade details, it includes special sleeves, detachable parts and zipper pockets.
dialog.zh: 寒武纪™1096冬季新款/十字郡。特别手工细节填充，使用防水材质，含袖口部拉链与可拆卸帽子、拉链口袋。

description.en: Kroos falls into a long, long dream. In that dream, she dons star and moon, and sails the ocean blue. She meets a few interesting people, and sees plenty of comedy and tragedy both. Where will her journey take her next? She's eager to find out.
description.zh: 克洛丝做了一个漫长的梦。梦里，她披星戴月，远渡重洋。旅途中，她认识了一些有趣的人，见过了几场喜剧和悲剧。下一站会是哪里呢？她很期待。

dialog.en: Test Collection Series/Moonlit Voyage. Themed around the night sky, the moon and oceanic voyages, the dream-like weave of star and sea feels like going on a fantastical journey, with drifting moon and stars as companions.
dialog.zh: 忒斯特收藏系列/星月漂流记。以星空、月亮和航海元素为主题，呈现出星辰与大海交织的梦幻风格，仿佛置身于奇幻的星月漂流旅程。

description.en: The holiday's true value lies in this smile.
description.zh: 节日的价值，就在于这份笑容。

dialog.en: Witch Feast Series/the mag. An outfit that Kroos designed for herself. In addition to being fashionable, it incorporates some mechanisms to assist her with her magic tricks.
dialog.zh: 克洛丝为自己设计的狂欢服饰/魔术师。采用了较为时尚的设计，并且在服装各处和装饰品中都设计了一些小机关，方便她进行魔术表演。

description.en: The bowstring trembles, the chord sounds, the wind leaves behind stories in its wake.
description.zh: 弓弦震颤，长琴嗡响，风中留下已唱的逸话。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Bard's Holiday. Trendy autumn attire, loose and breathable. Incorporates a unique multi-layer pocket design, convenient for holding all sorts of lightweight souvenirs during a serendipitous sojourn.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/诗人的假日。秋季潮流款，宽松且透气，衣物特有多层口袋设计，方便塞入各种轻巧物件，来一场说走就走的旅行。

description.en: Gwiazdcytron trees can only grow in Kazimierz. In the times they still remember, the forest wardens are warm and safe, just like their hometown.
description.zh: 星橼树只生长在卡西米尔。在它们尚有记忆的时候，守林人温暖、安全，就像家乡。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Gwiazdcytrony. Meteor's winter clothes from back in Kazimierz. Balancing lightness and warmth, they also allow one to easily hide in dense forests. A reproduction.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE子品牌 [昔时/Passe]系列精选款/星橼林。流星还在卡西米尔时所着的冬装。兼顾轻便与防寒，于密林中的隐蔽性也很高。复原品。

description.en: Tonight, she will write her own tale—the tale of a princess who conquered the endless wilds, and how she conquered her heart beyond reach.
description.zh: 今夜，她将书写属于自己的故事——书写一位征服了无垠荒野的公主，如何征服自己那颗遥不可及的心。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection/La Valse Couronnée de Fleurs. Formalwear Estelle prepared for a ball. A classic white dress is paired with a sash belt adorned with a ribbon with dangling tails. The picture of grace, yet replete with the elegance of night.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/花冕圆舞曲。艾丝黛尔为某场舞会准备的礼裙。复古款的白裙，配上缀有蝴蝶结拖尾的腰封，轻盈曼妙的同时，亦不乏夜幕般的雅致。

description.en: Sensitivity that rationality cannot overcome.
description.zh: 理性无法战胜的感性。

dialog.en: EPOQUE New Arrivals/Serenity. Casual clothing centered around black and purple as main colors to exude a bit of elegance while still maintaining a calm feel. A favorite among women in the workplace, this outfit was Ptilopsis's first choice when going out.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/幽静。常规款服饰，以黑紫为主色，在构建沉稳氛围的同时显出些许典雅。职场女性间好评如潮的一款服饰，曾是白面鸮最爱的出行搭配。

description.en: Crescents of jade shine upon the peaks, as white owls soar amidst the pale clouds.
description.zh: 玉弓映嶂时，白鸮游云间。

dialog.en: 0011 Yun Series New Arrivals/Among the Clouds. Garments crafted by Baizao's master tailors, embodying Yan's charms as envisioned by the wearer. Ptilopsis lightly plucks the strings, and heaven and earth resound with a crisp melody.
dialog.zh: 0011子品牌，韵系列新款/抚云间。百灶的裁衣老师傅倾心设计的衣装，满足了穿着者对炎国风韵的幻想。白面鸮轻抚琴弦，天地间便回荡起一串清音。

description.en: 'Why have you come to Elysia, traveler? Do you seek a song, or perhaps an antidote for your beloved?'
description.zh: “旅人呀，你为何来哀律西昂？是想得到一首歌，还是为心上人寻找剧毒的解药？”

dialog.en: Iteration Provident/Nocturne of Elysia. Blue Poison's iteration from decision point F/3019226. In the land of Elysia, she is the only fairy who is willing to offer a song to the toxic trees.
dialog.zh: 命途迭代系列/哀律西昂夜曲。蓝毒在决策F/3019226中的迭代。在哀律西昂，她是唯一愿为那些剧毒的花木献上歌声的仙子。

description.en: It means a lot to Blue Poison, just because every punch landed feeds back.
description.zh: 蓝毒热衷于此，只因每出一拳都有回馈。

dialog.en: MARTHE Sports Line New Arrivals/Shoal Beat. Fitness attire aimed first and foremost at the masses, absorbent and breathable, with strong stretchability. Preorder with full payment to immediately be gifted a random suitcase in a matching color.
dialog.zh: MARTHE运动系列新款/浅滩律动。以大众为主要销售目标的运动装束，吸湿透气，延展性良好。全款预订即刻赠送随机配色手提箱一款。

description.en: Patrols weren't obligated, but Dobermann still rounded the block a few times each day, up until this place was torn to ruins by the war.
description.zh: 巡逻并非义务，但杜宾仍旧每天在街区走上几圈，直至这里被战争撕扯成废墟。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Line [Passe] Series Selects/Lieutenant. Clothing modified from Bolívarian military uniform, with some accessories coming from Dobermann's own collection.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE子品牌 [昔时/Passe]系列精选款/少尉。以玻利瓦尔军装修改而来的服饰，一些配件源于杜宾自身的收藏。

description.en: Better setting out than knives out, on a bright, sunny day like this.
description.zh: 像这样一个阳光明媚的日子，出行要比出刀更适宜。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HDm04. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]悠然假日系列泳衣04男款。舒适放松，透气轻盈。让您可以在闲适的环境中享受最完美的沙滩体验。

description.en: He himself was not as brash as his outfit, and he took out his sword only to take photos. But even with only a single blade, when it came time to help others, he did not doubt himself for a second.
description.zh: 他渡世并不真像这衣装般张扬，权且出一把刀，也不过是为了摄影的方便。但哪怕真只这一把单刀，到了渡人之时，他亦绝不自疑。

dialog.en: 0011 Tempest Series New Arrivals/One Blade. Form-fitting, cool, and breathable sportswear, for those patrolling the streets. In a fistfight, the flowing scarlet sleeves become a raging flame. The accompanying sword is most certainly not a prop.
dialog.zh: 0011子品牌，飙系列新款/单刀。为巡行街头的有需之人设计的贴身运动装，凉爽透气。若穿着者施展起拳脚，鲜红大袖便扬作烈火一片。搭配的刀并非道具。

description.en: May's detective senses tell her that so long as she follows this alley filled with exotic homes, sun and surf will be within reach. Or at the very least, she'll be closer than where she was just now.
description.zh: 梅的推断是，只要走过这些遍是异国民居的小巷，阳光沙滩就在不远处——至少，应该是在比刚才更近一些的地方。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA054. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]夏卉系列泳衣054款。参考少女的身材和体质，采用天然材质制成。追求今夏最领先的设计潮流。

description.en: It'd be best not to let her into the kitchen.
description.zh: 最好别让她进厨房。

dialog.en: Rhodes Kitchen Collection/Children's Party. Designed by Silence. Made with special materials from Rhine Lab, it offers a completely unnecessary amount of protection.
dialog.zh: 由赫默参与设计的KFC合作系列服装/儿童派对。使用莱茵生命特殊材料制成，毫无必要地拥有着相当高的防护性。

description.en: According to Ifrit, 'There ain't a single problem I can't crush.' Even if it's a string of numbers that makes no sense, or a totally boring travel plan—'The only difficulty setting is 'Easy'? I could clear it easily even on the highest one!'
description.zh: 对伊芙利特大人来说，没有什么困难是无法克服的，即使是看不懂的数字，以及毫无挑战性的游玩安排——“难度只有‘轻松’？也太小看我了吧！”

dialog.en: Brand Collaborative Series/Relaxing Trip. Mark monsters, fortresses, and treasures on the map. Bring along your beloved dolls, a warm drink, and a cheerful mood. Come on, this is what it means to start a trip.
dialog.zh: 品牌合作服装/轻松旅途。在地图上标注怪物、标注堡垒、标注宝藏，带上心爱的玩偶、温暖的饮料、愉悦的心情。来吧，这些都是“出发”的应有之义。

description.en: It's burnt!
description.zh: 糊了!

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Sunburn Series Swimming Suit Type SP. Special Rhine Lab Collaboration Type. To meet Rhine Lab's specifications, this outfit is both comfortable and possesses heat-resistant properties.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]日晒系列泳衣SP款。莱茵生命特殊合作款。满足莱茵生命研究所的基础用途，在采用新型耐热材料的同时保证了舒适度。

description.en: The faint light of the stars is unable to penetrate the depths of the darkness, but she firmly believes that the light she's after will be enough to illuminate every nook and cranny of this land.
description.zh: 群星流转的微芒无法洞穿深沉的黑夜，她坚信自己追寻的光芒足以照亮大地上每一个角落。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Her Aspiration. The clothes Astgenne wore in her rented home. A lab coat thrown over an elegant and close fit, for she must always be ready for a whimsical stroke of inspiration for her experiments.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/所愿。星源在自己租的屋子里所穿的服饰。优雅贴身的小礼服之外，再套上一件研究服。她随时会突发奇想开始实验，必须为此做好准备。

description.en: The nightmare that haunts all gangs alike in Lungmen, large or small.
description.zh: 龙门大小帮派一致认定的梦魇。

dialog.en: 0011 Tempest-Series New Arrival/Patrolling Ronin. Several designers joined forces to create a look inspired by the style of the streets. Complete with the redesigned shield of an L.G.D. Officer joined with traditional elements from Higashi, this outfit brings a truly formidable look.
dialog.zh: 0011子品牌，飙系列新款/狩标浪人。多位设计师联手呈现，挑战街头风格。特别改装了一面近卫局制式盾，配以东国传统元素，压迫感十足。

description.en: If they knew that Hoshiguma crushed the coconut she'd finished drinking with her bare hands before throwing it in the trash, would the waves washing onto the artificial beach become quieter?
description.zh: 如果知道星熊喝完的椰子会被徒手压碎丢进垃圾桶，人工海滩的造浪是否就会——安分一些呢？

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Seeker Series Swimming Suit SK97. The material is light, breathable and exquisite. It's been tailored to meet the needs of those go-getter explorers.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]探寻者系列泳衣97款。轻薄透气，用料讲究，为开拓进取的探寻者们量身打造。

description.en: These fresh, luscious berries are already driving people crazy. What if you dipped them in a touch of thick honey... Wait, did you see that Ursus girl just now?
description.zh: 新鲜莓果已能让人疯狂，要是再蘸上一点浓稠的蜂蜜……你看到那个乌萨斯女孩了吗？

dialog.en: Rhodes Kitchen Collection/Honey Pilferer. Beehunter's sleepwear. Fluffy, soft, comfortable, tight-fitting, and easy to wash, this outfit is suitable for both home use and as sleepwear. What nobody expected is that Beehunter would head straight to the food festival.
dialog.zh: 罗德厨房系列/掠蜜能手。猎蜂的睡衣。蓬松柔软，舒适贴身且易洗，适合居家以及睡眠时穿着。让人没想到的是猎蜂居然直接穿去了美食节。

description.en: 'Is that all? That's all our lives are worth. I told you, everything you've taken from me, I'll have you repay. In full.'
description.zh: “这些够了吗？你我的命也就值这个价。我说了，你从我生命里拿走的，我会赎回来。全部。”

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Refined Horrormare. The outfit Lappland wore at the Laterano Apostolic Knights' Funeral Memorial Hall. Collect the debts, and pay the price.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/典雅噩兆。拉普兰德在拉特兰教宗骑士显圣纪念堂参加葬礼时的装束。讨取债务，支付代价。

description.en: Disappearances, odd deaths, clues that lead into the unknown. In the Dark Forest, by the light of the blood-red moon, the detective hears the name of the 'Hospital of Horror' for the very first time, straight from the smiling therapist's lips.
description.zh: 消失的人影，离奇的死亡，线索通向何方。血红色月夜下的暗黑森林里，那微笑着的疗养师口中，侦探第一次听到了“恐怖医院”的名号。

dialog.en: Storyboard Breaker Serialized Comic [Beyond Redemption] Final Character Art/The Nursing Home Creepshow. Outfit of the Dark Forest's therapist in the story. Holding poison in her right hand, her fingertips curled towards her subtle smile, making others wonder if those heavy chains are of any use.
dialog.zh: 破格视界连载漫画《无从救赎》角色定稿/疗养地怪谈。故事中暗黑森林疗养师的着装。她右手拿着毒药，指尖划向浅笑着的嘴角，让人怀疑那沉重的锁链是否真的管用。

description.en: She cares a lot about this outfit, even though she already can't remember why.
description.zh: 她很在意这套服饰，即使已经忘记了理由。

dialog.en: Cambrian 1096 Winter New Arrivals/Undercurrent. Waterproof with handmade details, it includes special sleeves, detachable parts and zipper pockets.
dialog.zh: 寒武纪™1096冬季新款/暗流。特别手工细节填充，使用防水材质，含袖口部拉链与可拆卸帽子、拉链口袋。

description.en: Hunting aquatic prey calls for new equipment, and Red's trialing it right now.
description.zh: 狩猎水里的猎物需要些新装备，红正在尝试使用它们。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Light Breeze Series Launch Type LB01. A swimsuit and jacket set designed with the full body in mind. Sure to satisfy your waterside athletic needs.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]轻风系列泳衣首发01款。基于整体性考量设计的泳装冲锋衣套组，必定能满足您在水边的运动着衣需求。

description.en: You can always meet new friends at the beach.
description.zh: 沙滩上总能遇见新朋友。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HD08. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]悠然假日系列泳衣08款。舒适放松，透气轻盈。让您可以在闲适的环境中享受最完美的沙滩体验。

description.en: Treading through myriad wildernesses, all to track down a past vision recalled.
description.zh: 踏过万千荒芜，仅为追寻存于记忆的往昔愿景。

dialog.en: Vitafield [Foruiner] Series Classics/Wasteland Walker. For the explorer pursuing what remains. Made with special materials suited for adapting to all climates, meeting the harsh demands of complex environments.
dialog.zh: 生命之地[探墟客/Foruiner]系列经典款/荒原行者。面向搜寻遗迹的探索者，特别材质制作，适应多端气候变化，满足对复杂环境的特殊需求。

description.en: Not even the dark night can conceal her glow.
description.zh: 夜色也遮掩不住她的光采。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Silent Night Series Swimming Suit Type 02. The material is light, soft, breathable and durable. The latest design that is as enchanting as it is elegant.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]静谧午夜系列泳衣02款。材质轻便透气，舒适耐磨。采用尖端设计，神秘典雅，高贵。

description.en: Even the Radiant Knight must still apply sunblock and set up parasols beneath the seaside sun.
description.zh: 即使是耀骑士，在海边的太阳前依旧要涂好防晒霜竖起遮阳伞。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Shining Dew Series SD01. Tight-fitting, breathable, lightweight, and designed for the summer.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]灿阳朝露系列泳衣01款。贴身、透气、轻便，专为夏日而生。

description.en: Even if the land is dead and dry, Scavenger will still survive.
description.zh: 即使大地枯死，清道夫仍旧会活下去。

dialog.en: Striker Series/Survive. A product of Raythean Industries, adopting the latest in adaptive clothing material, paired with an all-encompassing tailoring that tightly hugs the skin, ensuring operators' survival under the most extreme circumstances.
dialog.zh: 推进者系列/生存。雷神工业出品，采用最新型的适应性面料，配合全覆式剪裁工艺，紧紧包裹皮肤，保证干员能够在最极端的环境下存活。

description.en: You may forget where you came from, but not where you are going to.
description.zh: 也许会忘记来处，但不会忘记目的地。

dialog.en: Vitafield [Rewilder] Series Classics/Quadrangle. Made with special materials, it has multiple functions that can meet the needs in all kinds of natural environments.
dialog.zh: 生命之地™[识荒者/Rewilder]系列经典款/四边形。采用特别材质制作，包含各项功能性设计，足以应对多种自然环境变化，满足各类需求。

description.en: 'Wow! The flowers in the water are so pretty, and the goldfins are too! If I take some back, every day will be as bright as summer! ...Err, what did I come here to get again?'
description.zh: “哇！水里的这些花儿真好看，金鳞也好漂亮，多带一点回去，每天就都能像夏天一样开心了！……唔，我原本是要采什么来着？”

dialog.en: 0011 Yun Series New Arrivals/Amongst Lotuses. Summer clothes inspired by lotus flowers, made for Cuora by Yanese artisans. Only after countless back-and-forths with the client did the backpack's design finally receive her approval.
dialog.zh: 0011子品牌，韵系列新款/与荷。炎国匠人从荷花上汲取灵感，为蛇屠箱制作的夏日服装。在与顾客不断沟通后，最终将背包制作成了受其认可的款式。

description.en: 'This is the end you deserve for forcing the people to live in hatred and unease. Now fall. Hand your filthy soul over to the city pavement.'
description.zh: “让人们活在怨恨与不安中，这是你应得的下场。坠落吧，让这城市的地面收下你那肮脏不堪的灵魂。”

dialog.en: Iteration Provident Series/The Dark Night Terminator. Crownslayer's iteration from decision point S/5258902. Dark clothes for an assassin. She grips her blade, determined to bring an end to the darkest corners of the city with her own hands.
dialog.zh: 命途迭代系列/夜之终局。弑君者在决策S/5258902中的迭代。身着暗色的杀手服，她执起刀刃，决心要让城市中最浓的黑暗终结在自己手上。

description.en: 'The celebration is about to begin~ Sound the horns, spread the confetti, and follow me!'
description.zh: “庆典开始啦~吹起号角，铺散彩带，跟着我来吧！”

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Light Gold Celebration. Generalissimo Myrtle's attire during her triumphant return. Stand at attention–– and salute!
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/淡金庆典。桃金娘大将军得胜归来时的礼服，列队——欢迎！

description.en: The great generalissimo has defeated the sun. Enjoy the triumph of the sea breeze before moving on to conquer the waves.
description.zh: 阳光已被大将军彻底击败，在下一步征服海浪之前，先享受一会儿海风的赞美吧。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA062. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]夏卉系列泳衣062款。参考少女的身材和体质，采用天然材质制成。追求今夏最领先的设计潮流。

description.en: That was the 10-star 'Clapolpolska' randomed from the song category! So? Did my skills amaze you?' Myrtle points at the screen, showing off her perfect full combo result to you.
description.zh: “刚刚我演奏的这首是全随机魔王十星《竖波波卡》！怎么样，被我吓到了吧？”桃金娘指着屏幕上大大的全连全良成绩向你炫耀。

dialog.en: Taiko no Tatsujin Collaboration Outfit/Bustling Festival. Myrtle no longer cares about scoremaxxing during this grand festival, having fun drumming to the beat, rousing the audience's spirit. Don Don—KA!
dialog.zh: 太鼓之达人合作服装/繁闹祭典。在这盛大的祭典上，桃金娘已经不再拘泥于游戏分数，她挥舞鼓槌，随着音乐击打鼓面，引燃全场。咚咚——咔！

description.en: 'Aside from memoirs, I do occasionally write fiction. Here, have a peek—Oh, don't mind the wine stains, but the characters' deeds feel mighty familiar, don't they? Doesn't matter what I write—my pen hand keeps going back to the old gang. It's a real headache, I tell you!'
description.zh: “除了回忆录，我偶尔也会写点虚构故事，可你看——别管那些酒渍，你不觉得这几个角色干的事很眼熟吗？不管我怎么写，好像总会回到那帮家伙身上，真伤脑筋！”

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Behind the Words. Morgan's outfit for when she's drafting her next work. A classic windbreaker makes an odd pairing for form-fitting innerwear, a bold statement showing that a serious attitude and a rebellious personality don't have to clash.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/字里行间。摩根构思新作时的穿着。经典廓形风衣与贴身的内搭形成了视觉碰撞，宣告着严肃态度和叛逆个性之间的矛盾并非不可调和。

description.en: Civilization asks that people dress appropriately, but oftentimes, it takes the good old rules of nature to settle an incident.
description.zh: 文明要求人们穿着得体，但想解决事端，往往还是得用弱肉强食的老办法。

dialog.en: Striker Series/Valiant General. A product of Raythean Industries, this traditional Victorian formal attire has been reworked with upgraded materials across the board, alongside a lining imbued with the latest in structured textiles, providing effective protection against sharp instruments.
dialog.zh: 推进者系列/悍将。雷神工业出品，维多利亚传统正装的改良版型，材料全面升级，并在内衬中添入最新研发的结构化织物，有效防止锐器伤害。

description.en: With warmth still her companion, she is not alone.
description.zh: 还有温度与之为伴，她并不孤单。

dialog.en: Firewatch's Winter Clothing/Snowywatch. An outfit made for the priority demands of rural activity and cold resistance, with hues adhering to nature, simple and soft, aimed towards hunters and Messengers operating long-term in the northern wilds.
dialog.zh: 守林人的冬日服饰/覆雪。以野外活动与防寒为优先需求制作的服饰，颜色贴近自然，朴素且柔和，目标人群为长期在北方荒野行动的猎人与信使。

description.en: When the cypress withers away, what remains is a new lease of life.
description.zh: 枯萎殆尽，剩下的便是生机。

dialog.en: Vitafield [Rewilder] Series Classics/Wilted Cypress. Made with special materials and designed to be functional, perfect for coping with various needs and weathering even the roughest outdoor conditions.
dialog.zh: 生命之地™️[识荒者/Rewilder]系列经典款/枯柏。采用特别材质制作，包含各项功能性设计，足以应对多种自然环境变化，满足各类需求。

description.en: Ah, games—a whole new domain ripe for conviction.
description.zh: 啊，游戏，一片新的断罪领域。

dialog.en: Achievement Star Collection/Your Superconvicting Friend. A complimentary outfit that came with the luxury limited edition of a retro arcade machine. Loose and relaxed with a classic palette, this fit will both flaunt your gamer status and accompany you on your daily outings.
dialog.zh: 成就之星系列/超级断罪朋友。某复古游戏机豪华限定版赠送服饰，宽松舒适，经典配色，既能彰显玩家身份，也可用于日常出行。

description.en: 'This is the treasury of Lachedamon, and my workshop. You want weapons that can kill Them? Give me some time.'
description.zh: “这里是拉刻代蒙的宝库，也是我的工坊。你想要能杀死祂们的武器？给我一点时间。”

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Ignis. The hammering of iron resounds across the mountains. The weapons she forges are known as Ignis, for the power contained within them is enough to set all of Terra ablaze.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/火种。金铁撞击之声，响彻群山。她铸造出来的武器被称作火种，因为它们之中蕴含的力量，可以点燃天地万物。

description.en: The time has suddenly come, reversing black and white.
description.zh: 时光突至，黑白异位。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Light and Shadow. A trendy, vintage Victorian appeal, modified to Nightmare's specifications. Some decorative elements will change when Nightmare's personality shifts.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/光影。维多利亚潮流款复古服装，按照夜魔的要求进行了些许调整。部分佩饰在夜魔人格切换时会发生变化。

description.en: 'My dear, how can the land of love be real when these lands are so full of hardship? Love and loss walk hand in hand. Do you understand now? This ferry is the final stop. Alright then, now close your eyes, and sleep tight.'
description.zh: “亲爱的，这片大地充满了苦难，又怎会存在爱的国度？爱与死相生相伴。现在你明白了吗，这艘船真正的终点？好了，闭上眼，晚安。”

dialog.en: Unveiling of Devotion Series New Arrivals/The Ferry Girl. Clothes Gloria wears on outings. The pink and white of the dress and the flowers complement each other. This is the ferry to the land of love, and she's waiting for you to board.
dialog.zh: 待予花冠系列新款/湖畔的少女。葛罗莉亚郊游时的装扮。粉白相间的连衣裙与花朵交相辉映。小船通往爱的国度，她在等你。

description.en: Keep the swimming suit from fire.
description.zh: 请不要将泳衣靠近明火。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Temperature Difference Series Swimming Suit Type RX01. Attached with various accessories for convenient use. The special material is fire and cold-proof and suitable for activities in a variety of waters.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]温差系列泳衣RX01款。附带各种实用部件，舒适便捷，采用特殊材质耐火耐寒，适合于各种环境的水域。

description.en: She's just taking the chance to suntan while on call as an emergency medic—is that an explanation you'd believe?
description.zh: 她是去当应急医务人员顺便晒晒太阳的——你相信这样的解释吗？

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HD31. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]悠然假日系列泳衣31款。舒适放松，透气轻盈。让您可以在闲适的环境中享受最完美的沙滩体验。

description.en: This is her home.
description.zh: 这是她的主场。

dialog.en: Witch Feast Series/the feast. A custom-made outfit for Warfarin that incorporates holiday designs with Sarkaz motifs. The designer personally embellished this outfit with plenty of jewelry.
dialog.zh: 华法琳定制的狂欢服饰/盛宴。在节日元素的基础上，添加了萨卡兹的服装风格元素。由设计者本人亲手加工，制作了大量额外饰品。

description.en: Enciodes rejected those insignificant, sycophantic invitations to cooperation. He believes Kjerag will eventually conquer the entire audience, but understands that now is not the time for the ice to melt.
description.zh: 恩希欧迪斯谢绝了那些谄媚的、无关紧要的合作邀请。他相信谢拉格终会征服所有听众，但他也很清楚，现在还不是坚冰融化的时候。

dialog.en: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Never-melting Ice. One of SilverAsh's suits, tailored for important events. The weight of the name of Silverash clan can tear rifts across Terra. Even majestic glaciers and roiling clouds make way for him.
dialog.zh: 音律联觉特供款/不融冰。银灰的礼服，为出席重要场合量身定制。名为希瓦艾什的力量在泰拉撕开裂口，磅礴的冰川与奔腾的云也将为他让路。

description.en: One glance, and you already know everything you need about Victoria's sacred tome.
description.zh: 用一双眼，看懂维多利亚这本宝典。

dialog.en: SilverAsh's Tailor-Made Outfit by Savile/York's Bise. The expensive fabrics are as cold-resistant as possible while still ensuring comfort. Combined with a special scarf to reflect the discerning taste of the tailor.
dialog.zh: 萨维尔衣匠为银灰量身定做的服饰/约克的寒风。采用昂贵的面料，在保证舒适感的同时尽可能抗寒耐磨。配以特制的围巾，尽显订衣者的品味。

description.en: Though the Silverashes will never be afraid of challenges, summertime seaside still feels a bit too hot.
description.zh: 虽说希瓦艾什永不惧怕挑战，但海边实在是，有些炎热。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Seeker Series Swimming Suit SKm01. The material is light, breathable and exquisite. It's been tailored to meet the needs of those inventive elites.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]探寻者系列泳衣01豪华男款。轻薄透气，用料讲究，为开拓进取的精英们量身打造。

description.en: Be careful whenever you take a step, and cherish it whenever you reach the top.
description.zh: 每一个动作都很小心，每一次登顶都很可贵。

dialog.en: Vitafield [Rewilder] Series Classics/Lone Climber. Made with special materials, it has multiple functions that can meet the needs in all kinds of natural environments.
dialog.zh: 生命之地™[识荒者/Rewilder]系列经典款/孤攀客。采用特别材质制作，包含各项功能性设计，足以应对多种自然环境变化，满足各类需求。

description.en: Explore, witness, protect.
description.zh: 探寻，见证，保护。

dialog.en: WWF Collaborative Series/Highlands Visitor. Using synthetic materials to capture the inspiration of the great outdoors, this outfit is capable of adapting to adverse environments and protects experienced explorers as they visit every corner of Terra.
dialog.zh: WWF合作服装/高原访客。以自然为设计理念，采用人工合成材料制衣，能够适应各种严酷挑战，保护有经验的巡护员走到泰拉每个角落。

description.en: There is no Pramanix here, only an ordinary girl named Enya.
description.zh: 这里没有初雪，只有一个叫恩雅的普通女孩。

dialog.en: Pramanix's Tailor-Made Outfit by Savile/Caster's Frost. A full set of hand-made clothing that perfectly fits the wearer's body shape, with additional details to her lifestyle.
dialog.zh: 萨维尔衣匠为初雪量身定做的服饰/开斯特之霜。全套手工制作，完美贴合体型，增加了部分细节以最大程度贴合订衣者的生活习惯。

description.en: Bathed in the brilliant flows, Liz sees some beautiful possibilities—but it all comes to an end once she wakes.
description.zh: 沐浴着流溢的光辉，丽兹看到了一些美好的可能性——但一切都伴随着醒来而终结。

dialog.en: Misaligned Sightseer New Arrivals/Iakhu of Flows. In a naptime dream adorned with gold, the earth swells beneath Liz's feet, supporting a homeland. The sphere of the heavens turns above her head, spilling its golden rays upon her.
dialog.zh: 错位巡礼系列新款/流辉。在充盈着金色的午睡梦境中，大地于丽兹的脚下隆起，托起一方家园。天球在她的头顶移动，洒下一片金辉。

description.en: An ancient elegy from the twilight.
description.zh: 暮色里传来了古老的歌谣。

dialog.en: Witch Feast Series/an elegy. An outfit tailored for Nightingale. Who is the one who sings, and what language is it in? Whose dream do I see, and whose death do I see?
dialog.zh: 为夜莺量身定做的狂欢服饰/挽歌。是谁在歌唱？这种语言从何而来？我看到的是谁的梦，又是谁的死？

description.en: Tonight, let all the complex investigation reports and lengthy monitoring records stay far away from her. Let her embrace her childlike nature and roam among the bright lights with her cute fluffy friends. This is the gift she deserves.
description.zh: 今夜，让那些繁杂的勘查报告和冗长的监测记录都离她远一些，就由她带着孩子的天性，和可爱的毛绒朋友们一起，在华灯间遨游吧。这是她应得的礼物。

dialog.en: Brand Collaborative Series/Fluffy Little Witch. Perhaps every girl has dreamed of it—raising a parasol, donning a top hat, letting her magic dance across the night sky. She tells her fluffy friends the moment for dreams to come true is here.
dialog.zh: 品牌合作服装/绵绒小魔女。或许每个女孩都做过一个梦——撑起阳伞，戴上礼帽，让自己的魔法在夜空中蹦跳。她告诉毛绒朋友们，梦想成真的时刻已到。

description.en: There's no clash at all between studying volcanoes and a love of playing in the water.
description.zh: 研究火山和喜爱玩水一点都不冲突。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA018. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]夏卉系列泳衣018款。参考少女的身材和体质，采用天然材质制成。追求今夏最领先的设计潮流。

description.en: She's emitting the fragrance of countless flowers.
description.zh: 沾染了无数鲜花的香味。

dialog.en: Test Collection/Species Plantarum. Available only in certain regions, this remake of a classic design utilizes the best materials carefully hand-sewn details. An extra custom-made multifunctional tool bag is included.
dialog.zh: 忒斯特™收藏系列/植物种志。限定区域供应。经典款式复刻，采用绝佳材质，附加特别缝纫细节。附特别设计的多用工具袋。

description.en: In this age, taking tea and reading until you're tired might just be a style of relaxation to make people envious.
description.zh: 就着茶点读书读到困倦在这时代或许是种令人艳羡的休闲方式。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Leisurely Afternoon. Home leisure style, relaxed and pleasing to the eye, graceful and cozy. Comes with a pair of adorable fitted slippers, for an afternoon completely free of cares wherever you are.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/闲适午后。居家休闲款，宽松美观，优雅舒适，配有一双合脚的可爱拖鞋，能在任何地方悠哉过上整个午后。

description.en: Field surveys are not vacations. As long as she has her stick, her notebook and her sample box, it counts as work.
description.zh: 去往地质勘察现场对她来说可不是旅行休假，只要还带着手杖、笔记和样品箱，那就算加班时间。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Major Field. Practical yet dignified, it protects from the elements on field surveys, but can also be worn under a jacket for conferences.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/主修领域。地质学研究者地灵兼顾得体与实用的着装，保暖防风便于田野调查，披上外套就可以登台报告讲演。

description.en: Just rehydrate between sets! Once you're all done, there are some cookies on the table as a reward!
description.zh: 组间补充些水分就好，做完全部运动，再去享受桌上的甜美曲奇作为奖励吧！

dialog.en: MARTHE Sports Line New Arrivals/Hydration Time. Clothes specially designed for gym-heads, made from light and breathable materials. Enjoy unprecedented comfort and lightness during your training.
dialog.zh: MARTHE运动系列新款/补水时间。为健身爱好者特别设计的运动装束，采用轻薄透气面料，锻炼时能感受到前所未有的舒适与轻松。

description.en: Where are you? Are you doing well? Can we picnic together again?
description.zh: 你们在哪里？过得还好吗？还能一起出去野餐吗？

dialog.en: Vitafield [Camper] Series Classics/Campfire Cooking Smoke. Warm fur coat paired with red woven scarf for an inviting sight.
dialog.zh: 生命之地[行路人/Camper]系列经典款/营地炊烟。宽大的毛毡大衣保暖性能优秀，搭配正红的针织围巾看起来亲和力十足。

description.en: Don't forget your purpose even in the heat of battle.
description.zh: 奋战之际不忘本职。

dialog.en: EPOQUE First Edition/Combat Medic. Based upon a special-issue Ádakrys battlesuit, it has blades attached in the right parts to give off an extremely aggressive look. Gavial describes it as her ideal 'battlefield trappings.'
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列首发款/战医。以高规格阿达克利斯专用战甲为蓝本，在必要的部位加装了刀片，极具侵略性，是嘉维尔理想中的“战地黑大褂”。

description.en: 'I like leading the vanguard in all my battles. In his case, I imagine it'd be the shieldguard.'
description.zh: “我喜欢带百战先锋。如果是他，应该会喜欢盾卫。”

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Octopath Illusion. Hellagur's clothing during his time as vanguard commander in the Bloodpeak Campaign. If he weren't an enemy, if he could have served Ursus... Even if no such possibility existed.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/歧路幻影。赫拉格在血峰战役担任先锋指挥官时的着装。如果他不是敌人，如果他能服务于乌萨斯……哪怕并无这种可能。

description.en: Vermeil doesn't only hunt in the Siracusan wilds. Sometimes, toy shops are her hunting grounds. Let's see what she caught this time!
description.zh: 除了叙拉古的荒野，红云有时也会把玩具店当作自己的狩猎场。看看这一次她带回了什么猎物！

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Playfellows. Comfy casual clothes Vermeil changed into, sharing the dolls she collected with everyone at the party. Who would've thought she had such a cute collection?
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/玩伴。红云换上休闲舒适的打扮，在派对上与大家分享自己收集的各式玩偶。原来她还有这样的可爱收藏。

description.en: No longer needing to carry a heavy burden, no longer having to stay at arms, she can now easily face a new challenge in life.
description.zh: 不必负重在身，不必严阵以待，她能够从容应对另一种生活中的新挑战。

dialog.en: MARTHE Sports Line New Arrivals/Easy Time. A popular design with fitness lovers in mind. Stitchless weaving techniques and high-performance elastic materials come together for a smooth feel, ensuring snugness and flexibility during exercise.
dialog.zh: MARTHE运动系列新款/从容时刻。针对健身爱好者设计的大众款式，无缝针织工艺搭配高性能弹性面料，触感顺滑，确保运动时的舒适度和灵活性。

description.en: 'People are still sending children onto the battlefield? Got it, I'll handle this rescue mission.'
description.zh: “还有人在把孩子们往战场上送？明白了，我来处理这份解救委托。”

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Breaking the Ice. Operator Frostleaf's attire during her special appointment by the Rhodes Island Columbia branch to conduct a search and rescue in the nation's north. Life has bestowed her the resolve to return to the battlefield.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/破冰。罗德岛哥伦比亚分部特派干员霜叶在哥伦比亚北部执行搜救任务时的装束。生活赋予了她重返战场的决心。

description.en: Leaving this place, will tomorrow bring another unavoidable bitterness? "As long as you remember how to sing the ballads, any despondency is just a passing cloud." She plucks the strings, answering your question with a song.
description.zh: 离开这里，明天是否又要面对无法逃避的苦涩？“只要记得歌谣唱起的方法，任何消沉都不过是一时云烟”，她拨响琴弦，用歌声对你的问题做出了回答。

dialog.en: PhaseZero Collection Special/Songs of Tomorrow. Between the decorations of the corridor and under the rising night sky, a joyful melody flows, making visitors reluctant to leave.
dialog.zh: 错位巡礼新定义[第零位相/PhaseZero]系列特别款/来日欢歌。回廊的雕饰之间，升起的夜幕之下，流转着让来访者不思归去的欢乐曲调。

description.en: The most fun in life is had in books and through food.
description.zh: 百般玩乐，唯书与食可兼得。

dialog.en: Rhodes Kitchen Collection/Bibliosmia. After being re-coordinated to reflect the national outfits of the people of Ursus, Istina wore this outfit to promote traditional cuisine at the food festival. Underneath the plain materials are countless intricate details, and only those who deem themselves wise come to seek answers.
dialog.zh: 罗德厨房系列/书味。经过重新搭配的乌民族服饰，真理穿着它在美食节推广传统美食。朴素材料下编入了难以计数的细节，只等自认聪慧的人前来寻找答案。

description.en: No free jacket or ice cream cart included.
description.zh: 并不会赠送外套和冷饮小车。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA011. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]夏卉系列泳衣011款。参考少女的身材和体质，采用天然材质制成。追求今夏最领先的设计潮流。

description.en: Count Rostov sees his eldest daughter as his magnum opus. But after an unexpected encounter with adversity, Natalya chooses to be herself.
description.zh: 罗斯托夫伯爵视长女为他最完美的作品，但与苦难不期而遇后，娜塔莉娅选择成为自己。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Line [Passe] Series Selects/Masterpiece. The outfit worn by Natalya Andreyevna Rostova, student council president of Chernobog #4 Secondary School, during her commencement speech.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE子品牌 [昔时/Passe]系列精选款/杰作。切尔诺伯格第四中学学生会长娜塔莉娅·安德烈耶维娜·罗斯托娃开学致辞时所穿着的服饰。

description.en: Natalya still knows exactly what makes an afternoon tea perfect—the colors, the frosting, the tea at just the right warmth. But right now? That doesn't matter at all. 'Phew… I'll just lie here for a bit. Just a little bit, that's all.'
description.zh: 娜塔莉娅记得完美下午茶的模样，记得糕点的色度、糖霜的厚度、茶水的温度。但此刻这些并不重要。“呼，那就这样休息一会儿吧，一会儿就好。”

dialog.en: Brand Collaborative Series/Forever Together. Black tea, lemon, colorful little sweets, and lots of soft, friendly companions. Forget stiff manners and anything that ties you down, and just lie back. Your friends' warm, welcoming arms are always there to embrace you.
dialog.zh: 品牌合作服装/常伴我身。红茶、柠檬、糖果，五颜六色的糕点，以及更多柔软而亲密的陪伴。抛开礼节和束缚躺下吧，朋友无私的怀抱永远会为你敞开。

description.en: They say you can see another side to someone when they perform an instrument, but performing an instrument is itself an act too.
description.zh: 有人说演奏能看出人的另外一面，但演奏本身，也是表演。

dialog.en: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Speechless Sound. Stage clothing picked by bassist Courier himself. People think of Kjerag's men as steadfast and untalkative, but Courier's ready with his bass to change their perception.
dialog.zh: 音律联觉特供款/无言狂响。贝斯手讯使自己选配的演出服。人们都觉得谢拉格的汉子坚忍而寡言，但现在讯使准备用贝斯改变他们的看法。

description.en: A carefree journey starts from taking the next step.
description.zh: 自由自在的旅行，从迈出下一步开始。

dialog.en: Cambrian 1096 Winter New Arrivals/New Routes. Waterproof with handmade details, it includes special sleeves, detachable parts and zipper pockets.
dialog.zh: 寒武纪™1096冬季新款/新航线。特别手工细节填充，使用防水材质，含袖口部拉链与可拆卸帽子、拉链口袋。

description.en: Thanks to his effort, the beach is safer.
description.zh: 沙滩变得可靠而安全，多亏了他的付出。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Beach Guard Series Swimming Suit Launch Type 001. Made with materials that are both durable and comfortable, this outfit ensures high performance in a variety of different conditions.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]沙滩护卫系列泳衣首发001款。采用耐磨材质，宽松舒适而又贴身透气。贴合人体，确保观赏性同时便于各种户外运动。

description.en: Croissants are obviously delicious!
description.zh: 可颂当然很好吃！

dialog.en: Rhodes Kitchen Collection/Seven in the Morning. Designed by Croissant. Actually just recycled Exusiai's design because it's cheaper to do it that way.
dialog.zh: 由可颂本人设计的KFC合作系列服装/清晨七点。事实上采用了配合能天使的设计，因为一次做两套比较省钱。

description.en: Croissant has prepared a lot for the field trip. She'll surely make a fortune out of it!
description.zh: 为支援干员们出行，可颂做了许多准备，马上就能赚大钱了！

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Seeker Series Swimming Suit SK03. The material is light, breathable and exquisite. It's been tailored to meet the needs of those go-getter explorers.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]探寻者系列泳衣03款。轻薄透气，用料讲究，为开拓进取的探寻者们量身打造。

description.en: When the sunlight scatters the chill air, the warm breeze thaws the clammy clouds, and even the storm has decided to stop over sea—please, allow her some time to rest.
description.zh: 当阳光驱散寒气，热风融化凝云，风暴也在海面稍作停留，请给她歇息的时光。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Temperature Difference Series Swimming Suit Type RX07. Attached with various accessories for convenient use. The special material is fire and cold-proof, suitable for activities in a variety of waters.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]温差系列泳衣RX07款。附带各种实用部件，舒适便捷，采用特殊材质耐火耐寒，适合于各种环境的水域。

description.en: A lone hunter of the wilderness who maintains order for Sami. Her greatest challenge yet: how to explain proper precautions to an enormous combined Scientific Exploration team of nearly a hundred people.
description.zh: 独行荒野的猎人替萨米维持秩序。她遇到的最大挑战，来自如何给浩浩荡荡近百人的联合科考队讲解注意事项。

dialog.en: Vitafield [Rewilder] Series Classics/Northern Pathfinder. Made with special materials with function in mind, perfect for meeting your various needs and weathering even the roughest conditions.
dialog.zh: 生命之地[识荒者/Rewilder]系列经典款/北地引路人。采用特别材质制作，包含各项功能性设计，足以应对多种自然环境变化，满足各类需求。

description.en: She's been playing all day long and if no one comes to stop her, she'll keep playing.
description.zh: 她已经玩了一天了，如果没人阻止她，她还能继续玩下去。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA333. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]夏卉系列泳衣333款。参考少女的身材和体质，采用天然材质制成。追求今夏最领先的设计潮流。

description.en: Vulcan took out one piece of clothing after another from the bag, and Ceobe put them on one by one, but she ran away before Vulcan could take out the pants.
description.zh: 火神从包裹里拿出一件，刻俄柏就穿上一件，然而，当火神想再找条长裤给刻俄柏穿上的时候……她早就跑得没影啦！

dialog.en: 0011 Tempest Series New Release/Unfettered. A set of children's clothes, Columbian in origin. Vulcan's reward to Ceobe for being a good girl.
dialog.zh: 0011子品牌，飙系列新款/无拘无束。为了奖励近期十分听话的刻俄柏，火神托人从哥伦比亚弄来了一套最新潮流……童装？

description.en: Apparently Director Nian had a burst of inspiration. Not only has she come up with over a hundred designs for the doomsday kaiju, she is also filming a police-themed action flick with Chongyue as the lead, and shooting another movie just to help Jessica's self-esteem.
description.zh: 据说年导现在灵感大爆发，不仅给末日巨怪设计了一百多种造型，还在拍摄一部以重岳为主角的警察大片，另外也打算给杰西卡拍一部突破她自我形象的电影。

dialog.en: Collaborative Series/Thunderbolt Director. Clothes the prodigy director Nian wears on the job. Having analyzed countless classics, she channels the inspiration into her latest blockbuster: Unlimited Showdown in the Siege of Monster Doomsday.
dialog.zh: CFA合作服装/霹雳导演。优秀青年导演年在导戏时的穿着。年拉片了无数经典电影，准备把吸取到的灵感用到她的大片《无极玄战·巨怪末日围攻》里去。

description.en: It bugged her how these clothes didn't fit well, so she picked a few places to make a couple of tweaks herself.
description.zh: 她嫌这些衣服不合身，所以随便挑了件自己做修改。

dialog.en: 0011 New Arrivals/Unfettered Freedom. Handcrafted by Lungmen artisans, per the client's requests, twenty-four different designs of traditional women's clothing were drawn up, from which the client rolled dice to select one to ultimately be made into an outfit.
dialog.zh: 0011新款/乐逍遥。龙门手工匠制，根据客户要求设计了二十四种不同款式的女性传统服饰，最后客户掷骰子选了一种制作了成衣。

description.en: Jade ruminates quietly, while ink keeps its silence. The spring breeze whistles through the carved stone fence, while youth springs forth from the tip of her brush.
description.zh: 静玉有意，墨砚无言，春风又过雕栏，芳华自现笔端。

dialog.en: 0011 Custom Brand [Magnificence Curation] Series Collection/Hazy Jade. The painter of a thousand forms, wrapped in jade silk. The soul who sculpts ink into shape, entwined in kohl silk. The gauze stretches out before her, serving as her infinite canvas.
dialog.zh: 0011定制品牌[群瑰博辑]系列珍藏/青玉砚。玉色丝绸包裹绘制百态之身，素黛罗绮缠绕泼墨万物之魂。此刻，眼前轻纱延展供她尽情挥毫。

description.en: The distant mountains are as ink, each step leaving smoke. Falling ink becomes art, plain colors reflect the self.
description.zh: 远山如黛，移步生烟，落墨为画，素色当身。

dialog.en: 0011 New Release / Everything Is a Miracle. A silky and delicate satin surface, perfectly fitted to the wearer's body shape. Blue-green envelops the body, invoking an ancient charm. After completing the outfit's design, the client draws it into existence, ready-to-wear, with a stroke of the brush.
dialog.zh: 0011新款/染尘烟。缎面丝滑细腻，完美贴合身形，苍青缠身，古意盎然。当完成衣物设计图后，客户提笔挥毫直接画出了成衣。

description.en: Many view the unknown as a darkness to be feared, so they cry out for those who dare stand against and dispel it. That is why they call her name.
description.zh: 未知对许多人来说等同于黑暗与恐惧，所以人们呼唤敢于对抗并驱散它的人。她的名字正因此响起。

dialog.en: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Unstained, Unshaken. Outlined in sharp lines and painted in cold tones, revealing the wearer's pioneering, problem-smashing fearlessness in full color.
dialog.zh: 音律联觉特供款/黑白冷峻。以硬朗线条勾勒，用冷色调装点，将穿戴者敢当先锋、冲破迷惘的无畏意志展露无遗。

description.en: 'What's the matter, Boss? You don't seem as sharp as before. Since you didn't manage to finish me off, I suppose it's my turn now. Don't blink.'
description.zh: “怎么了老总？你比以前退步了。既然你这一下没能杀我，我就要还击了。别眨眼。”
