dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Stronghold. An outfit worn by Saria during the confrontation between the General Jurisdiction and the Research Branch. Though her surroundings crumbled under the onslaught of Arts colliding, her conviction never wavered, like the land itself.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/坚城。塞雷娅在总辖构件科与总辖对峙时的装束。周遭事物因法术相碰湮灭的余波陷入混乱，唯独她的意志似大地般永不动摇。

description.en: Submission is order. Order is justice.
description.zh: 服从即秩序，秩序即正义。

dialog.en: Test Collection Series/The Law. The jailer garments Saria used when entering Mansfield State Prison, largely in line with the female jailer's standard uniform.
dialog.zh: 忒斯特收藏系列/铁律。塞雷娅在进入曼斯菲尔德监狱时使用的狱警服，与女性狱警标准制服没有太大区别。

description.en: 'How many starry nights must the long wind blow, and how many springs and autumns must the snowmelt wash, before the wonders of blooming gravel are revealed?'
description.zh: “长风吹过几个星夜，雪水洗过几载春秋，才得见眼前傲然绽放，砾石无数的奇景呢？”

dialog.en: Brand Collaborative Series/Towering is Cliff of Nostalgia. Stylish and classic. The wind brushes the cliffs for a thousand years, a thousand li, brushing against the wanderer's robes, brushing into dream.
dialog.zh: 品牌合作服装/崖高梦远。造型设计十分时尚，布料纹理在细节上处处彰显古典风格。崖上的风吹过几千年，几万里，吹动旅人衣袍，吹入梦中。

description.en: A thousand years of wandering passed in a flash. All truths, all lies, all but a dream. Outside my tent, the wind howls as it ever has. My lord awakens, so I too awake.
description.zh: 千载长路不过须臾，万般虚实无非一梦。帐外风如旧，君醒我亦醒。

dialog.en: 0011 Custom Brand [Magnificence Curation] Series Collection/A Gallant Dream. Bestial pattern on robe of white, silver plate on black of gown, adorned with jade, an ensemble unfettered. The gongs of the border's night watch ring out, while Ling seeks the great Dao in woven dream.
dialog.zh: 0011定制品牌[群瑰博辑]系列珍藏/方遒卷。兽纹白襟，银甲玄袍，翠玉作为配饰，更显逍遥。边关的打更声里，令在自己织就的梦中寻得大道。

description.en: 'Who am I?' 'What am I?' 'Where do I go?' 'Thunder with no rain, bones to dust. The dreamer must wake, the calm be disturbed. Why ask?'
description.zh: “我是谁？”“我正何道？”“我法何物？”风雷阒起雨不喧，骷髅粉黛成莫逆，沽梦者醒，静心者乱，何苦问来？

dialog.en: 0011 New Arrivals/It Does Wash the Strings. Robe made from white cloth, with loose-fitting sleeves that reach to knee level. A lucky animal is weaved onto the skirt, inspired by a dream the client had.
dialog.zh: 0011新款/濯缨。素白布帛制成的羽衣，大袖及膝，裙裳上绣有某种瑞兽图案。据说设计灵感出自客户旧梦中的一段经历。

description.en: Having suddenly gone from stunt coordinator to leading man, Chongyue admits he's not too sure what to do right now, especially after seeing one younger sister sitting in the director's chair, and another on the set drinking from her flask.
description.zh: 从动作指导突然变成了男主演，重岳坦言自己确实感到无所适从，尤其在看到两个妹妹一个坐在导演的位子上，另一个在片场提着葫芦喝酒之后。

dialog.en: Collaborative Series/All-Round Actor. Clothes Chongyue wears when studying past roles. The characters are so different, so how should one breathe life into them? He browses both scripts and tapes, experiencing life after life after life.
dialog.zh: CFA合作服装/全能演员。重岳揣摩角色时的穿着。戏中人各不相同，怎么才算赋予戏中角色一段真实的生命？重岳翻看剧本和录像，体验一段又一段人生。

description.en: O lush wood, how long have you stood? O fluttering pale plumes, how far have you wandered? The seasons turn, and the white feathers return not. O barren tree, where could they perch?
description.zh: 郁郁苍木，何住久兮？依依白羽，何为远游？星霜几变，白羽不返。木叶摇落，何处可栖？

dialog.en: 0011 Custom Brand [Magnificence Curation] Series Collection/Alighting. Magnum opus of a Yumen craftsman, given to a traveler heading on a long journey. In the hope that men and might need no longer be a burden, that he can wander for myriad li with ease.
dialog.zh: 0011定制品牌[群瑰博辑]系列珍藏/何处栖。玉门匠人的得意之作，送给了一位将要远行的旅人。希望百兵武具不再是重担，希望他能游遍万里河山。

description.en: She was always the first to arrive. She always tidied everything up in silence. She was always the last to leave.
description.zh: 她总是第一个到。她总是默默收拾一切。她总是最后一个走。

dialog.en: 0011 New Arrivals/Spring Feast. Outfit Shu wore during a feast held by her family. A beauteous purple robe across her shoulders, a silken skirt along her legs. Here, a goddess lies, quietly watching the turning of the seasons.
dialog.zh: 0011新款/春日宴。黍与兄弟姐妹们举办宴会时的装扮。锦绣紫衫，轻纱罗裙，神女卧于此间，静看沧海桑田。

description.en: "When spring rain is scarce, water the fields; when summer rain is plentiful, open the channels." Shu still remembers the scene long ago when she and the people recorded this agricultural proverb in the scrolls together. Today, the paper from back then has yellowed, while the rice fields beneath her feet are lush and green.
description.zh: “春雨少，用水浇；夏雨多，开渠道。”黍还记得很久以前她和人们一同将这则农谚记录在书卷上的情景。如今，当年的纸张已经泛黄，而她脚下稻谷青青，浓绿一片。

dialog.en: National Library Collaboration Outfit/Longstanding Stream. The outfit Shu wore while working at the Tianshi Bureau. Ancient scrolls unfold before her, and wisdom passed down through generations emerges on paper, flowing ceaselessly forward just like the long river under her feet.
dialog.zh: 国家图书馆合作服装/源远流长。黍在天师府工作时穿着的服装。古卷在她的面前展开，代代相传的智慧浮现纸上，一如脚下长河奔流不息，一径向前。

description.en: You need to get to the market as early as possible to pick the best ingredients. Though what he sees in the early morn are things he has seen a hundred times before, he can almost already hear his brothers and sisters rejoicing in their reunion.
description.zh: 集市就是要赶早才能选到最好的食材，此刻他眼前虽然还是清晨的寻常百景，兄弟姐妹们团聚的欢声却似已在耳边。

dialog.en: 0011 New Arrivals/Clear Morning View. Clothes Yu wears when getting ingredients for the reunion dinner. The gold-embroidered top under his cyan jacket billows in the wind. Amidst verdant green, the young man begins his return to his dream of a family gathering.
dialog.zh: 0011新款/愿清晓。余外出为团圆宴会准备食材时的装扮。青色外衫下绣着金纹的衣摆在和风中飘舞，一片新绿里少年怀抱欢聚的愿景踏上归途。

description.en: Silk flows with the water, and the Kuranta walks with the wind.
description.zh: 绸缎随水漂荡，库兰塔与风同行。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Shining Dew Series SD05. Tight-fitting, breathable, lightweight, and designed for the summer.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]灿阳朝露系列泳衣05款。贴身、透气、轻便，专为夏日而生。

description.en: 'Terra will be witness to Kjerag's precipitous rise.'
description.zh: “泰拉将见证谢拉格的崛起。”

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Forerunner. Following the Vine-Bead Court's final meeting of the Tri-Clan Council, Gnosis formally assumed the post of inaugural Speaker of the Parliament of Kjerag by SilverAsh's recommendation.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/先驱。蔓珠院最后一届三族议会后，在银灰的举荐下，灵知正式就任谢拉格议会第一任议长。

description.en: A blast from the middle school past.
description.zh: 来自中学时代的留言。

dialog.en: A uniform from Victoria's Wessex Middle School, adapted by traditional Victorian designers. Centuries of rich heritage combines with excellent craftsmanship to make a light and comfortable outfit.
dialog.zh: 来自维多利亚威塞克斯中学。由维多利亚传统设计师个性化定制，威塞克斯学生装。采用百年传承手艺，做工精良，轻便舒适。

description.en: As she jumps out the window and faces the sun, she can't help but believe that her future will be as bright as it is today.
description.zh: 跃出窗台，面向阳光，她情不自禁地相信，自己的未来都将如今日一般晴朗。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Sunny Day. Cardigan's outfit when she had just arrived at a city in southern Leithanien. Skillfully tailored to fit a young girl's stature. Light, airy, and blooming with vitality.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/晴日。卡缇刚到莱塔尼亚南部城市时的装扮。依照少女身材设计，裁剪得体。轻盈灵动，绽放盎然活力。

description.en: When happiness blocks the door.
description.zh: 当幸福堵住门。

dialog.en: Cardigan's Winter Wear/Cheerful Guardian. Lightweight, comfortable, full of wintry motifs, but not cold-resistant at all. Cardigan is a bit afraid of the cold, but in front of a bag of gifts and her favorite sled, the temperature stops seeming so important.
dialog.zh: 卡缇的冬日穿搭/快乐卫士。轻便舒适，充满冬季元素，但完全不防寒。卡缇是有点怕冷，不过在满满一袋礼物和心爱的雪橇面前，温度高低已经不重要了。

description.en: Prior to his reunion with his teammates, Steward mingled with businesspeople of all nations, carefully weighing the benefits each of them could bring Kjerag.
description.zh: 和队友重新聚首前，史都华德游走在各国商人间，仔细斟酌他们能够为谢拉格带来的利益。

dialog.en: Test Collection Series/Snowstorm Invitation. An outfit tailor-made by Karlan Trade for their affiliated business negotiators. First impressions are of the utmost importance in trade talks. Steward knows this well, and has never failed to live up to expectations.
dialog.zh: 忒斯特收藏系列/风雪邀请。喀兰贸易为旗下商业谈判人员量身定制的衣物，商业洽谈时第一印象很重要，史都华德深知这一点，并从未辜负期待。

description.en: Before reuniting with his teammates, he took up the duties of a Legatus, traveling among the nations of Terra.
description.zh: 和队友重新聚首前，他领了份万国信使的差事，往返于泰拉诸国之间。

dialog.en: Test Collection Series/Traceless Walker. Custom-made by the Lateran Curia for certain Legati. Sankta who get custom outfits all share a common feature: there is something unusual about their halos.
dialog.zh: 忒斯特收藏系列/无痕行者。拉特兰教皇厅为部分万国信使量身定制的衣物，获得定制衣物的萨科塔都有一个共同特征，他们头顶的光环皆存在一定偏差。

description.en: 'If nocturnality is a racial trait, couldn't you at least provide coffee at night for other Cautus operators? No? But you drink it every night!'
description.zh: “既然你说夜间活动是种族特性，那可不可以至少为卡特斯干员提供晚间咖啡？……不行吗？但是你自己每天晚上都会喝欸！”

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Nighttime Café. Always meticulous, Ansel likes to be properly dressed at the café as well. He steadfastly refuses to sell coffee at night, however.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/晚间咖啡店。做事永远井井有条的安赛尔，经营食堂咖啡店时的穿着也一丝不苟。不过，安赛尔坚决拒绝在晚上向任何干员出售咖啡。

description.en: Where should I set my next beach stronghold?
description.zh: 接下来去哪里安置好沙滩据点呢？

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HDm06 for men. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation. Critically acclaimed outfit for men, on sale now.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]悠然假日系列泳衣06男款。舒适放松，透气轻盈。让您可以在闲适的环境中享受最完美的沙滩体验。男款大受好评发售中。

description.en: 'Close your eyes. Imagine you have arrived at the end of time. There is nobody there. Only the sun, the moons, and the instruments. Then, you hear music, and you cannot help but open your eyes. Welcome to the concert, just for you.'
description.zh: “闭上眼。想象你来到了时间的尽头，那里空无一人，只有太阳、月亮和乐器。然后，你听到了音乐声，你忍不住睁开眼——欢迎来到属于你的音乐会。”

dialog.en: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Ethereal Harmony. Stage clothing picked by conductor Mostima herself. A mysterious blue serves as the main hue, a blue of grace and beauty, a fitting accompaniment to the stage she built.
dialog.zh: 音律联觉特供款/幻语乐痕。指挥家莫斯提马自己选配的演出服。以神秘的蓝色为主色调，优雅而美丽，与她为自己搭建的舞台相得益彰。

description.en: Beneath the gaze of justice, evil tumbles into the abyss.
description.zh: 正义之下，恶者堕深渊。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Spellbreaker. A Laterano dress with corresponding weapons. Generally, only Sankta who have presided over the ceremonies are allowed to wear it, and Mostima seems to have quietly snuck out with this outfit.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/除魅。拉特兰礼服，配有与之相应的武器。一般只允许主持仪式的萨科塔穿着，这一套似乎是莫斯提马悄悄带出来的。

description.en: 'My little friends, you're in charge of setting up the background tonight. For each paper cutout placed crooked, I'm taking one piece of candy out of your present!'
description.zh: “小家伙们，今晚的背景布置就靠你们咯。剪纸如果贴歪的话，礼物里就会少一颗糖哦！”

dialog.en: Kafka's holiday work attire / Cardboard Fairy. A smorgasbord of different elements and styles, featuring a red undergarment that contrasts with the green jacket. Kafka's fashion sense is as bold as her découpage.
dialog.zh: 卡夫卡的节日工作服/纸板仙子。元素多样、风格混搭，配色上采用对比鲜明的红色内搭和绿色外套，卡夫卡的着装风格如同她的剪纸风格一样大胆。

description.en: The stinger of Sargon reflects no moonlight. Wrapped in darkness, she only shows herself only when the outcome is no longer in doubt.
description.zh: 萨尔贡的尖刺在月光照耀下也不会反射出任何光芒，将自己包裹在重重黑暗中。若是它出现在人前，说明结果已定。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Under A Veil. Manticore once wore it on a mission in Sargon, and was bothered by the clanging of the gold accessories as she moved.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE子品牌 [昔时/Passe]系列精选款/面纱之下。狮蝎在萨尔贡时曾身着此衣执行任务。缀在身上的金饰总会因行走而响动，让她非常烦恼。

description.en: With a light touch of her tail, courage, fear, and shyness become things of the past, along with life itself.
description.zh: 尾尖轻轻一点，果敢、恐惧、羞涩连同生命化为往事。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Invisible Dirge. Taking the model's peculiar traits in consideration, this outfit was completed without being tailored. Combines comfort, fashion, and a proper fit while also protecting the operator's vitals.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/无形悼挽。考虑到客户特殊性在未经量体裁剪情况下完成整衣制作。时尚、舒适、贴合身形，并为干员重要器官添加进攻性保护配件。

description.en: Mercenaries roam the city, their backs to the night and the people they wish to protect.
description.zh: 佣兵在城市游荡，背靠着夜色和想要保护的人。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Line [Passe] Series Selects/Silent Arrow. An Iberian classic, enhanced with the customer's own artistic touches. Andreana particularly appreciates this outfit's moisture resistance.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE子品牌 [昔时/Passe]系列精选款/暗矢。伊比利亚经典款式，加入了顾客自己的设计改造。安哲拉尤其偏爱这件衣服的防潮性。

description.en: Is this her first time letting down her guard and relaxing so leisurely? Just look at her smile in the cool breeze under the stars and moon, and the answer becomes self-evident.
description.zh: 这是她第一次放松警惕如此悠闲吗？看看星月下凉风中她露出的笑容，答案就不言自明了。

dialog.en: Coral Coast/Summer Flowers Series Swimsuit Model 240 by MARTHE. Tailored to a young woman's figure and build, made with natural materials. Pursuing this summer's top design trends.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]夏卉系列泳衣240款。参考少女的身材和体质，采用天然材质制成。追求今夏最领先的设计潮流。

description.en: She blends in with the rubble and the smoke.
description.zh: 她与废墟和硝烟融为一体。

dialog.en: Pioneer Series/Graphite. Raythean Industrial's new product line is based upon standard-issue battlesuits, utilizing new materials and a weatherproof design suitable for harsh environments.
dialog.zh: 开拓者系列/石墨。雷神工业出品，以常规战斗服设计为蓝本，采用了全新材料以及更为密封式的方案，强化了对严苛环境的适应性。

description.en: The happy days will pass away, but the memories will firmly remain within your mind, accompanying you through all kinds of dangers.
description.zh: 快乐的日子一转而逝，但回忆却会牢牢刻在脑海中，陪伴你渡过千难万险。

dialog.en: EPOQUE New Series/Miraculous Moment. Casual clothes that capture the region's impressions while taking the customer's preferences in consideration. After a deep dive into the customer's life, the designer collaborated with the customer to add a variety of supporting accessories.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/美妙时光。结合地方印象与顾客喜好制作的便服，贴身舒适。在深入了解顾客的生活后，设计师与顾客共同制作了许多配套物件。

description.en: The young lady always seems to be staring off in a daze these days. Not because she's surrounded by unfamiliar people, but rather she's secretly worried that she put on her uniform in the wrong order.
description.zh: 姑娘这天看起来有些发懵，并不是因为周围的人陌生，而是因为她一直在偷偷烦恼自己着装的顺序有没有出毛病。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Royal Guardswoman. Bagpipe's uniform as a new cadet at the military academy, doubling as formal wear. Training in formal wear was yet another duty of a royal guardsman cadet.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE子品牌 [昔时/Passe]系列精选款/皇家近卫。风笛于军校初出茅庐时的制服，算作常礼服。以礼服作训也是皇家近卫学员的一项职责。

description.en: The life Bagpipe dreams of is simple. After a productive day of farmwork, she picks up the satisfaction of a hard day's work and her hopes for a bumper crop before walking home under the setting sun, accompanied by the distant sound of bagpipes. It will come true. She believes it with all her heart.
description.zh: 风笛梦想的生活很简单。努力完成农活之后，带着工作的充实感和对丰收的期望，在夕阳下，伴着远处的风笛声踏上回家的小路。会实现的，她相信。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Echo of Bagpipes. Clothes Bagpipe wears when she heads home. No need for any fancy accessories. A simple dress and a bright smile are enough to charm even the critters frolicking by her side.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/风笛声声。风笛回到家乡时的装扮。不需要过多的点缀，朴素的连衣裙和干净的笑容，连田间的小兽也被她吸引，在她身边流连。

description.en: But the racers were scared of Bagpipe, because on the off-chance of a crash, they'd be the only ones injured. Luckily, that was another reason the organizers asked her to be the flag-bearer.
description.zh: 然而赛车手们害怕风笛，因为万一出车祸，受伤的只会是自己，而这，恰好是主办方请她当旗手的另一个理由。

dialog.en: Whistlewind Series Race Queen Core Line/Queen, No.1. In full race queen form, sporting a Raythean-sponsored Piledriver Spear, Bagpipe carries herself tall and brings the spectators' cheers non-stop.
dialog.zh: 啸风系列赛车皇后基础款/皇后一号。穿着赛车皇后款式，配以雷神赞助破城矛，英姿飒爽的风笛，使观众们欢呼不断。因此，主办方安排风笛担任旗手。

description.en: Medicine's a useful tool. How do you wanna use it?
description.zh: 医术是件好用的工具，你想怎么使用它？

dialog.en: 0011 New Arrivals/Doctor of Faces. Handcrafted by Lungmen artisans, with a design concept more inclined towards the East, its main appeal is to highlight the wearer's personality. Onlookers can sense the simplicities and trends of Lungmen.
dialog.zh: 0011新款/百面郎中。龙门手工匠制，设计理念更偏向东方，以突出着衣者气质为主要诉求。能让人感受到龙门的古朴与潮流。

description.en: Practicing medicine is like spraying pesticide. It can uproot disease, or it can snuff out life. Life or death begins with the formula, ends with the dosage, and depends entirely on intent.
description.zh: 行医如施药，可除病根，可夺性命。是生是死，起于配方，止于剂量，存乎一念。

dialog.en: 0011 New Arrivals/Healing Hand, Evil Heart. Handmade in Lungmen, the outfit includes multiple pieces of clothing that can be mixed and matched based on the customer's mood. The details in the outfit have been adjusted according to his needs, and includes an old-fashioned medicine box.
dialog.zh: 0011新款/妙手玄心。龙门手工匠制，全套包含多件衣物，既为整体，也可依顾客心情自由搭配。已根据需求调整衣物细节，并附赠复古药箱一个。

description.en: 'Ordinary' is a unique kind of quality. When the time comes calling, do abandon it.
description.zh: “平凡”是一种独特的品质，请在必要的时候，舍弃它。

dialog.en: 0011 New Arrivals/Just A Driver. Handcrafted by Lungmen artisans, with a design concept more inclined towards the West, its main appeal being to create a balanced sense of uniform. Many fasteners adorn the outfit, reserving space for the client to personalize, mix and match.
dialog.zh: 0011新款/一介车夫。龙门手工匠制，设计理念更偏向西方，以创造整齐划一的制服感为主要诉求。服装上有多个搭扣，为客户的个性化搭配预留了空间。

description.en: 'Team, get in contact with Amiya and the Doctor—I've found it! We've finally found it!'
description.zh: “作战小队，转告阿米娅和博士——我找到了，我们终于找到了！”

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/300 Metres Underground. Savage raises her lantern, her suit billowing in the abyss. Deeper in the darkness, graviton accelerators link in a loop, twinkling in unison. They have noticed her arrival.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/地底三百米。暴行举起提灯，防护服被深渊的气浪翻动。在更远处的黑暗中，引力子加速器缀连成环，整齐地闪烁着。他们已注意到她的来访。

description.en: 'Alright, now I'm going to make the frosting! Everyone close your eyes—this is my mom's secret recipe. Doctor, I saw you sneaking a peek just now!'
description.zh: “好了，这样接下来我要制作糖霜了！所有人闭上眼睛，这可是我老妈传下来的秘密配方——博士，我看到你刚才悄悄睁眼了哦。”

dialog.en: Rhodes Kitchen Collection/Secret Family Recipe. Savage wore this when making carrot cakes. The hand-knitted sleeves and an apron paired with a cool, breathable inner layer make it feel relaxing and distinctive.
dialog.zh: 罗德厨房系列/家传秘方。暴行制作胡萝卜蛋糕时的穿着，手工编织的袖套和围裙配合清凉透气的内搭，闲散惬意之余也不失个性。

description.en: Her only wish is to keep walking with you and Amiya. This year, next year, and every year after that.
description.zh: 她惟愿与你和阿米娅继续走下去，这一年、下一年、每一年。

dialog.en: Test Collection Series/Yet Another Autumn. The autumn sun shines gently, its light falling with the ginkgo leaves onto her white dress. Charlotte looks up from under her wide-brimmed hat, feeling the wind's whisper with her fingers.
dialog.zh: 忒斯特收藏系列/又一年秋季。秋天的阳光温柔地洒下，与银杏叶一起，落在她的白礼裙上。夏洛特从宽檐帽下抬起头，伸手触碰这宁静秋日的风。

description.en: I'd like to try an Eastern-style outfit every now and then.
description.zh: 偶尔尝试的东方服饰。

dialog.en: 0011 New Arrivals/Clivia. Handmade by Lungmen craftsman, this stylish outfit combines comfortable materials with cutting-edge tech and traditional handicraft. Get this spring special while it's still available!
dialog.zh: 0011™新款/君子兰。龙门匠制，尖端科技和传统工艺的完美结合。新春限定款，珍稀品。

description.en: For those who prioritize their safety.
description.zh: 选择这套装备的理由是“看起来非常安全。”

dialog.en: Pioneer Series/Iron Block. An extremely durable product designed by Raythean Industrial, made for the harshest of environments. With the perfect combination of advanced technology and rare materials, it provides the best protection that money can buy.
dialog.zh: 开拓者系列/铁块。雷神工业出品，为极端严苛环境设计，先端技术与稀有材料的完美结合。以牺牲便捷性为代价，拥有极高的防护能力。

description.en: Missions can give you a hard time. Hang in there.
description.zh: 任务很艰难，咬咬牙坚持下去。

dialog.en: Vitafield [Rewilder] Series Classics/Ash. Made with special materials and designed to be functional, perfect for coping with various needs and weathering even the roughest outdoor conditions.
dialog.zh: 生命之地™️[识荒者/Rewilder]系列经典款/燃灰。采用特别材质制作，包含各项功能性设计，足以应对多种自然环境变化，满足各类需求。

description.en: Looks surprisingly well-behaved, and is so— at least until she finishes her ice cream cone.
description.zh: 看上去很乖巧，实际上也很乖巧——直到吃完手上的甜筒。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA008. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]夏卉系列泳衣008款。参考少女的身材和体质，采用天然材质制成。追求今夏最领先的设计潮流。

description.en: Phew... Someone is knocking.
description.zh: 嘘……有人在敲门！

dialog.en: Witch Feast Series/Imp's House. A custom-made outfit for Rope that takes the young woman's activities and body shape into account. It utilizes lightweight and breathable materials, simple while not sacrificing elegance.
dialog.zh: 罗德岛送给暗索的狂欢礼物/小鬼当家。参考年轻女性体型设计，考虑到本人的日常行动，采用轻薄和透气性好的布料，简约而不失美感。

description.en: As long as they're in the studio, every knight ought to be an excellent model.
description.zh: 只要在影棚里，每位骑士都应是优秀的模特。

dialog.en: Cambrian 1097 Winter New Arrivals/Modeling Night. Tailored Kazimierzian apparel, slim-fit, highly accessorized, accompanied by a cloak in a complementary shade, sure to draw the eyes of every onlooker.
dialog.zh: 寒武纪1097冬季新款/模特之夜。卡西米尔特供服饰，修身塑形，多款佩饰，辅以与主衣异色的披风，定能吸引所有观众的目光。

description.en: Thanks to the rule stating 'pets of the same species can tag out with one another', she became the arena's top contestant.
description.zh: 在“同种宠物可接力上场”的规则下，她成了本场活动的热门选手。

dialog.en: Achievement Star Collection/The Zoophilist and Her Mollusca. At the game expo, Vanilla dressed up as her 'Destiny Quest' character. The beast fight demo will be broadcast live, and the slugs in her pet cage are ready for their debut.
dialog.zh: 成就之星系列/平原驯虫士。电玩展上，香草特意装扮成了自己在《命运追索》中创建的角色。斗兽试玩活动将全程直播，她宠物栏里的源石虫们已整装待发。

description.en: Incidentally, the title of the movie is 'Divine Palm of the Phantom Godfist - Decisive Battle II'.
description.zh: 顺带一提，电影名是《神鬼玄奇之异人神掌-决战巅峰2》。

dialog.en: MARTHE Sports Line. A limited-edition outfit commemorating FEater's 3rd Anniversary of setting the box office record. Lightweight, breathable, and comfortably-fitting. However, anyone who knows FEater also knows that she has never worn this outfit properly.
dialog.zh: MARTHE运动系列，食铁兽票房巅峰作上映3周年纪念之龙门限定款。轻巧透气，贴合身型，但了解她的人都知道食铁兽从来没有好好穿过这套衣服。

description.en: FEater wanted so much for the producers to add food scenes and chopstick fights to every film. Unfortunately, even though the audience loves this idea, the directors don't.
description.zh: 食铁兽多么希望制片人在每部片子里都加场美食戏和筷子打戏，可惜观众喜欢，导演们却嫌烦。

dialog.en: 0011 New Release / Gourmet. FEater's outfit from a bestselling Lungmen foodie film. Incorporates a sporty inner layer and a traditional knotted jacked, once all the rage.
dialog.zh: 0011新款/且试箸。食铁兽在龙门畅销动作美食电影中的戏服，选用了便于运动的内搭与传统韵味十足的结扣外套，曾是一时的风尚。

description.en: The investigator desires to illuminate the castle's mysteries—
description.zh: 调查员想要洞察古堡的谜团——

dialog.en: Multimedia Escape Experience 'Dreambind Castle' Visitor's Prepared Outfit/Visionblazer in the Courtyard. The outfit Mayer wore for the code-cracking event 'Courtyard Tidings.' Mayer loved all the puzzles her coworkers designed, and took to making short work of them.
dialog.zh: 多媒体密室“缠梦古堡”游客专用服饰/庭院寻梦尖兵。梅尔游玩解密项目“庭院惊喜”时所穿的服饰。梅尔十分享受同事们布设的谜题，她马上就能解开了。

description.en: When you work at Old Lee's office, you have to know a little of everything.
description.zh: 老鲤对员工的个人能力没什么硬性规定，但在事务所工作，总得什么都会一些。

dialog.en: 0011 Tempest Series New Release/Wild Flower of Street. A custom Lungmen-style outfit, tight-fitting attire made entirely from aged leather. Rugged and good-looking at the same time.
dialog.zh: 0011子品牌，飙系列新款/街道狂花。龙门定制服装，全套皮革材质，并以特殊工艺做旧处理，贴合身材，防风耐磨的同时兼具观赏性。

description.en: She sees a Laterano: open, harmonized, mutualistic. Amidst the unending flow of emotion, people no longer close off their hearts. Mutual achievement, mutual comfort. Each their own self, her included.
description.zh: 她见到了一个拉特兰，开放、共享、互助。在几无边际的感性中，人们不再压抑内心，互相成就，互相抚慰，人人皆本我，她也不例外。

dialog.en: Test Collection Series/Diversity Oneness. A possibility derived from when Virtuosa connected to the Law: emotions link together the hearts of all. The performer who once plucked at their heartstrings is now no more than a voice in the chorus.
dialog.zh: 忒斯特收藏系列/无我唯识。塑心连接律法时所推演出的可能：通连的情感充盈于众人心中，曾经撩拨心弦的乐手，此刻也只是大合唱中的一个音节。

description.en: After replacing manual labor with technology, Magallan discovered a new side to frosty confection-making.
description.zh: 以科技替代人工后，麦哲伦发现了消暑甜点的新维度。

dialog.en: Rhodes Kitchen Collection/Shaved-Ice Memories. The work outfit worn by Magallan to make shaved ice during the food festival combines traditions of Higashi with characteristics of Rhine Labs. Breathable, well-insulated, and easy to move in, this outfit allows Magallan to fully devote herself to her work, even if in a shaved-ice shop.
dialog.zh: 罗德厨房系列/回味冰霜雪。麦哲伦在制作美食节刨冰时的工服，兼备东国传统与莱茵特色。透气、保温、便于行动，能让麦哲伦全心投入刨冰屋运营。

description.en: It is as if time stands still here. A golden hall, a golden dream—and in the time it takes you to think this, an elf walks out from under the archway, gracing you with a smile. At that instant, time resumes its flow.
description.zh: 时间仿佛在这里静止，一座金色的大厅，一个金色的梦——就在你这么想的时候，精灵从拱门中走出，优雅地向你微笑。这一瞬间，时间重新开始流动。

dialog.en: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Golden Reverie. Dress carefully picked by Muelsyse. The top is bright and brazen, like the early dawnlight, and the skirt is soft and sable, like the moons playing across a still lake—a perfect union of luxury and solemnity.
dialog.zh: 音律联觉特供款/漫步于黄金之梦。缪尔赛思精心挑选的礼服。上身明亮热烈，犹如清晨的阳光，下身柔暗幽静，恰似月下的湖面。奢华与庄严的完美结合。

description.en: 'But It has still left some memories behind for us. Are they mementos, or lamentations? I don't know...'
description.zh: “但祂还是留下了一些回忆给我们。那是纪念吗，是哀叹吗……我不知道……”

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Young Branch. Water melts glacier on its way back to the soil, while wandering leaves revisit the woods. Her origins in eternal sleep, her answers long departed. But where are they now?
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/新枝。归壤的水融开冰川，飘游的叶重访林地。可血脉之源已陷入永恒的沉睡，答案早已远去，当下又在何方？

description.en: 'Pristine dreamscapes twine over the tangible in symbiosis, their fear and dread a permeation just begun. You outsiders, honored to take them on, are the first to do so—that live.'
description.zh: “清晰的梦境跨过现实与之共生，开始播散恐慌与畏惧。外来者只是第一个有幸承受它的——活物。”

dialog.en: Clothes of Phantom's, the attire he sported while staffing the 'Dreambind Castle' event. The dance as cloth, the song as silk, the threading through emotion, the tailoring by fabrication, the weave of obliteration and howling madness, it all culminates in this majestic yet skin-crawling ensemble.
dialog.zh: 傀影的衣服，参加“缠梦古堡”项目时穿着它当工作人员。舞蹈为布，歌声为丝，借情感穿线，用臆想裁剪，以毁灭与癫狂编织，成就这件优雅而渗人的衣物。

description.en: Phantom's life is a play, but the members of the Troupe have no right to concern themselves with how it unfolds.
description.zh: 傀影的生活是一出戏，但如何演绎，剧团成员们已无权过问。

dialog.en: Test Collection Series/Focus. The attire Phantom wore when he left for the castle, and the costume of his maiden performance. After an age of gathering dust, it finally sees the light of day again.
dialog.zh: 忒斯特收藏系列/焦点。傀影前往古堡时的装束，同时也是他的首演戏服，在蒙尘许久之后，终于重见天日。

description.en: Do you require help, Madam?
description.zh: 女士，需要帮忙吗？

dialog.en: Cambrian 1097 Winter New Arrivals/Soft Wool. Cozy and warm standard line winter garments. With personalized coordination, you can attain your perfect balance of fashion and everyday use.
dialog.zh: 寒武纪1097冬季新款/软绒。舒适温暖的标准款冬季服饰，在经过个性化搭配后，可以达到追求时尚与日常使用的平衡。

description.en: Tie up your laces, put on your hat, and follow your pup partner close to enjoy all that life has to offer, together.
description.zh: 系好鞋带，按住帽檐，与紧紧跟随自己的幼兽伙伴同享生活的冷暖。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/My Fellow Newsboy. Outfit Greyy wears when delivering newspapers. Durable jacket, sturdy boots, and checkered scarf mean he has no need to fear wind nor rain while making his way through the plazas and alleys.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/都会送报员。格雷伊派送报刊时的着装。耐磨外衣配上厚实靴子，再裹一条格子围巾，就足以让他在穿越广场与小巷时无惧风雨。

description.en: Joy lies in absorptions, craft, and smiles and wonder on others' faces.
description.zh: 喜悦在于钻研、制作、还有他人脸上的惊奇与笑容。

dialog.en: EPOQUE New Arrivals/Eggcellent Craftsman. Greyy made an exquisite eight-tone musical egg as a present for his close friends, and in exchange, they custom-ordered him this outfit brimming with holiday atmosphere.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/八音蛋匠人。格雷伊制作了一个精巧的八音蛋送给好友，而作为回赠，他们为他订制了这件充满节日氛围的服饰。

description.en: Shamare has to give commands to the other actors to protect the treasure of the Horrorlair from pilferage. She may be the only actor here really playing herself.
description.zh: 为了保护魔城，巫恋需要给其他扮演者发布指令，保证财宝不被染指。她可能是所有扮演者中唯一本色出演的干员了。

dialog.en: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Horrorlair's Enigma' Custom Line/Echo of the Horrorlair. The actor plays the role of the Horrorlair's incarnation, patrolling its corridors and keeping it safe from the patronage of thieves.
dialog.zh: 巫异盛宴角色扮演剧本“魔城密令” 定制服饰/魔城回响。扮演者将是魔城的化身。徘徊于廊道间，管理并保护城中各项财产免遭窃贼光顾。

description.en: Cranes the image of grace, clouds the image of gentleness. Here, a moon embroidered in red shines, a place where quarrels should be left behind.
description.zh: 鹤姿何翩翩，云影亦徐徐。红绣月明处，是非皆不语。

dialog.en: 0011 Yun Series New Arrivals/Celestial Crane. Outfit made from high-quality Yanese brocade, accompanied with a long ribbon of gauze. At Shamare's request, the remaining fabric was used to make a new look for Morte as well.
dialog.zh: 0011子品牌，韵系列新款/绣云鹤。以上等炎国锦缎为材设计而成的衣装，配有薄纱长飘带。应巫恋要求，用裁剪之后的剩余料子为小莫提也换上了新装。

description.en: Cultivating flora, dressing herself, living a fine life; there's still a lot Podenco has to learn after she wakes up.
description.zh: 花卉栽培、穿着打扮、精致生活，波登可睡醒后要学的还有很多。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Wake Up From a Nap. Home leisure style, selected for Podenco by Lena. Similar colors to Podenco's original clothing, but with a complete change of style.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/小憩初醒。居家休闲款，莱娜为波登可选配的服装，和波登可原本的着装在颜色上相近，但风格截然不同。

description.en: There are loads and loads of soft, squishy plush toys, along with a piece of delicious cream layer cake!
description.zh: 松松软软的不止布偶娃娃，还有这块可口的夹心奶油蛋糕！

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Plush Cake. On her off days, Dur-nar changes out of her well-worn battlefield clothes to try something a little more fun. She's well versed in balancing work and play, and an expert in enjoying life.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/绒布蛋糕。闲暇时，坚雷一改往日干练的战场着装风格，尝试起活泼俏皮的装束。她深谙劳逸结合、享受生活之道。

description.en: Words scatter into the air, sticking by the leaves and landing in her glass. After Reed gathers them all up, only then can she put them together throughout the days and the nights.
description.zh: 词句弥散在空气中，附着在叶片上，沉落在果汁里，苇草把它们收集起来后，才有可能在昼夜交替中将之编排起来。

dialog.en: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Emerald Holiday. Reed's plain outfit during downtime. Lyrics have limits, and manuscripts have deadlines, but all that's still far, far away. They're no worry; in the comfort of the afternoon sun, finishing your glass of juice comes first.
dialog.zh: 音律联觉特供款/翡翠假日。苇草闲暇时穿的便衣。谱词有限制，稿件有截止日，但它们都还很远，比起这些，在午后暖阳下惬意喝完这杯蔬果汁，更重要。

description.en: The day's work is done, and it's time to buy some snacks from the street-side shops for a comfortable afternoon at home. The snacks available now are different than before, but the people enjoying them still are the same.
description.zh: 一天的力气活到此为止，去街上的商店买些零食饮料，便能在家里舒舒服服待一整个下午。如今，食物虽有变化，享受的人倒是同以前一样悠闲。

dialog.en: MARTHE Sports Line New Arrivals/The Next Afternoon Tea. Tailored to fit snugly from lightweight hydrophobic fabric, ensuring the wearer is unhindered in water. Made to measure for Ægir residing on the land.
dialog.zh: MARTHE运动系列新款/下一顿午茶。裁剪贴身，且使用疏水布料，入水后轻薄无阻，为久居陆地的阿戈尔量身打造。

description.en: The hunters of the sea still do not understand why they need to don the strange attire of landlubbers.
description.zh: 生于海中的猎人至今都不明白，为什么自己需要与陆地上的人一样穿着这奇怪的衣服。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Waverider Series WR04. This swimsuit tailor-made for Ægir beachgoers allows inhabitants of the sea to look dazzling on the sand.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]驭浪系列泳衣04款。为阿戈尔人贴心订做的泳衣款式，让海中精灵在沙滩上也能光彩夺目。

description.en: 'I apply to withdraw from Rhodes Island. You've helped me plenty enough, and I will not implicate you all in what I am to do next.'
description.zh: “我申请退出罗德岛。你们帮了我够多，我接下来要做的事，不牵连到你们。”

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Dark Cloud. Mountain's attire at his parents' funeral. Though he personally slew his own enemy, there is no hint of joy in his heart. There are still things he needs to do.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/乌云。山在父母葬礼上的装束。即使手刃仇敌，他的心中也没有丝毫喜悦，他还有要做的事。

description.en: Status and wealth can be whisked away overnight, but the thick coverage brought by knowledge lets him stride firmly towards the future.
description.zh: 身份和财富的变故只在一夕，但学识带来的厚度会让他坚定地迈向未来。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Book Reader. Traditional Victorian textiles and tailoring, every cut made by the hands of craftsmen, its custom-made monochrome cloth premium without being conspicuous.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/读者。维多利亚传统制衣工艺，每一处裁剪均出自匠人之手，纯色的定制面料高级而不高调。

description.en: Though the resting rider appears calm and composed, once he puts on his helmet, the roar of the engine and soul will be etched into the quiet night.
description.zh: 暂歇的骑手虽然看起来波澜不惊，但等他戴上头盔，宁静的夜里就将刻下引擎与灵魂的轰鸣声。

dialog.en: MARTHE Sportswear Series New Arrival/Hardcore Speed. A riding suit specially designed for competitive motorcycle racers, featuring windproof fabric and reinforced joint padding to ensure top-tier safety protection while maintaining comfort.
dialog.zh: MARTHE运动系列新款/硬派速度。专为竞技摩托赛手设计的骑行服，采用防风面料，并在关节处进行加固处理，在保证舒适的同时提供顶级安全防护。

description.en: A desperate blow brought her riches and glory, but also a lifelong illness.
description.zh: 绝境一击为她带来了莫大的财富与荣誉，也留下了伴随终身的病痛。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Line [Passe] Series Selects/Glory Purple. Zofia's attire when she participated in the Kazimierz Major awards ceremony. The right choice of attire made her the center of attention during the ceremony.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE子品牌 [昔时/Passe]系列精选款/荣耀之紫。佐菲娅参加特锦赛颁奖典礼时的服饰，恰到好处的打扮让她成为了典礼无可争议的焦点。

description.en: The film has ended, and the night has just begun. The lingering fragrance on his fingertips discloses a most dangerous signal, but it is clear that he has left no room to refuse.
description.zh: 影片结束，而夜晚才刚刚开始。指尖的余香透露出危险的讯号，但显然，他没有留下拒绝的余地。

dialog.en: Unveiling of Devotion Series New Arrivals/Dangerous Invitation. A graceful custom-made suit just for Arene. The stiff material is painstakingly cut to fit his youthful figure. He also personally selected the accompanying perfume.
dialog.zh: 待予花冠系列新款/危险邀约。芳汀私人定制的优雅礼服，面料挺括，裁剪细致，贴合少年身形。所搭配的香水同样由芳汀亲自挑选。

description.en: Should ego not be manifest, it will vanish unto the masses.
description.zh: 自我若不彰显，便会泯然众人。

dialog.en: Cambrian 1097 Winter New Arrivals/Casual. Rainproof, wear-resistant, close-fitting yet breathing, the first choice for fashionable youth. Coloring of the lining and some accessories can be changed at the client's request, letting their no-imitation individuality pop.
dialog.zh: 寒武纪1097冬季新款/随性。防雨、耐磨、贴身透气，时尚青年的首选款式。内衬与部分配件可以按顾客要求替换色彩，以突显独一无二的个人气质。

description.en: The lifeguard's a new hire, and he specializes in cutting the sea plant tangling drowning tourists' ankles.
description.zh: 新上岗的救生员，特别擅长切断缠住溺水游客脚踝的水草。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Beach Guard Series GT002. Made with materials that are both durable and comfortable, this outfit ensures high performance in a variety of different conditions.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]沙滩护卫系列泳衣002款。采用耐磨材质，宽松舒适而又贴身透气。贴合人体，确保观赏性同时便于各种户外运动。

description.en: While her sister works on the machine for the competition, Astesia quietly goes about procuring materials, managing the schedule, testing... and preparing three meals a day for the two of them.
description.zh: 在妹妹研发比赛用机械的时候，星极默默做着材料采购、进度控制、强度测试……以及给两人准备一日三餐的工作。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Fantastic Crafts. Astesia and her sister wore this for a machine design competition. Lightweight, durable, and easy to clean, a stylish outfit for a hard-worker.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/奇工妙想。星极与妹妹组队参加机械设计大赛时的穿着。版型轻便，面料光滑耐磨，污渍一擦即净，便于工作且兼具时尚感。

description.en: Let your heart stare hard into the stars, and witness countless flashes of glory.
description.zh: 予星以心，得见万千光辉之一瞬。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Starseeker. One of the intricate outfits worn by Astesia only in the grandest occasions of Columbia's social life. Merely donning this outfit is a statement of its own.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/寻耀。哥伦比亚地区出席隆重场合时才会穿着的繁复衣装之一，星极衣柜中价值不菲的礼服。穿上它本身就是种态度。

description.en: Humility is left to the audience, pride belongs to the singer. This night, only I shine.
description.zh: 谦逊留给观众，骄傲发自歌喉，此夜，唯我璀璨。

dialog.en: Monster Siren Records Idol Project 'Shining Steps' Promotional Costume/Frlibe on the Palace. Astesia joins the project at her own expense, looking to interpret the stories written in the sky in a popular and easily accessible way.
dialog.zh: 塞壬唱片偶像企划《闪耀阶梯》特供服饰/殿堂上的游禽。星极自费参加了这项企划，尝试着用大众能接受的方式演绎天空之上的故事。

description.en: The sweets she makes may have a little unexpected bitterness and sourness, but the feelings she wishes to share are always sweet as sugar.
description.zh: 她的甜点里还留着意料之外的苦味与酸涩，但她想要传达的感情却一直是清甜的。

dialog.en: Unveiling of Devotion Series New Arrivals/Half-sweet Strawberry. Outfit Grace wears while making holiday-appropriate sweets. A simple apron meets a clash of bold black against daring red, proof that there is no contradiction between reserved expression and sincere intent.
dialog.zh: 待予花冠系列新款/半甜草莓。格蕾丝制作节日甜品时的装扮。素朴的围裙搭配大胆的红黑撞色设计，就像含蓄的表达与真诚的心意并不矛盾。

description.en: The adept ventures to unravel the castle's secrets—
description.zh: 专家正解开古堡的秘密——

dialog.en: Multimedia Escape Experience 'Dreambind Castle' Visitor's Prepared Outfit/Cleansweeper in the Castle. The outfit Shaw wore for the investigation event 'Trails in the Castle.' While Shaw trawls the castle scenery, she's prepared to fend off unexpected guests at any time.
dialog.zh: 多媒体密室“缠梦古堡”游客专用服饰/古堡清洁专家。阿消游玩探索项目“古堡寻踪”时所穿的服饰。阿消正在古堡场景中探索，随时准备与不速之客战斗。

description.en: 'I didn't understand back then... I gave them form, but could not manage warmth or life. But now I do, which is why they're always a beautiful shade of pure white, while I'm always draped in black.'
description.zh: “那时我不明白……我只是塑造它们，但不能赋予它们温度与生命。现在我明白了，所以它们都纯白美好，而我则常着黑纱。”

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Twines of Time. Orchid finally completed her design after several torturous nights. She stroked the delicate stitches on it, quietly praying for life.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/衣缕往昔。经历过数个煎熬的夜晚，梓兰完成了她的设计。她抚摸过上面的细密针脚，安静地为生命祷告。

description.en: 'Don't worry, she won't get away. As you said, if she and I are the only people in this world who can't see eye to eye, then nobody is better suited to be her nemesis than me.'
description.zh: “请放心，她逃不掉。就像你说的那样，如果这片大地上只有我和她不可能和解，那么就没人比我更适合做她的敌人。”

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Titleless Code. The outfit worn by Executor when tracking important charges for the Laterano Notarial Hall. Though one's identity may change over the years, what the heart desires does not.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/无题密令。拉特兰公证所遗嘱执行人兼罗德岛干员送葬人追查重要被执行人时的装束。历经岁月身份会产生变化，只是心中所想，与最初毫无差别。

description.en: At this moment, her growth, along with that mirror image she has never met, will not be merely a passing bubble.
description.zh: 此刻的她，与那不曾相见的镜中影，两个人的成长不会只是泡影一场。

dialog.en: Test Collection/Tranquil Bamboo. An outfit slightly adjusted from the formal attire of an exotic ruler. No mysterious power is needed; after undergoing the baptism of time, Popukar has gradually embraced new changes.
dialog.zh: 忒斯特收藏系列/幽然灵竹。由异国国主的礼服微调而成的着装。无需神秘的力量，泡普卡在经历时光的洗礼之后，逐渐有了新的改变。

description.en: Wait! Someone stop her! Why's she running around on her chainsaw like it's a broom?! The training room floor can't take any more!
description.zh: 等等，拦一拦她，怎么真把电锯当扫帚骑着跑呀！训练室的地面也经不起这么折腾呀！

dialog.en: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Grimoire of Dark Law' Custom Line/Witch's Swing. She plays the role of the young witch brought by her dark mistress to gain some experience! Who says a witch's swing has to be a broom? A chainsaw works too!
dialog.zh: 巫异盛宴角色扮演剧本“暗律魔典”定制服饰/魔女的秋千。扮演者将是魔女老师带出来历练的小魔女！谁说小魔女的秋千只能是扫帚？电锯也很合适啦！

description.en: 'Three, two, one, firing water round!'
description.zh: “三、二、一，水弹发射！”

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HD66. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]悠然假日系列泳衣66款。舒适放松，透气轻盈。让您可以在闲适的环境中享受最完美的沙滩体验。

description.en: 'Did you see it, my lovely mistress? Are you not pleased with this banquet of blood and darkness— Ow... If you want to fight, don't start with the face...'
description.zh: “你看到了吗，亲爱的小姐？这场血与黑暗的盛宴，你满意——哎，要打的话请不要打脸……”

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Seventh Night's Awakened. An outfit worn by Midnight during the promotional video of an annihilation operation. Though it was undeniably effective, everyone agreed that it was a bit over-the-top.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/第七夜苏醒魔君。月见夜在剿灭任务宣传片中穿着的装束。效果虽然很好，但大家都觉得有些夸大了。

description.en: 'We done shooting yet? No? Listen, director lady, I don't wanna get you rated for obscenities, but can you not waste my precious freaking time along with yours?'
description.zh: “我们拍完没？还没有？听着，导演小姐，我不想口出污言秽语，但是在您折腾自己的时候，能不能不要把我宝贵的时间一并浪费了？”

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Professional. The outfit Spot wore for an Annihilation mission promo. It might've been effective, but all Spot's thinking about is what cartoons are on tonight.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/专业人士。斑点在剿灭任务宣传片中穿着的装束。虽然效果不错，但斑点只惦记着今晚播出的动画节目。

description.en: 'I couldn't perform any tasks while I was afloat, so the only thing I could do was compute something interesting. According to my calculations over these last three months, the logic of space and time takes the form of the lovely Ms. Closure.'
description.zh: “在海上漂着的时候没事能做，只能计算些有趣的事情，根据这三个月的运算，空间与时间的形成逻辑是可爱的可露希尔姐姐。”

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Shore Rescue Modification. Lancet-2 was unexpectedly shot down into the water while aiding Ægir refugees off the coast of Iberia, and remained afloat for three months until located and retrieved by a Rhodes Island search and rescue team.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/海岸救援改装。Lancet-2在伊比利亚近海救助阿戈尔难民时被意外击落海中，漂流了三个月后由罗德岛搜救队寻回。

description.en: It's even harder to tell it apart from a medical robot with this new paint job.
description.zh: 新涂装让它变得更容易和医疗用车搞混了。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Raythean Style SUMMER Special Painting. Equipped with heat-proof coating, the latest sand wheels, and reinforced engineering. It is specially modified for operations on the beach.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]雷神工业联动SUMMER特别涂装款。采用夏季耐热涂料，配备最新的沙滩轮胎以及强化引擎，海滩行动特化。

description.en: 'She walked down the towering steps, one by one, like a goddess descending from the mountains.' Everyone was stunned into silence by Matoimaru's performance. They could not help but wonder: Is she an acting genius? Or is she actually—
description.zh: “她从高高的台阶上一步一步走下来，就像是栖宿山中的神女。”所有人都被缠丸的表现震撼。他们忍不住想：难道她其实是演戏的天才？还是说——

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Frosted Steps. Outfit Matoimaru wore when taking part in a period piece. An elegant Higashinese dress combined with delicate makeup bring out her hidden charms in all their glory.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/繁霜满阶。缠丸受邀参演时代剧时的装扮。东国华服配上精致的妆容，将缠丸潜藏的魅力展现得淋漓尽致。

description.en: Bringing an all-new 'flame,' wheeling about in the battlefield they call 'music.'
description.zh: 带着崭新“烈火”，翱翔在名为“音乐”的战场上。

dialog.en: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Black Wave. Stage clothing picked by guitarist Vigna herself. The outfit in whole has been languishing in Vigna's wardrobe for a while, and she's always wanted to give it a stage showing. The chance has now arrived.
dialog.zh: 音律联觉特供款/漆黑热浪。吉他手红豆自己选配的演出服。这一整套衣服在衣柜里藏了许久，她一直想穿着这身上舞台发挥，现在，机会来了。

description.en: Perfect for getting that lovely tan.
description.zh: 可以晒出漂亮的泳衣痕迹。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HD01. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]悠然假日系列泳衣01款。舒适放松，透气轻盈。让您可以在闲适的环境中享受最完美的沙滩体验。

description.en: 'Captain, I'll handle things here. You're still needed elsewhere.'
description.zh: “上尉，这里交给我。你有你该做的事。”

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Distinguished Visitor. The outfit worn by Angelina while she was stationed at the 2nd Final Defense Front. The substance of reality slowly flows between her fingers and her tools.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/质素访客。干员安洁莉娜驻扎在第二最终防卫阵线时穿着的装束。实相物质在她的施术单元与手指间缓慢流淌。

description.en: Aww, I can't finish all these cakes on my own. What do I do~
description.zh: 这些糕点一个人根本吃不完，怎么办呀~

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA017. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]夏卉系列泳衣017款。参考少女的身材和体质，采用天然材质制成。追求今夏最领先的设计潮流。

description.en: 'Once more has the tide returned to Iberia, and it follows the point of my sword. Do you hear the command of the waves as they crash upon the shore? They call upon Iberia to set sail once more.'
description.zh: “再度显现的伊比利亚之潮，顺着我剑锋所指的方向。你们听到那潮声的号令了吗？诸位，那号令呼唤伊比利亚重新起航。”

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Blade-cleaved Tides. Thorns bares his blade, and Iberia's fleet sets sail after a century of silence. A golden secret has emerged in lawless lands, and seas of sand and salt can no longer conceal its radiance.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/锋潮。棘刺亮出剑锋，沉寂近百年的伊比利亚舰队再度起航。黄金璀璨的秘密显于律外之地，无垠沙海与汪洋再难掩盖夺目辉光。

description.en: Have fun on vacation. Do not disturb at work.
description.zh: 享受假期，工作勿扰。

dialog.en: I.T Brand UNDER GARDEN Collab Outfit/Cómodo. A black and white base, the third color freely selectable. A casual design, a multi-modular composition for balanced action/everyday effect.
dialog.zh: I.T旗下品牌UNDER GARDEN合作款服装/惬意。黑白基础配色，第三色可自由选配，休闲型设计，多模块组合兼顾行动/日常效果。

description.en: 'And Leon's armed like a weaponized tin can now. Fine, at least we all know what we're doing.'
description.zh: “连莱特都武装成罐头了。行吧，至少我们都知道自己在做什么。”

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Tested One. Ayerscarpe's attire while upgrading the Rim Billiton Weapon Distribution Center weapons system. He needs to infiltrate a Catastrophe area together with his friends, and heist an important piece of data back before the Columbians.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/受验者。断崖在雷姆必拓武器分配中心更新武器系统时的装束。他需要和朋友一起深入天灾影响区，抢在哥伦比亚人之前回收一份重要资料。

description.en: Harmonie rarely allows anyone into her study, a private space for her alone. The room is furnished with elegant furniture, but she is happy to sit on the table with her tail slightly raised, her staff teasing the sunlight.
description.zh: 和弦很少让人进入她的书房，那是独属于她自己的空间。原本桌椅齐全的优雅小屋，她却乐意坐在桌上，尾尖微微翘起，法杖挑逗阳光。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Invitation. A set of formalwear Harmonie wears while enjoying the afternoon in her study. The smart tailoring makes her skirt move in a beautiful curve, and the fabrics are specially chosen to hide any stray fur stuck on her clothes.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/邀约。和弦在自己书房中享受下午时光时所穿的小礼服。裁剪巧妙，走动时裙摆会有好看的弧度，布料选取了粘上了毛也看不出的颜色。

description.en: On special occasions, Harmonie will redecorate her room, paying meticulous attention to every detail, all for the sake of appeasing her long-lost maiden's heart.
description.zh: 或逢特殊的时节，和弦也会重新装点自己的房间，精心准备，只为安抚自己久违的少女心。

dialog.en: Unveiling of Devotion Series New Arrivals/Decoration. A cute dress Harmonie rarely wears. With its adjustable fit and flexible materials, it can accentuate the body's natural curves better than any other. The accessories are all from her beloved private collection.
dialog.zh: 待予花冠系列新款/装点。少见和弦干员穿着的可爱礼服，松紧灵活可调，更贴合身体曲线，所戴配饰也都是她至爱的私藏。

description.en: There's no end to the race with the reaper; you've always got to take a proper break.
description.zh: 和死神赛跑的道路没有尽头，总得好好休息一下。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA026. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]夏卉系列泳衣026款。参考少女的身材和体质，采用天然材质制成。追求今夏最领先的设计潮流。

description.en: The palm tree sticker was given to her by a surf shop owner during her last trip to Siesta, and the Lupo sticker is from her trip before that to Columbia, where an arcade manager awarded it for a new high score. Both adorn her suitcase. Who knows what she can get on her next trip?
description.zh: 上次旅行汐斯塔冲浪店老板送了她海边树影的贴纸，上上次哥伦比亚电玩城老板把代表着破纪录的鲁珀贴纸贴在了她的行李箱上，不知道这次又能收集到什么？

dialog.en: Cambrian 1100 Winter New Arrivals/Travel Freely. A red and white baseball jacket over a black hoodie, paired with drawstring pants and sports shoes. Comfy and casual, unrestrictive and lightweight, suited for day-to-day travel.
dialog.zh: 寒武纪1100冬季新款/随意而行。红白棒球服内搭黑色帽衫，下半身配上同色系长裤及运动鞋，自在随性，灵活轻便，更适合日常出行。

description.en: 'There's still the Holy City and Kazdel left... You really give me the worst headaches, Mostima. Once I find you, I'm going to punch you in the face.'
description.zh: “剩下的，还有圣城和卡兹戴尔……莫斯提马，你真是能给我惹麻烦。等我找到你，我绝对要把你揍一顿。”

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Judgment Day. Gun-Knight Fiammetta returns to where her squad fell apart. Fragments of time have turned into vicious beasts, intent on bringing everything in the area into stasis. Without the slightest hesitation, she pulls the trigger.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/审判日。铳骑菲亚梅塔回到他们小队分崩离析的地方，时间的碎片已然化作凶兽，意图将周围的一切纳入静滞之中。她扣下扳机，毫不犹豫。

description.en: 'Stop passing around my character card! I mean it! Divine Oath and Crimson Fury are just made up for the game, not my new codenames!'
description.zh: “停止传阅我的角色卡！立刻，马上！‘至圣誓言’和‘绯红盛怒’是虚构角色的称号，不是我的新代号！”

dialog.en: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Dominions & Dogma' Custom Line/Divine Oath. This player shall be the apostolic knight who takes charge in times of crisis. She is the crimson fury spilling forth from the Holy Spirit's palm, bearing the eternal burden of seeking the land of salvation.
dialog.zh: 巫异盛宴角色扮演剧本“异域信条”定制服饰/至圣誓言。扮演者将是临危受命的教廷骑士。她是圣灵掌心溢出的绯红盛怒，背负着寻觅救赎之地的不朽使命。

description.en: After browsing the massive CD collection, Cutter settled on a series teaching kitchen skills. She'll put in the work so that next time, she won't get banned from the kitchen again!
description.zh: 在众多光碟收藏中，刻刀最终选择了厨房教学系列。好好学习，争取下次不会再被禁止进入厨房！

dialog.en: MARTHE Sports Line New Arrivals/Wiping Knife. A style trending among the youth. Tight yet breathable, with an avant-garde design. Noted for its high-contrast colors and modular buckles, letting the wearer freely express themselves.
dialog.zh: MARTHE运动系列新款/拭刀。青少年群体中流行的款式。贴身透气，设计前卫，以高对比配色和可自由拆卸的搭扣组合为卖点，助力客户肆意挥洒个性。

description.en: She should have made proper plans before setting off on her trip. Now, the blistering heat is right by her side while the shade is far away. She can only take in the sun while she figures something out.
description.zh: 她出行前就该给自己做好规划。现在可好，离炎热太近，离阴凉又太远。在想出办法前，只能接受阳光了。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HD29. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]悠然假日系列泳衣29款。舒适放松，透气轻盈。让您可以在闲适的环境中享受最完美的沙滩体验。

description.en: Civilization's trash is nature's treasure.
description.zh: 文明抛弃的，大自然会收养。

dialog.en: Vitafield [Foruiner] Series Classics/Tranquil Moss. For the explorer pursuing what remains. Made with special materials suited for all climates, meeting the harsh demands of complex environments.
dialog.zh: 生命之地[探墟客/Foruiner]系列经典款/幽苔。面向搜寻遗迹的探索者，特别材质制作，适应多端气候变化，满足对复杂环境的特殊需求。

description.en: When 'Destiny Quest' launched, the wandering scholar watched over the ruins, welcoming the hero to the start of their rough-and-tumble journey. Leizi doubted her motives, broke down her words, searched all over for her secrets, before finally unlocking the hidden level after the end of the game.
description.zh: 《命运追索》开局时，游学者守在荒芜遗迹，接引英雄踏上坎坷的命途。惊蛰怀疑她的动机，解构她的言语，寻遍关于她的秘密，最终开启了终局之后的关卡。

dialog.en: Achievement Star Collection/The Archivist and Her Pilgrimage. Clothes Leizi wore at a game expo. She plays a mysterious wandering scholar with a magical companion. Her dedication was praiseworthy, and she brought a true ending to the story.
dialog.zh: 成就之星系列/遗迹游学者。惊蛰受邀参加电玩展时穿的服饰。她扮演的是一位与魔法生物相伴的神秘游学者。社群颂扬她的贡献，故事因她有了真正的解答。

description.en: Blink and you'll miss it. You'll never forget it when you see it.
description.zh: 一闪而过的惊喜，看到了就忘不了。

dialog.en: 0011 New Arrivals/Honor and Splendor. Handcrafted by Lungmen artisans, this outfit synergizes a wide variety of practical fabrics, providing a truly holistic look to meet exacting demands while still maintaining an affordable price.
dialog.zh: 0011™新款/富贵荣华。龙门手工匠制，在预算有限制的情况下使用大量实用面料互相搭配，只为满足客户对整衣的苛刻需求。

description.en: Most hotheaded troublemakers back off for their own safety, seeing the iron hammer she's carrying.
description.zh: 看到她随身携带的铁锤，大多数头脑发热的闹事者都会知难而退。

dialog.en: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Obsidian. Mudrock's work outfit. Mudrock made rounds between every facility at the venue, ensuring the performance would go without a hitch. Though working behind the scenes, she nevertheless opted for a disguise of sorts so as not to disturb the audience.
dialog.zh: 音律联觉特供款/黑曜石。泥岩的工作服。泥岩在演出现场各设施间巡视，确保演出万无一失。虽是幕后工作，但为了不惊扰到观众，她还是换了身装扮。

description.en: Yes, this is Mudrock, our young and beautiful Sarkaz lady.
description.zh: 是的，这位是泥岩，我们青春靓丽的萨卡兹大姑娘。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Silent Night Series DN06. The material is light, soft, breathable and durable. The latest design that is as enchanting as it is elegant.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]静谧午夜系列泳衣06款。材质轻便透气，舒适耐磨。采用尖端设计，神秘典雅，高贵。

description.en: To the Children of Soil and Stone, decaying ruins can quickly become a set of Kazdelian houses.
description.zh: 在土石之子看来，颓败的废墟很快就能成为卡兹戴尔的一栋栋屋舍。

dialog.en: Vitafield [Foruiner] Series Classics/Rubble. For the explorer pursuing what remains. Made of special materials suited for all climates, meeting the harsh demands of complex environments.
dialog.zh: 生命之地[探墟客/Foruiner]系列经典款/砾瓦。面向搜寻遗迹的探索者，特别材质制作，适应多端气候变化，满足对复杂环境的特殊需求。

skinName.en: Remedy In A Cup Of Leung Cha

description.en: A leung cha store is not just for leung cha, and the office is not just for work. As Lee would say, this is where you'll find the human touch in Lungmen. After all, no matter if someone's here for leung cha or a detective, what they're really looking for is peace of mind.
description.zh: 凉茶铺不只卖凉茶，事务所不只办事务，按老鲤的话说，这才是龙门的人情味所在。毕竟，人们不论来凉茶铺还是事务所，总归都是求个心安。

dialog.en: Brand Collaborative Series/Remedy In A Cup Of Leung Cha. Hard to imagine, but the oft-lazing-about Lee is happily wearing an apron while minding the leung cha store below the office. A hobby of his?
dialog.zh: 品牌合作服装/坊间凉茶铺。很难想象，时常偷闲的老鲤，会兴致盎然地穿着围裙在事务所楼下的凉茶铺帮忙看店。难道说，这是他的某种特别爱好？

description.en: Hands fiddle with relics unending, eyes rove across mortality shifting. What stories would these treasures tell him if they could speak?
description.zh: 手中把玩的是一件件藏品，眼中流转的是生死浮沉。宝物若能言语，又将向他诉说何种故事？

dialog.en: 0011 Tempest Series/The Life Appraiser. Traditional clothes made for an appraiser of all things. A purple cape patterned with gold is paired with roomy trousers, emphasizing the wearer's easy-going yet profound nature.
dialog.zh: 0011子品牌，飙系列新款/鉴浮生。为鉴定各类收藏的专业人士设计的传统风格服饰，金纹紫底披袍搭配宽松裤装，凸显穿戴者平易又不失深沉的个性。

description.en: Lee deftly handles his playing cards, corner of his mouth cocked in the same smile as ever. 'Winning a commitment from the underworld three times over in one card game? Ah, that's nonsense.'
description.zh: 老鲤游刃有余地耍着扑克牌，嘴角挂着他一如既往的笑。“用一场牌赢下黑道的三个承诺？哎，没有的事。”

dialog.en: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'The Curious Trove Manor' Custom Line/Trust Your Eyes. The actor plays the role of a Great Thief Magician, here for the treasure. No, come now—doubt those eyes of yours. Trust his hands.
dialog.zh: 巫异盛宴角色扮演剧本“古宅异宝”定制服饰/手到牌来。扮演者将是为了宝物前来此处的魔术师大盗。怀疑你的眼睛，相信他的手。

description.en: He knows that whether you are a well-traveled armed escort or a mountain-crossing Messenger, only those stout of heart will be able to sweep their gaze across the clouds from above.
description.zh: 他明白，无论是走南闯北的镖师，还是踏山行岳的信使，惟有坚如磐石之人，方能纵览云霄。

dialog.en: 0011 Yun Series New Arrivals/Soaring Will. Clothes based on the garb of the armed escorts of Yan, balancing traditional aesthetics with practicality. The youth aspires to shift mountains, his will soaring above the clouds.
dialog.zh: 0011子品牌，韵系列新款/凌云意。参考炎国镖师的服饰设计制作的衣装，兼顾传统美与实用性。少年壮志，撼山震岳，意当凌云。

description.en: The rider seeks to find the castle's entrances—
description.zh: 骑手在寻找古堡的入口——

dialog.en: Multimedia Escape Experience 'Dreambind Castle' Visitor's Prepared Outfit/Exterminator in the Square. The outfit Glaucus wore for the photoshoot event 'Cyclonic Square.' Prior to the photographer clicking the shutter, Glaucus needed to nail down her pose.
dialog.zh: 多媒体密室“缠梦古堡”游客专用服饰/广场扫荡客。格劳克斯游玩拍摄项目“广场狂飙”时所穿的服饰。在摄像师按下快门前，格劳克斯要想好姿势。

description.en: For Caper, rather than the summer scenery and relaxing time she experienced herself, being able to shoot the most fun holiday video in history with other Operators is the real reason she came to this beach.
description.zh: 对卡达来说，比起自己经历的夏日风景和放松时光，能与其他干员一起拍摄出史上最好玩的假日记录视频，才是她来到这片沙滩的原因。

dialog.en: Coral Coast/Holiday Series Swimsuit Model 59 by MARTHE. Comfortable, relaxing, breathable, and light. Allows you to enjoy the most perfect beach experience in a casual environment.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]悠然假日系列泳衣59款。舒适放松，透气轻盈。让您可以在闲适的环境中享受最完美的沙滩体验。

description.en: Click's ready to buy Snowsant's loot at half price, trade for supplies, then sell it back to her at premium. She'll record each transaction, call it material for a future set.
description.zh: 卡达准备半价收购雪雉的战利品，换成实用物资，然后加价卖给她。每次交易都会拍照留念，为之后的集锦收集素材。

dialog.en: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Horrorlair's Enigma' Custom Line/Grave Thief. The actor plays the role of the first enemy the hero faces. If defeated, she will offer her service as a merchant.
dialog.zh: 巫异盛宴角色扮演剧本“魔城密令” 定制服饰/安息处的怪盗。扮演者将是勇者面对的第一个敌人。若被击败，会给勇者提供交易服务。

description.en: The clerics of Landen Monastery haven't worn the traditional habit as daily attire in quite a while, but on days that require hymn-singing and pious vows, they take the time to put them on and gather in the chapel, for the sake of a beautiful dream that all have partaken in for ages past.
description.zh: 兰登修道院的修士们早已不常穿古典修士服，但在需要赞歌与虔诚许愿的日子，他们依然自觉地如此穿着，聚集在礼拜堂，为一个所有人经营许久的美梦。

dialog.en: Test Collection Series/Glory of the Devout. Nun's habit that has been altered, with adjustments for the wearer's racial characteristics. Paired with accessories that reflect one's personal style.
dialog.zh: 忒斯特收藏系列/至虔者荣光。经过量裁后定制的修士制服，根据穿戴者的种族特征进行了微调，并搭配了可体现个人风格的配饰。

description.en: Some of her cleric sisters off stage have to hold in their laughter at the fact that Hildegard's up there singing a prayer.
description.zh: 台下几位修士姐妹都在憋笑，原因无他，只因为席德佳现在唱的是祷文。

dialog.en: Monster Siren Records Idol Project 'Shining Steps' Promotional Costume/Publicity Strategy. The cloistered idol Hildegard, appearing with the sponsorship from MountainDash Logistics, sings the praises of Landen Monstery in a modern, fashionable way.
dialog.zh: 塞壬唱片偶像企划《闪耀阶梯》特供服饰/宣传策略。在峯驰物流赞助下登台献艺的修士偶像席德佳，此刻正在用最潮流的演唱方式歌颂兰登。

description.en: Today's course is beach survival plus goods transport—for Sideroca, a piece of cake.
description.zh: 今天的课程是沙滩求生外加物品搬运，对铸铁来说只是小菜一碟。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Light Breeze Series LB03. A swimsuit and jacket set designed with the full body in mind. Sure to satisfy your waterside athletic needs.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]轻风系列泳衣03款。基于整体性考量设计的泳装冲锋衣套组，必定能满足您在水边的运动着衣需求。

description.en: Death and rebirth, each in their own moment. May the good times last.
description.zh: 枯荣有时，愿好景长存。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Betsushi. Traditional Higashinese outfit made from the highest-quality fabric, colorful yet minimalistic. Comfortable and warm, an ideal choice for outdoor trips in autumn.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/别枝。东国传统服饰，以优质织物精心裁剪成衣，色彩绮丽，花纹素雅。款型舒适防寒，适宜秋日出行。

description.en: Scene gazes at the wilderness while her "lens" searches for the ruins of old cities. Humans transform nature, and nature washes away human traces; history stacks textures here, captured by Scene through her "lens."
description.zh: 稀音注视着原野，“镜头”为她寻找着旧日城市的遗迹。人改造自然，自然抚去人的痕迹，历史在此堆积出纹理，经由“镜头”被稀音捕捉。

dialog.en: Pioneer Series Classic/New Terrain. Made from special materials with functional designs, it can adapt to various environmental changes and satisfy all kinds of needs.
dialog.zh: 生命之地[识荒者/Rewilder]系列经典款/新地形。采用特别材质制作，包含各项功能性设计，足以应对多种自然环境变化，满足各类需求。

description.en: Fashion trends change like the weather, and the same can be said of Utage's character. Which of her is real, in the end?
description.zh: 时尚风向如晴雨般多变，宴的性格亦是如此，究竟哪个才是真正的她呢？

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Disguise. Home leisure style, snug and cozy material. Dark purple and tangerine yellow collide for a full-on sense of vogue.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/伪装。居家休闲款，面料亲肤舒适，暗紫与橙黄的色彩碰撞尽显时尚气质。

description.en: When there is a will, there is a way. Sunshine can also become part of a trend.
description.zh: 只要寻到方法，阳光也能成为潮流的一部分。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA661. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]夏卉系列泳衣661款。参考少女的身材和体质，采用天然材质制成。追求今夏最领先的设计潮流。

description.en: The children absolutely love this costume of Iris's, and to placate them, she might even show up to her recent storytelling tea parties wearing it.
description.zh: 孩子们十分喜欢爱丽丝的这套新衣服，为了满足他们，爱丽丝最近出席故事茶话会可能都会穿这一身。

dialog.en: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'The Curious Trove Manor' Custom Line/Mirror Visitor. The actor—hush, now. Does she play the role of the Master, a guest, or a phantom in the mirror? Until the highest landing is reached, all remains a mystery.
dialog.zh: 巫异盛宴角色扮演剧本“古宅异宝”定制服饰/镜中来访。扮演者将是——嘘，是主人，是宾客，或是镜中虚影，在登上最顶层之前，一切都是未知。

description.en: 'What kind of present... would she like?'
description.zh: “小姐她……到底喜欢什么礼物呢？”

dialog.en: Schwarz's Personal Winter Collection/Presents. Some elements of this outfit run antithetical to the holiday spirit, but she hasn't seemed to notice. More important things are on her mind.
dialog.zh: 黑自己的冬日穿搭/厚礼。使用了反季节的搭配，但本人似乎没有注意到这点，她正在被一些更重要的事情所困扰。

description.en: Schwarz knows there's a little blue being who'll follow her. Schwarz has always known.
description.zh: 黑知道有只兰色的小生物会跟着她，黑一直都知道。

dialog.en: Striker Series/Skyline. A product of Raythean Industries, geared for hypothetical city combat environs. Along with basic protection, the application of the latest in reflective paint allows specialist personnel to blend into the complex surroundings of the city.
dialog.zh: 推进者系列/天际线。雷神工业出品，以城市为假想作战环境，在提供基础防护的同时，加入最新研发的反射涂料，能让专业人员自然融入城市的复杂环境中。

description.en: She accepted the melting of the ice. After coming to the south, she takes a moment to relax under the sunlight.
description.zh: 她接受了坚冰的融化，她来到南方，在阳光下小憩。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HD71. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]悠然假日系列泳衣71款。舒适放松，透气轻盈。让您可以在闲适的环境中享受最完美的沙滩体验。

description.en: Serving gods and serving humans are far from as remote as you'd imagine.
description.zh: 侍神与侍人的区别并没有想象中那么遥远。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Londinium Style Miko. Home leisure style, standard apparel for Victorian housekeeping staff. The pattern on the skirt hem was embroidered in improvisation by Tsukinogi, who seems to have misunderstood this clothing's use case.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/伦式巫女。居家休闲款，维多利亚家政服务人员的标准服饰，裙边上的纹饰是月禾即兴绣上去的，她好像将这件衣服搞错了用途。

description.en: No need to clean up. Avoiding the gift boxes on the ground is part of the fun of dancing. No need to learn the steps. The only dance Tsukinogi hates is the kind where every step is strictly choreographed.
description.zh: 没关系，不用特地收拾场地，在满地礼盒之间寻觅落脚点，也是舞蹈的乐趣之一。没关系，不用特地学习舞步，月禾唯一讨厌的舞，就是每一步都循规蹈矩的舞。

dialog.en: Tsukinogi's formal dress for festive occasions/Dance. The flimsy red skirt and sturdy white shawl are like flowing fire and burning snow. Shall we dance?
dialog.zh: 月禾在节日聚会上穿着的礼服/舞。轻盈的红裙子与厚实的白披肩，像是流动的火与燃烧的雪。要来共舞一曲吗？

description.en: There were a few fashion experts shopping alongside who betted that this outfit wouldn't work on Beeswax, and they very clearly lost.
description.zh: 有几位一起购物的时尚达人打赌这套衣服不适合蜜蜡，她们输得很干脆。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Weißer Sand. Home leisure style, a present from Carnelian to Beeswax. She believed this one would fit her most, and knew Beeswax would like it.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/白沙。居家休闲款，卡涅利安送给蜜蜡的礼物，她认为这件最适合，也知道蜜蜡会喜欢。

description.en: Before, her towers could only be formed with sand, but now they come in pure white, adorned with fresh flowers.
description.zh: 在此之前，她的塔只能由黄沙铸就。在此之后，它添上了洁白与鲜花。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HD61. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]悠然假日系列泳衣61款。舒适放松，透气轻盈。让您可以在闲适的环境中享受最完美的沙滩体验。

description.en: Pushing through in the wilderness, hunting the fog unerasable from her heart.
description.zh: 穿行在荒野中，狩猎内心无法消弥的阴霾。

dialog.en: Vitafield [Rewilder] Series Classics/Lasting Arrowroot. Made with special materials and designed to be functional, perfect for coping with various needs and weathering even the roughest outdoor conditions.
dialog.zh: 生命之地[识荒者/Rewilder]系列经典款/残葛。采用特别材质制作，包含各项功能性设计，足以应对多种自然环境变化，满足各类需求。

description.en: Chiave takes care of the repairs, but Aosta is the one to make the final check.
description.zh: 贾维负责维修，但光铳配件修没修好，还得奥斯塔来判定。

dialog.en: Achievement Star Collection/Light Gun Adjuster. The outfit Aosta wore while working for the Family, paired with tactical equipment. He also likes to wear it when testing light guns at Rhodes Island.
dialog.zh: 成就之星系列/光铳调试员。奥斯塔还在家族中干活时常穿的皮衣，配上了些许战术装备。在罗德岛调试光铳顺便玩上几局刷刷分的时候，他总喜欢穿这一件。

description.en: Jackie leaps into the air, grabs the banner at the center of the mall, falls down onto one of the stalls from the ground floor convention, takes out a few bad guys with a stool, then runs away.
description.zh: 在帅气的一跃后，杰克需要抓住商场中央的宣传横幅往下落，掉在一楼特卖会的顶棚上，用凳子打翻几个坏人，然后夺路而逃。

dialog.en: 0011 Tempest Series New Release/Take a Leap. Green jacket over a simple shirt, with a pair of jeans and protective pads. Very easy to move in, making it well-suited for the outdoors.
dialog.zh: 0011子品牌，飙系列新款/纵身一跃。浅绿色工装外套、护膝牛仔长裤、百搭款打底衫，简约轻便，透气吸汗，是户外活动的首选搭配。墨镜为随机赠品。

description.en: She wishes she could share the taste of these cherries and citrus tea with the one on her mind, now far away.
description.zh: 樱桃与盛夏柑茶的滋味，她也想分享给远方自己在意的人。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HD49. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]悠然假日系列泳衣49款。舒适放松，透气轻盈。让您可以在闲适的环境中享受最完美的沙滩体验。

description.en: The organizer believed that, rather than allowing Chiave to tinker with other people's race cars, it would be better to approve his application as a solo participant. This meant Chiave ended up the grand prix's only driver who was also an engineer.
description.zh: 主办方认为，与其让贾维改造别人的赛车，不如同意他独自参赛的申请。于是贾维成为了本次大奖赛中唯一一位兼任工程师的车手。

dialog.en: Whistlewind Series Race Driver Core Line/One-man Racing Team. He gets out of his work clothes and into his tricolor race outfit, riding his trusty hand-reared steed as they surge across the finish line in a blaze of glory. In this grand prix, all eyes are on him.
dialog.zh: 啸风系列赛车手基础款/一人车队。脱下工装，换上潇洒的三色赛车服，骑着自己亲手调教过的赛车，率先冲过代表荣誉的终点线，这场大奖赛上他才是焦点。

description.en: Surrounded by the organ's roar, her figure composes a symphonic poem as fierce as flame.
description.zh: 在管风琴的奏鸣声中，她的身影谱写出如火般热烈的交响诗。

dialog.en: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Prelude to Transcendence. Clothes Surtr wore to the theater. The fiery train symbolizing the flame of her soul, the gold-trimmed white performing the song of her mind.
dialog.zh: 音律联觉特供款/超然序曲。史尔特尔出席剧场晚会时的着装。焰色的拖尾象征着她的灵魂之火，以金色点缀的纯白演奏着她的意念之歌。

description.en: Accomplishing deeds has no need for meaning. Where the mind goes, the body follows.
description.zh: 成事无需意义，思绪既行，身躯即至。

dialog.en: I.T Brand UNDER GARDEN Collab Outfit/Liberté//Échec. A black and red base. A non-integrated design, with multiple accessories to select, the complete effect taking on personalized preferences.
dialog.zh: I.T旗下品牌UNDER GARDEN合作款服装/自由//失效。黑红基础配色，非整体设计，多种佩饰选择，整体效果呈现个性化偏向。

description.en: Flowers in full bloom, the sea embracing the sky, brilliant memories amidst a shallow slumber. They all bring a smile to her face.
description.zh: 绽开色彩的花，轻搂天空的海，浅梦中斑斓的回忆，勾起她嘴角一抹弯弧。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Colorful Wonderland series CW03. The cool and comfortable blends well with diverse decorations for a unique interpretation of summer.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]缤纷奇境系列泳衣03款。清凉舒适的基础剪裁与多样化的装饰性元素巧妙融合，是对夏天的独特阐释。

description.en: He used to walk the streets, outrage on his mind. There he was, and there he wasn't. Could you stop him? No-one could.
description.zh: 从前的他怀着愤怒行走在街道间，忽隐忽现，无人可挡。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Line [Passe] Series Selects/Infiltrator. This clothing is styled exactly as Ethan used to wear, but closer-fitting, cozier, making him somewhat unwilling to change out of it.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE子品牌 [昔时/Passe]系列精选款/渗透。这件衣服正是伊桑从前穿的款式，但是更贴身，更舒适，让他有些舍不得换。

description.en: He is equally quiet when exercising and resting. Few truly get a glimpse into his heart.
description.zh: 运动时的他与休息时的他同样沉默，很少有人能了解他的内心世界。

dialog.en: MARTHE Sports Line New Arrivals/Rest Between Sets. Targeted at fitness enthusiasts, with material that stretches well and is gentle on the skin. Comfortable and breathable, it is suitable for all types of sports.
dialog.zh: MARTHE运动系列新款/组间休息。针对专业健身人群设计的运动装束，选用亲肤且延展性良好的特级面料，透气舒适，适用于各种运动场合。

description.en: The girl's eyes reflect the color of the snow. She is pure and pristine like the new snow.
description.zh: 少女的眼眸里映着茫茫雪色，她如新雪般洁净无瑕。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Yukibare. Suzuran's outfit on a winter morning trip to the shrine. The loose-fitting sleeves protect against the wind and snow, while the pleated front adds an exotic touch.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/雪霁。铃兰在一个冬日清晨拜访神祠的穿着。宽大的衣袖结实地隔绝了风雪，荷叶边的前摆增添了几分异国风情。

description.en: Sunlight filters through the leaves, and she meanders about the trees with her newfound friend, her smile as beautiful and bright as a flower.
description.zh: 树叶筛下阳光，她和新认识的朋友徜徉林间，笑靥如花朵般明媚。

dialog.en: The Legend of Luo Xiaohei Collaborative Series/Spring Praise. Rustic apparel commonly seen in Terra's central regions. Simple and easygoing, hardy against wear and dirt. Best suited to journeys, outings, and other such daily activities.
dialog.zh: 《罗小黑战记》合作服装/春之颂。泰拉中部常见的乡村服饰，简约大方，耐磨耐脏，更加适应出行、郊游等日常场合。

description.en: The colossi may long be in decline, but the smallest flowerbuds brim yet with hope.
description.zh: 巨物已然颓败，但小小花蕾仍然满含希望。

dialog.en: Vitafield [Foruiner] Series Classics/Lostlands Flowering. For the explorer pursuing what remains. Made with special materials suited for adapting to all climates, meeting the harsh demands of complex environments.
dialog.zh: 生命之地[探墟客/Foruiner]系列经典款/弃土花开。面向搜寻遗迹的探索者，特别材质制作，适应多端气候变化，满足对复杂环境的特殊需求。

description.en: 'This side or the other, real or ethereal. If before thou stands a bandit or a village girl, then I am simply yet another dream, yet unawakened.'
description.zh: “此有故彼有，此无故彼无。倘若此刻站在施主面前的，是盗贼是村妇，那小僧就只是另一场没醒来的梦了，呼~”

dialog.en: Test Collection Series/There They Be. Saga's attire when she left P'o-shan Village, with Biteys for pockets and straw sandals. What is in the scrolls cannot be removed, but after so much time spent with oneselves, what was drawn in ink is now etched in the heart.
dialog.zh: 忒斯特收藏系列/彼有。嵯峨离开婆山镇时的穿着，阿咬为兜草作屐。按理说画卷中的一切无法带出画卷，但与无数个自己相伴相争后，墨迹已成心迹。

description.en: Cutting amber sands and heat haze, you send your gaze far, towards myriad unknowns.
description.zh: 穿越黄沙与热浪，将视线送往满含未知的远方。

dialog.en: Vitafield [Foruiner] Series Classics/Faraway Gaze. For the explorer pursuing what remains. Made with special materials suited for adapting to all climates, meeting the harsh demands of complex environments.
dialog.zh: 生命之地[探墟客/Foruiner]系列经典款/远望。面向搜寻遗迹的探索者，特别材质制作，适应多端气候变化，满足对复杂环境的特殊需求。

description.en: 'A surfing shooting challenge? That's just a skateboard trick challenge on water. Watch, I'm gonna get full points!'
description.zh: “冲浪射击挑战？只不过是滑板挑战的水上版罢了，等着看我的全中表演吧！”

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HD75. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]悠然假日系列泳衣75款。舒适放松，透气轻盈。让您可以在闲适的环境中享受最完美的沙滩体验。

description.en: To Aciddrop, 'afternoon teatime' should really mean chowing down on a pizza meal set for one, grabbing a canvas to test out a spray can, then putting foot to board and heading out for a free skate, destination nada.
description.zh: 对于酸糖而言，所谓的下午茶时光，其实指的是吃完一份单人食披萨套餐，在画布试试喷罐的效果，然后踩着滑板，到外头进行一场没有终点的自由滑行。

dialog.en: 0011 Tempest Series New Arrivals/'Afternoon Teatime'. A cozy, snug-fitting exercise wardrobe paired with a vivid jacket, ensuring the customer will be the center of attention wherever they go.
dialog.zh: 0011子品牌，飙系列新款/“下午茶时光”。舒适合身的运动装配上颜色鲜亮的夹克，让顾客在什么地方都能引人注目。

description.en: 'Follow the road behind me, quickly. Don't thank me, it's part of my duty.'
description.zh: “从我身后这条路走，快。不必道谢，这是我的职责。”

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Homecoming. The outfit worn by Operator GreyThroat while participating in a rescue operation for the Infected within the Catastrophe zone of Sugar City. Disregarding protection or camouflage, upon this outfit is etched the will to protect the next person, and save another life.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/归巢。干员灰喉在甘糖城参与天灾区域感染者营救行动时的装束。顾不得防护和伪装，只希望能多挡下一个人，多救下一个人。

description.en: Bena dreamed. In the dream, the master of a super-big steamer basket told her that as long as she was willing to help, she could have some real yummy xiaolongbao. And so, Bena picked up her rod, sat down on a Beast Steward, and... started running errands!
description.zh: 贝娜做了一个梦。梦里，超级大蒸笼的主人告诉她，只要她愿意帮忙，就可以给她吃超级小笼包。于是，贝娜拿起钓竿，骑上兽亲……开始跑腿！

dialog.en: 0011 New Arrivals/Prairie Pals. Outfit Bena wore on a field mission in the prairie. The traditional clothes serving as the base have been enhanced with modern innovations, making them lightweight without sacrificing cuteness.
dialog.zh: 0011新款/草原小帮手。贝娜在草原上执行外勤任务时的装扮。在民族服饰的基础上进行了现代化的创新，轻便又不失可爱。

description.en: On this day, the news he brings has nothing to do with Catastrophes. He carries only happiness and hope, and the gifts everyone dreamed of.
description.zh: 在这一天，他带来的所有讯息都无关天灾，只有幸福和希望，以及大家梦寐以求的礼物。

dialog.en: Leonhardt's winter outfit / Hope Cruise. Made in Victorian fashion, featuring exquisite materials. Perfectly aligned while maintaining comfort to give an overall crisp look to the outfit - simple, yet not so simple.
dialog.zh: 莱恩哈特的冬日穿搭/希望巡游。维多利亚风格，用料考究，在保证舒适度的同时内置里衬，让服装整体视感更加挺括，简约而不简单。

description.en: As the wasteland wanderers say: when you find what you need to survive, you've found treasure.
description.zh: 在荒野游荡者们口中，能让人存活下去的东西，就被称作宝藏。

dialog.en: Vitafield [Foruiner] Series Classics/Finder in the Rough. For the explorer pursuing what remains. Made with special materials suited for adapting to all climates, meeting the harsh demands of complex environments.
dialog.zh: 生命之地[探墟客/Foruiner]系列经典款/宝藏行家。面向搜寻遗迹的探索者，特别材质制作，适应多端气候变化，满足对复杂环境的特殊需求。

description.en: A quarterback is responsible for organizing every offensive play, but THRM-EX much prefers cradling the ball and charging in!
description.zh: 四分卫需要负责组织每一场进攻，但THRM-EX更喜欢持球冲锋！

dialog.en: MARTHE Sports Line New Arrivals/Dual-threat Quarterback. No matter who popularized the sport, THRM-EX is its #1 fan. As for his teammates... They're mainly other operation platforms.
dialog.zh: MARTHE运动系列新款/双料四分卫。无论将这项运动传开的是谁，THRM-EX都成了它的忠实拥趸。他的队友……主要是其他作业平台。

description.en: From baking cakes to putting up decorations, Goldenglow helped set up this tea party with her friends. There's no special occasion or meaning behind it. Just a gentle, quiet afternoon she should have had.
description.zh: 从烘焙甜点到布置场景，澄闪亲手与朋友们一起筹备了这场茶话会。不是什么特别的日子，没有什么特别的话题，只是她本该拥有的一个温柔而宁静的午后。

dialog.en: Brand Collaborative Series/Party In The Garden. The sweetest treats, the most vibrant flowers, and lots and lots and lots of bow-tie ribbons. Even after the fire, Goldenglow has never forgotten that dream.
dialog.zh: 品牌合作服装/花房茶话会。最甜蜜的派、最繁盛的花，还有很多、很多、很多蝴蝶结——经历过一场大火之后，澄闪仍没有忘记那个梦。

description.en: Gifts for the guests, decorations at the door, beautiful dresses. Goldenglow has been preparing to celebrate this day with everyone. All that's left is to blow the horn and spread the joy.
description.zh: 给客人的礼物、门前的装饰、靓丽的服饰。澄闪为和大家一起庆祝这一天准备了许多。现在只差最后一步——吹响手中的号角，让欢乐遍满大地。

dialog.en: Goldenglow's festival attire/Maiden for the Bright Night. Warm, solid wool sweater sent by her mum, paired with gauze skirt for a red and green combination perfect for the festive season.
dialog.zh: 澄闪的节日私服/喜夜侍者。妈妈寄来的编织毛衣温暖厚实，配上一条轻盈的纱裙，让明丽的红绿色与节日的欢愉相得益彰。

description.en: Jump off a boat filled with sunflowers and frolic in their shadow. Watermelons, soft drinks, the sun, and the cool waves. This is how a girl's summer should be.
description.zh: 跳下满载向日葵的小船，躲进花蔓的影子里摇摇荡荡。西瓜、软饮、阳光与海浪都冰镇得刚刚好，少女的夏日就该如此惬意。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA394. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]夏卉系列泳衣394款。参考少女的身材和体质，采用天然材质制成。追求今夏最领先的设计潮流。

description.en: The sound of synthesized voices echo at a leisurely tempo, like the valley in the rain.
description.zh: 人声经过恰当的电音处理，配合慢板节奏，幽幽回响，仿佛雨季的山谷……

dialog.en: 0011 Tempest Series New Release/Glen Sonata. Limited-edition padded jacket with leather bottoms and artisan accessories. SOLD OUT: STAY TUNED FOR ANNOUNCEMENTS ABOUT RESTOCKING.
dialog.zh: 0011子品牌，飙系列新款/幽谷奏鸣。本季限量软塑夹层风衣、高光皮裤、特殊配饰，已售罄，请关注后续再贩情报。

description.en:
'You've got skills!'
'All that exists has a soul. To approach true greatness, the first step is to sense the—Hey! Where're you going?'
'Oh, uh, there's a sale going on over there!'
description.zh:
“你的技术真的很棒！”
“万物皆有灵魂，要接近伟大的真实，第一步是感受这……喂！！你去哪？”
“啊——那边有东西打折！”

dialog.en: Achievement Star Collection/To Evoke the Anima. Sesa loves games, especially sandbox survival ones with plenty of computer-wrecking bugs. Still, with the 'Garb of the Soulseer', he can overcome any issue, somehow.
dialog.zh: 成就之星系列/万物有灵。慑砂酷爱游戏，尤其是带生存建造玩法、故障高发到损坏机器的。无妨，换上“调魂师正装”的他会以神秘手段化解所有问题。

description.en: She has undeniably proven herself the fastest racer to all the spectators. Now, if she can just stop herself once she's past the finish line...
description.zh: 这一次所有人都看在眼里，她就是无可争议的全场最快选手——若是越过终点后能自己停下就更好了。

dialog.en: MARTHE Sports Line/The Wind Rider. Clothes for roller-skaters, pairing skintight athletics wear with a transparent jacket, highlighting the wearer's grace as they surge ahead.
dialog.zh: MARTHE运动系列新款/迎风之轮。专为轮滑选手设计的装束，紧身运动衣配合透明外套，凸显出穿戴者疾速向前时的风姿。

description.en: Once a pauper, now the world's greatest hope. That's what the script says anyway, but Snowsant just wants to get at the treasure chest Whislash brought!
description.zh: 曾是贫民，现为大地唯一的希望——剧本上是这么描述的，但雪雉只想摸摸鞭刃提供的宝箱！

dialog.en: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Horrorlair's Enigma' Custom Line/Fated Hero. The actor plays the role of the hero chosen by fate, who descends into the Horrorlair not just to quell disaster and eliminate evil, but with the hope of finding treasures to improve her life.
dialog.zh: 巫异盛宴角色扮演剧本“魔城密令” 定制服饰/天命勇者。扮演者将是命运选中的勇者，前往魔城既是为了消灾除恶，更是希望能在城中找到财宝改善生活。

description.en: 'When the spring chill's coming in, you gotta shout 'Happy New Year, long time no see!''
description.zh: “春寒时节道一声新年快乐，好久不见啦。”

dialog.en: 0011 New Arrivals/Yearly Present. Purestream dons new clothes and brings a gift for her visit, the trendy multi-layered style unable to hide the bright colors of Yan—the hem's red lining and the pendants on her staff and her waist come together in harmonious ingenuity.
