dialog.zh: 0011新款/贺新禧。清流着新装携礼物拜访，时下流行的层层叠穿难掩鲜明的炎国风格——裙摆的红色内衬、腰间杖头的挂件，尽显搭配巧思。

description.en: 'I can't wait for the fair! All the fun activities, and the used book sale!'
description.zh: “哇，祭典！听说会有好多新奇的活动，还有旧书摊！我已经迫不及待了！”

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Tsukiyoi. Custom-made for Mint, integrating Victorian style into traditional Higashinese garb. Comfy yet unique, it is one of Mint's favorites on festive occasions.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/月宵。薄绿的私人定制款，将维多利亚风格融入东国传统服饰中，穿着舒适，独具个性。薄绿喜欢用这身搭配欢庆的气氛。

description.en: The private study is filled with books, each filled with mysteries waiting to be solved. She comes here whenever she gets a rare moment to focus.
description.zh: 私人书房中的典籍如山如海，书间谜团亟待解开，女孩难得的专注时光都倾注于此。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Private Study. Mint's formalwear at the Victorian Institution for Higher Studies, the green waistband showing off her lines and individuality.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/私人书房。薄绿在维多利亚高等学府的正式着装，腰间的绿色束带收束腰线，尽显个人风格。

description.en: Rosmontis longs to know what it was that all those machines held back in concert. She's seen it. She's forgotten it.
description.zh: 迷迭香渴望知道藏在那一道道机械阻碍后的究竟是什么。她见到了，她失忆了。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Become Anew. Rosmontis's attire while still a test subject, adorned only by detectors and inhibitors.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE子品牌 [昔时/Passe]系列精选款/拥抱新生。迷迭香仍为实验对象时的装束，除了检测器和抑制器外没有任何装饰。

description.en: In her dream, Rosmontis struggled to recall how to play this game of chess, but she knew that no matter where her path led, the pieces around her would accompany her.
description.zh: 在梦中，迷迭香有些回想不起这种棋的下法，但她知道，不论自己前进的方向是哪里，身边这些棋子都会陪着她一起。

dialog.en: Test Collection Series/An Airy Dream. Rosmontis's lavender dream. In this dream, soft flowers bloom deep in her memories, and Rosmontis's skirt billows with the wind, leaping towards a light future with her companions.
dialog.zh: 忒斯特收藏系列/轻盈一梦。迷迭香的淡紫色梦境。在梦中，记忆深处开满柔软的花朵，迷迭香的裙摆随风扬起，和身旁的伙伴一起跃向轻盈的未来。

description.en: Weedy goes wherever the wind blows. It seems rather clear she's forgotten she's here on holiday.
description.zh: 循着风的流动，温蒂一路向前。显然，她已经忘记自己来这里本是为了休假。

dialog.en: Misaligned Sightseer New Arrivals/Sedjem. Weedy treads the boundary between sand and water, tracing the flow ever deeper. Is what she hears the whispers of the sea of salt, or the greetings of the sea of sand?
dialog.zh: 错位巡礼系列新款/倾听。在沙和水的交会区，温蒂漫步其间，向更深处追溯。她听到的，是海洋的呢喃，还是沙海的致意？

description.en: Word is that the musical production had a strange name—'The Nutcracker.'
description.zh: 听说演出曲目有个奇怪的名字——《木果夹子》。

dialog.en: Weedy's Stage Outfit/Candy Cape. A vivid and colorful stage costume, pursued with multiple-layered design and modification for full effect, demanding complex fabrication. Dirt- and wear-resistant, as well as excellently dustproofed.
dialog.zh: 温蒂的演出服/糖果仙子。拥有强烈色彩的演出服，为了追求效果进行了层层设计与修改，制作工艺很复杂。耐脏耐磨，防尘效果也很优秀。

description.en: 'I dreamed of a knight. They were a carefree and cheerful sort, having traveled all over the land and gathered an array of talents. They saved countless enslaved robots and Infected, and in that dream... that knight was me.'
description.zh: “我梦见了一个骑士。他放荡不羁，幽默开朗。他游历大地，博学多才。他解救了无数被奴役的机器与感染者。而梦里，我就是那个骑士。”

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Tournament Fantasy Retrofit Kit. The General Chamber of Commerce had no idea the newest wave of protests would arise from a most unremarkable robot's tournament retrofit labelled as a 'drone.'
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/竞技之梦改装。商业联合会无论如何都想不到，引起新一轮抗议的，竟然是一辆平平无奇的机器人竞赛改装“无人机”。

description.en: Pudding is responsible for emergency power maintenance today. Overtime pay is always appreciated—all the better when nothing happens—allowing her to wait under the tree and hand out gifts to passing children.
description.zh: 在收取了一笔可观的加班费后，布丁要在今天负责各种电源的紧急维护。当然，今天什么都没有发生，于是布丁就在树下待着，为来往的孩童派送礼物。

dialog.en: Pudding's winter attire for going out/Gleaming Fey. The snowflake-embroidered gauze lining mitigates the heaviness of the jacket, giving it a light, pretty touch.
dialog.zh: 布丁的冬日逛街穿搭/火树灵。设计师特意使用了绣有雪花的轻薄纱缎来中和外套的厚重感，看起来飘逸又美好。

description.en: 'What an exquisite weapon... Tell me, Phidia, what surprise have you prepared for me?'
description.zh: “多么精美的武器……告诉我，斐迪亚，你给我准备了什么惊喜？”

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/For the Banquet. Melanite once attended a banquet hosting people from across the industry. On careful consideration, she chose this gown to hide her true purpose for attending.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/赴宴。玫拉曾出席友商云集的宴会。她精心挑选了晚礼服，隐藏赴宴的真正目的。

description.en: During her spare time while setting up, Irene lifts the hem of her skirt, and looks at the fowlbeasts soaring up high. A hint of eagerness shows on her face as she goes on stage and begins to dance, Iberian style.
description.zh: 在布置的空闲时刻，艾丽妮提起自己的裙摆，看向那只高飞的羽兽，脸上隐隐露出一点跃跃欲试的表情，在台上跳起伊比利亚的舞步来。

dialog.en: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Voyage of Feathers. Irene's work outfit. Placed in charge of the props, she sets them in place, as a flock of fowlbeasts circles higher into the sky, ships sailing into the distant horizon.
dialog.zh: 音律联觉特供款/飞羽。艾丽妮的工作服。艾丽妮负责准备演出道具，在她的布置下，羽兽盘旋上升，飞向更高远的天空，海面的舰船也驶向远方。

description.en: As one of her off-hour pastimes, Irene is very interested in how her choices in the game will affect the narrative. Recently, her plethora of notes has gone viral without her meaning to. The developers agreed to change her username—if she agreed to show her sincerity.
description.zh: 作为工作外的消遣，艾丽妮非常在意游戏内的抉择如何影响故事走向。最近，她曾写下的笔记意外爆火。官方同意她更改用户名，但她也需要拿出一点诚意。

dialog.en: Achievement Star Collection/The Adjudicatrix and Her Resolve. A 'Destiny Quest' outfit made for Irene by the devs based on her role in the game. To promote the next update, she's forced to stand on the stage for a photo op.
dialog.zh: 成就之星系列/至高判决。《命运追索》官方根据艾丽妮过去的游戏角色形象定制的服饰。她不得不站在精心制作的展台前留影，为新版本的到来宣传造势。

description.en: From far, far away, you can see a completely different Elysium. Want the normal one? Just start talking with him.
description.zh: 远远望去，能看到一个截然不同的极境。想要平时的那个？那和他说句话就行。

dialog.en: One of Elysium's Numerous Outfits as a Messenger/Snowy Echo. Many associate the pairing of red and white with the bygone Icefield Messenger. Perhaps to pander to their expectations, he's matched it with a pair of spectacles on purpose.
dialog.zh: 极境担任信使时众多着装中的一种/雪夜回音。红与白的配色很容易让人联想到曾经的冰原信使，或许是为了迎合人们的期待，他特地配了副眼镜。

description.en: Imagine NOT wearing something that shows off this beautiful physique in the summer. What a waste.
description.zh: 炎炎夏日，要是不能穿上展露身姿的好衣服，实在是太对不起这样的大帅哥了。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Shining Dew Series SDm11 for men. Tight-fitting, lightweight, breathable, and designed for the summer.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]灿阳朝露系列泳衣11男款。贴身、透气、轻便，专为夏日而生。

description.en: Under the spotlight, she is both a captivating masterpiece and the meticulous creator behind it.
description.zh: 射灯之下，她是摄人心魄的作品，也是精益求精的作者。

dialog.en: Cambrian 1102 Winter New Arrivals/Dazzling Blue. A brilliant sapphire-blue velvet jacket paired with a form-fitting satin bodysuit keeps the wearer warm while showing off their confidence, turning them into the most dazzling star under the spotlight.
dialog.zh: 寒武纪1102冬季新款/耀目之蓝。蓝宝石丝绒外套搭配立体剪裁的缎面连体裤，保暖的同时彰显穿着者自信气质，使其成为聚光灯下最耀眼的存在。

description.en: Lessing hasn't said what he thinks of this outfit, and some suspect that trying a new style might be a form of 'training under pressure' for him. He's been wearing it for a few days now, though. He has to like them, right?
description.zh: 止颂没有对这套衣服发表什么看法，甚至有人怀疑他是不是把尝试新风格也当作“压力训练”的一种。不过他这几天都穿着这一身，看起来应该是喜欢的吧？

dialog.en: 0011 Tempest Series New Arrivals/Ignis Fatuus. A gift for Lessing from some young Liches, for taking the brunt of their teacher's ire. Though it's the opposite of his usual style, he looks surprisingly cool in it.
dialog.zh: 0011子品牌，飙系列新款/幻火。由几位小巫妖带回的用来感谢止颂替他们分担老师怒火的礼物。虽然和他平时的风格截然不同，但出乎意料地帅气。

description.en: If not for Kjera's perusal of some traditional Victorian fairytales prior to ordering, Pramanix might have utterly missed out on the look of furrowed perplexity that flitted across SilverAsh's face. And what of Kjera's thoughts, you say? She's having a great deal of fun.
description.zh: 如果不是耶拉在定制衣物前看了点维多利亚传统童话故事，初雪或许捕捉不到银灰那饱含疑惑的皱眉瞬间。若是问耶拉自己的感想？她玩得很开心。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Ingenious Servant. A bespoke outfit ordered at the Savile Boutique Tailors by Kjera, the finished product of bewildering quality thanks to the fantastic minds of the designers, plus Kjera's own clever touch.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/灵巧侍者。耶拉在萨维尔衣匠处定制的衣物，由于耶拉本人的巧妙点子与设计者的奇思妙想，成衣产生了预料之外的效果。

skinName.en: Clouds Float Like Ideas of Art

description.en: 'I had a dream, Agnese... I turned into a winged beastling amongst flowers, flying over a strange fence, up into the sky... Will there be people up above the clouds to hunt with us?'
description.zh: “阿涅塞，我好像做了一场梦。梦里我变成了一只生于花叶间的有翼小兽，乘风越过造型奇异的石栏，飞得老高老高……云上也会有人陪我们打猎吗？”

dialog.en: 0011 Yun Series/Clouds Float Like Ideas of Art. Presented by the finest Yanese artisans, combining classic style with trendy spirit.
dialog.zh: 0011子品牌，韵系列新款/棠云巧梦。炎国织匠倾力呈现。亘古承传的经典美学与时尚精神交互融合，别出机杼，尽释雅趣。

description.en: On days off, she will also step out of her room with her meticulously decorated drone, humming a song to leisurely enjoy an afternoon without field assignments.
description.zh: 没有工作的日子，她也会带着悉心装点一番的无人机走出房间，哼着歌去悠闲地享受一个不用出外勤的午后。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrival/Languid Humming. Crafted from soft, lightweight fabric, it adds a distinctive bow tie as a neck ornament without compromising flexibility, making it the top choice for strolling around when off duty.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/慵怠哼唱。以柔软的轻型布料制作，在不影响灵活的前提下，增加了独具特色的小领结作为颈饰，是没有工作闲逛时的首选穿搭。

description.en: For a good while, Kazemaru secretly had a paper self 'listening' for her while the script was explained, and was only found out once everyone decided to break for food.
description.zh: 风丸偷偷让纸人帮自己“听”了好一会儿剧本讲解，直到大家决定一起去吃饭时才被发现。

dialog.en: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'The Curious Trove Manor' Custom Line/Like Illusion. The actor plays the role of the maid who guards the treasure. In a sea of roaming shadows of a hundred and one forms, all truest true and falsest false, the willful intruder finds himself endlessly dithering about the stairs.
dialog.zh: 巫异盛宴角色扮演剧本“古宅异宝”定制服饰/幻影轻悄。扮演者将是守护宝物的女仆。百般变化，真真假假，人影憧憧中，入侵者在楼梯上无尽徘徊。

description.en: 'These tweezers? I use them to pick up puzzle pieces. The ones too small or too thin are rather difficult to grasp with your fingers. They have no other use apart from this.'
description.zh: “镊子？是用来夹起拼图碎片的，太小太薄的碎片不适合直接用手拿。除此之外，它没有别的意义。”

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Amidst the Pieces. Puzzle knows that he should tailor his attire to his target—one of the most efficient ways to win trust and exchange intel. When alone, however, he barely spares a thought to his appearance.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/碎片之间。谜图知道面对不同的人应该选择怎样的着装，才能最高效地博取信任、换来情报。但独处时，他并不在乎自己形象如何。

description.en: A conspicuous new identity is not necessarily a bad thing for him. When people start to let their guards down thanks to his soothing melody, the cool-colored network woven by him is already quietly spreading.
description.zh: 拥有引人注目的新身份对他来说并不是坏事，在人们因为他弹奏的旋律而放松下来的时候，他编织的冷色之网就已经开始扩散。

dialog.en: Monster Siren Records Idol Project 'Shining Steps' Promotional Costume/Cool Colored Rock 'n' roll. Puzzle quickly mastered the instrument in his hand, completing his transformation to an idol with nary a hitch. Now, his mission truly begins.
dialog.zh: 塞壬唱片偶像企划《闪耀阶梯》特供服饰/冷色摇滚。谜图只用了很短时间就熟练掌握了手中的乐器，从而顺利成为了音乐偶像，他的任务就此开启。

skinName.en: A Silvern Caress On the Flow of Time

description.en: 'Neither the flowing sands nor moonlight speak. As for the magnificence and treasures of the past millennia, shall I recount their stories for you?'
description.zh: “流沙不言，月光不语，这千百年间的瑰丽和珍宝，想听我为你讲述吗？”

dialog.en: 'Nine-Colored Deer' Collaborative Series/A Silvern Caress On the Flow of Time. Crossing the golden sands yet leaving nary a trace, time passes quietly along with the moon's shadow. Nine-Colored Deer meticulously counts the tracks left behind by the passing years, and thus the full moon pauses, seeking one to converse with.
dialog.zh: 《九色鹿》合作服装/古往今来的月。黄沙踏过并不留痕，时光与月影一同悄悄流逝。九色鹿细数过往岁月留下的痕迹，圆月为此驻足，欲与人说。

description.en: Plant a little tree, the first step towards bringing green to the vast desert.
description.zh: 万顷黄沙终将成为良田，而这场远征，从种下些微不足道的植株开始。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Series New Release/Cultivate Vegetation. Rugged traditional Sargon outfit, suitable for long journeys. The new collar details give the wearer a closer fit.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/培翠。萨尔贡传统服饰，材质耐磨经脏，方便远行，衣领处增添了新式细褶，整体更加贴合顾客的身线。

description.en: This is the first time she's playing this distinctive game, so sit down, order a pot of tea, and teach her the basics of making friends through tiles.
description.zh: 这还是她第一次接触这种独特的游戏，点一壶茶，坐下来向她传授以牌会友的基本技巧吧。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Charm of the Tiles. Clothes Kestrel wears while having fun at the games teahouse. Culottes matched with a leather jacket and handbag draw out an elegant charm, while maximizing the wearer's easy-going attitude.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/三元风情。红隼在棋牌茶室游玩时的穿着。布面裙裤搭配皮衣与手包，引出雅致魅力的同时，尽显穿戴者洒脱风范。

description.en: The curtains fall, as do ripened fruits. If you wish to taste the fruit, learn to create. They are best fallen, as they have elsewhere, as yours do.
description.zh: 戏剧已落幕，鲜美的果实也已从树上剪落。若想品尝这份美味，便要懂得创作。噢哦，果实落地才有滋味，别处的是如此，你的，也不会例外。

dialog.en: 0011 Tempest Series/The Fruition. Classic black and white, with just a touch of color. No need for complex ornamentations; any flair belongs to the performer alone.
dialog.zh: 0011子品牌，飙系列新款/结果。版型简单自然，经典黑白配色，一抹鲜艳点到即止。无需繁杂装饰，风采留给表演者自由展现。

description.en: Tabloid journalists, enemies, detectives... Many have tried to capture a candid moment of her. But the real Ms. Ingrid is never trapped in a single focal plane; she exists beyond the focus.
description.zh: 小报记者、仇家、缉凶警探……许多人曾试图拍下她的真实瞬间。但真正的英格丽女士从不会困于单一的焦平面，她存在于焦点之外。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrival/Out of Focus. The outfit Honeysweet wore while watching an opera in Siracusa. The new synthetic fabric presents a dazzling shine under the flashlights, reflecting similar yet different colors from every angle.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/失焦。忍冬于叙拉古观看歌剧时的穿着。新型的合成面料在闪光灯下呈现耀眼的光泽，从各个角度反射出相似却不同的色彩。

skinName.en: Carriage of the Winds of Time

description.en: The night wind blows away an ancient melody, and the stars leave behind an instant of mirth. In the end, all things must fade. But spare them no thought for now. Ho'olheyak steps down from the stage, reciting eternity at you.
description.zh: 夜风吹散古老的旋律，星辰遗落刹那的欢笑，万物终有一日将会消逝。此刻，将它们置之度外吧。霍尔海雅走下台阶，向你念诵着何为漫长。

dialog.en: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Carriage of the Winds of Time. Ho'olheyak's concert outfit, evoking a classical yet romantic dance. She chose the fabrics with utmost care, wrinkled for her key performance, and gilded for the years everlasting.
dialog.zh: 音律联觉特供款/历世流风。霍尔海雅的演出服，为带来古典又浪漫的翩舞而设计。她精心挑选了布料与纹样，为重要的演出掇弄褶皱，为不灭的岁月鎏金。

description.en: Atop the pedestal engraved with the past, her lithe steps make a mockery of history.
description.zh: 她在刻满过往的展台上，迈出俯视历史的轻盈脚步。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection/Ritual of Immortality. Clothes Ho'olheyak wore while touring the ruins. Under a loose coat lies an exceedingly-modern black dress, making clear that her purpose here is not to explore the past, but to sneer at its passing.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/恒久祭礼。霍尔海雅进行遗迹巡礼时的着装。宽松外袍下是富有现代感的黑裙，彰显她来到此处的目的并非探索过去，而是傲视时间。

description.en: 'As long as I can keep enjoying my vacation, I'm happy to defend the innocent for the rest of my life!'
description.zh: “只要还能享受假期，我就愿意为生活作无罪辩护！”

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HD78. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]悠然假日系列泳衣78款。舒适放松，透气轻盈。让您可以在闲适的环境中享受最完美的沙滩体验。

description.en: Proviso leaves the office and its documents behind and comes upon a field painted in autumn. There is no need for argument or jargon here, you can simply express what you feel.
description.zh: 离开了堆满文档的办公室，但书来到了被秋意渲染过的田野。这里不需要使用辩论技巧和专业术语，想要抒发什么情感，直接说出来就好。

dialog.en: Vitafield [Camper] Series Classics/High Autumn. Designed for outdoor activities, providing extra support for the body. The comfortable and breathable fabric dries quickly.
dialog.zh: 生命之地[行路人/Camper]系列经典款/秋高气爽。专为户外运动设计，选用特殊工艺为身体提供超强支撑，面料舒适透气，高效速干。

description.en: Ezell continues to ponder the meaning of the Sankta's wings. He finds no answer, even as his clothes are soaked with rain.
description.zh: 艾泽尔仍在思考萨科塔背生翅翼所承载的意义。可直到雨水沾湿了他的衣裳，他还是没能找到答案。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Paper Wing. White jacket on mint-green T-shirt, refreshingly cool for the summer.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/拾翼。白色外套内搭薄荷绿短袖，轻松营造出清爽舒适的氛围，为夏日增添清凉的气息。

description.en: A longsword sheathed in stone with vines wrapped around the hilt. Souls of the departed lost to war should, like this sword, go to a quiet place inlaid with white flowers to forever rest in peace.
description.zh: 长剑封入石鞘，藤蔓缠住剑柄。亡失于战争的灵魂，也应同这剑一般，去往白花点缀的静谧之地，永享安眠。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/To Effloresce Whitely. A gown for Victorian nobles woven with fine muslin, fragrant and supple flowers gracing the pure white skirt. A quiet elegance, delicate and sublime.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/化花。维多利亚贵族纱织长裙，清香柔婉的花朵，纯白飘逸的裙摆，清丽优雅，轻软精致。

description.en: Rockrock's endlessly enthused about picking out a present for her new friend, but when the next welcoming activity is—singing twelve straight songs with Xiaohei? That's got her a little awkward.
description.zh: 在给新朋友挑礼物这件事上，洛洛热情无限，但接下来的欢迎活动是——带小黑连唱十二首歌？这倒是让她有些为难。

dialog.en: The Legend of Luo Xiaohei Collaborative Series/Before Singing. Glossy texturing and a bright palette make for materials that shout energy, while contour-hugging innerwear pairs with a loose-fit jacket to provide both comfort and chic.
dialog.zh: 《罗小黑战记》合作服装/欢唱之前。衣料的亮面材质与鲜艳用色尽显活力，贴身内搭与大号外套的搭配兼具舒适度与时尚感。

description.en: He did not find his favorite crystals on the beach, but the coolness of drinks and sea breeze made it worth his while.
description.zh: 沙滩上没找见他最喜欢的亮晶矿。不过，回味着汽水与海风的清凉，他依然感到不虚此行。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HDm57. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]悠然假日系列泳衣57男款。舒适放松，透气轻盈。让您可以在闲适的环境中享受最完美的沙滩体验。

description.en: The golden sunlight is not the only visitor to this room. The ocean has just revealed itself, and Lumen gestures at you to speak softly so as to not disturb the dreamlike scene.
description.zh: 浅金色的阳光不是唯一一位到访这间屋子的客人，大海刚刚褪去面纱，流明示意你轻声，别惊扰了这如梦一般的光景。

dialog.en: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Golden Dream. Lumen's casual leisure wear, tailored for elegance from lightweight materials. The sea mist has lifted, and you can now see the lighthouse without binoculars.
dialog.zh: 音律联觉特供款/灿海浮梦。流明闲暇时的便装，裁剪飘逸，用料轻薄。海雾已经散去，想要眺望灯塔，可以不必再借用望远镜的帮助。

description.en: Through bustling cities and endless crowds, he was just a small piece of the land. Now, and always, he is no longer alone.
description.zh: 不知穿过多少城市喧嚣，经过多少人来人往，他仍旧是世间的小碎片，但无论现在还是未来，他都不再孤身一人。

dialog.en: Brand Collaborative Series/Wanderer in the Rain. Raindrops slide down his clear umbrella to his feet, and the night wind lifts the hem of his white coat. Though the path ahead remains unclear, he knows where to go.
dialog.zh: 品牌合作服装/雨霓行游客。透明伞上的雨滴滑落脚边，夜风扬起白色外衣的衣角。前路通向何处虽然尚不清楚，但他知晓自己的方向。

description.en: The story goes from day to night and back, but not all stories are meant to be told right away. Hot drinks and beautiful scenery are everything tonight. A poem yet unread can wait for tomorrow.
description.zh: 故事在日夜之间来回流转，但并非所有故事都应在当下就被叙述。热饮与美景便是今晚的全部，尚未出口的诗篇，还是等到明天再来讲述吧。

dialog.en: Erato's home attire/Untold Stories. Soft, tight-fitting fabric with a thick and comfy scarf; comfortable attire for relaxing at home.
dialog.zh: 埃拉托的居家服饰/未讲述的故事。布料亲肤柔软，版型简洁修身，搭配厚实的毛绒围巾，让居家生活自在适宜。

description.en: Heidi has sent a thousand letters, ranging from her teenage dreams to heartfelt essays, keeping the replies in a box she carries around. She has met some of her recipients, but others she will never hear from again.
description.zh: 从她少女时的梦，到她流露真心的随笔，她寄出一千封信，将那些回音收在匣中，随身携带。信纸那一端的人，有些她已见到，有些不再回来。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/A Thousand Correspondences. A custom outfit made of fine and lightweight material, tailored based on Heidi's descriptions of her childhood summers. Though it feels different from how she remembers.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/书信零落。海蒂按照幼年时夏日出游的经历定做的服饰，材质轻盈，用料考究，只是穿上的感觉和记忆中已经不同。

description.en: 'My duty, my obligation, the shame of my nobility, and the golden cage that I oh so hate... this is my path.'
description.zh: “我的责任，我的义务，我高贵的耻辱，我切齿痛恨的金色囚笼……我的路。”

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Eine Variation. A traditional-style gown worn by every Graf Urtica, now draped over Ebenholz's shoulders. Orders apathetically seep from the tip of the staff, piercing through the sparse ensemble of nobles.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/变奏。历代乌提卡伯爵都曾穿过的传统式样礼服，如今正披在黑键肩头。律令自杖尖漠然流出，穿透贵族们空洞的合奏。

description.en: The wild hills form the staves, adorned by the notes of Gloompincers rolling helplessly in the wind. Czerny takes out pen and paper, writing down music with nature, believing that he can perfect its work.
description.zh: 荒野山丘隔出线谱层间，狂风带起无助的钳兽上下翻滚。车尔尼不由自主地掏出纸笔，与自然一同谱写乐曲。他坚信自己的修饰，能让这乐章更加完美。

dialog.en: Vitafield [Rewilder] Series Classics/Freeland Tuneseeker. Made with special materials with function in mind, perfect for meeting your various needs and weathering even the roughest conditions.
dialog.zh: 生命之地[识荒者/Rewilder]系列经典款/荒野寻音。采用特别材质制作，包含各项功能性设计，足以应对多种自然环境变化，满足各类需求。

description.en: This is not the first time Dorothy has taken on the role of the lord of the realm. To weave a fantasy, to direct an adventure, to achieve everyone else's hopes and dreams... She has always been like this.
description.zh: 这不是多萝西第一次扮演界域之主的角色。编织一段幻梦，主持一场冒险，实现大家的愿望，她向来如此。

dialog.en: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Dominions & Dogma' Custom Line/Hand of Destiny. This player shall be the will of the realm behind the story. She is neither a wicked god, nor a righteous spirit. All she does is let the players roll the dice.
dialog.zh: 巫异盛宴角色扮演剧本“异域信条”定制服饰/命运主宰。扮演者将是故事背后的界域意志。她并非邪神，亦非圣灵，她仅仅是让人们掷出骰子而已。

description.en: 'Tis a shame that the sunlight always shines upon this plow for far too short. But before that spring, she still did not understand such things.
description.zh: 只可惜，阳光能照在这把犁上的时间总是太短了。但这样的事，那个春天之前的她还不明白。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Noon Twilight. Absinthe's former school uniform. In Ursus, students wear their uniforms while exercising, resembling a field of neatly spaced seedlings behind a plow.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE子品牌 [昔时/Passe]系列精选款/正午余光。苦艾曾经的校服。在乌萨斯，学生穿校服出操，就像是跟在一把犁后面一行整齐的秧苗。

description.en: A duet of blue waves and sea breeze accompanied by the distant harmony of Fowlsbeasts. Without her recorder this time, she captures this wonderful summer song with her own ears.
description.zh: 碧波与海风的二重奏，搭配上远处羽兽的和声，这一次不用录音器，她用双耳记录下这首美妙的夏日之曲。

dialog.en: MARTHE Coral Coast Series/Carefree Holiday HD91. Comfortable and relaxed, breathable and lightweight, allowing you to enjoy the ultimate beach experience in a leisure environment.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]悠然假日系列泳衣91款。舒适放松，透气轻盈。让您可以在闲适的环境中享受最完美的沙滩体验。

description.en: She smiles as she says: 'Admiring all these lanterns with you tonight is warmer than the countless sunsets I've seen in the wilds.'
description.zh: 她笑着说，今夜一同欣赏的万千灯火，暖过曾经无数次观赏的荒野上的夕阳。

dialog.en: 0011 New Arrivals/By the Lamplight. Clothes Surfer wore while sightseeing during the lantern display. A dignified, elegant jacket is draped over an avant-garde red silk top, just like the wearer's cautious exterior hides a daring heart.
dialog.zh: 0011新款/共凭栏。寻澜游览节日灯会时的穿着。庄重典雅的外套搭配设计前卫的红绸衣，正如穿戴者持重的外表下有颗敢于冒险的心。

description.en: Minimalist fought all day to build his sandcastle, until at last the unfinished project was toppled by a stiff wind. Then he decided to take a break.
description.zh: 至简与他的沙堡事业斗争了大半天，一阵狂风吹来，未完工的宏伟杰作轰然倾塌。是时候放松一下了，他想。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HDm74. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]悠然假日系列泳衣74男款。舒适放松，透气轻盈。让您可以在闲适的环境中享受最完美的沙滩体验。

description.en: As line after line appears on the page, Pozëmka's thoughts drift to the night of her flight. The north wind brings the snow, while a bright fire burns in the fireplace. The gas lamp outside the tent flickers, unable to light her unpredictable path.
description.zh: 随着一行行文字在纸面落下，鸿雪的思绪也回到了逃亡途中的那个夜晚，北风挟卷着雪花，炉中的火焰滚烫，帐篷外的汽灯忽明忽暗，照不亮她叵测的前路。

dialog.en: Vitafield [Camper] Series Classics/Snowy Plains in Words. The layered fabric keeps the wearer warm, while the closed sleeves and pants keep the wind and snow out.
dialog.zh: 生命之地[行路人/Camper]系列经典款/字句中的雪原。多层复合面料有效提升保暖性能，紧收的袖口与裤脚最大程度阻挡风雪灌入，减缓热量流失。

description.en: Stronger drink will not make this fantasy any more real. It is unknown when the moons' light seeped into her dreams. Please pack away these curious thoughts properly, and don't let the Yanese read her half-written work.
description.zh: 再烈的酒也催生不出这等狂想，不知何时的月光误入了她的梦乡。请把这些奇想好好珍藏，不要叫炎国人见到半篇文章。

dialog.en: 0011 Yun Series New Arrivals/Beside Dreams. A sheer robe woven from Yanese muslin, paired with a magnolia hairpin. Returned to seclusion, brush in hand beside spring's window, the mortal realm meets ethereal dreams.
dialog.zh: 0011子品牌，韵系列新款/行梦侧畔。以炎国产出的柔纱织就的蝉翼罗衣，配有玉兰花发簪。墨笔春窗独回处，人世皆缥缈。

description.en: One day, the stars will fall to the earth, entering the eternal cycles of history. As for the power to flip the pages of the chronicle of fate, that lies in Pepe's hands.
description.zh: 星辰终会落入大地彼方，进入历史永恒往复的轮回，而翻动那命运纪事的力量，就在佩佩扬起的手中。

dialog.en: Misaligned Sightseer New Arrivals/Nuit of the Nightsky. Reed flutes and harps play in succession as jade lotuses gently float by. The night sky and melodic notes accompany Pepe in a moment where she has pushed everything else to the back of her mind.
dialog.zh: 错位巡礼系列新款/星移。芦苇笛和竖琴依次奏响，玉色的莲花轻轻浮荡。星空与音符陪伴在佩佩身边，此刻时光似乎已经将一切遗忘。

description.en: The hunter returns home, leaving the snows far behind him for a spell. This is a story about a reclusive youth's arrow, and his days in Sargon's rainforests.
description.zh: 猎人回到故乡，暂别与雪作伴的远方。萨尔贡的雨林，隐逸年少的箭与时光。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Shining Dew Series SDm09 for men. Tight-fitting, lightweight, breathable, and designed for the summer.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]灿阳朝露系列泳衣09男款。贴身、透气、轻便，专为夏日而生。

description.en: Quartz nearly fell over the first time she put on high heels, but she quickly got used to them, going back to her usual cool self in front of the camera—Oh no, she's not trying to look cool, she just doesn't know what expression to make! Go help her, quick!
description.zh: 第一次穿上高跟鞋时，石英差点摔倒，不过她很快就适应了，随即在镜头前恢复了冷静——哦不，看来她只是不知道该露出什么表情，快去帮帮她！

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Cover Mercenary. Clothes Quartz wore when she was invited to a magazine shoot. Minimalist yet stylish, daring yet elegant. A mercenary's aura adds a touch of mystique to this outfit.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/封面佣兵。石英被杂志摄影师邀请拍摄时的着装。简约时尚，大胆而不失风度，佣兵特有的气质也为这身装扮增添了一丝神秘的色彩。

description.en: He has spent a long time searching, yet is still where he started. The night before news arrived of a Nearl family swordstaff entering Leithanien, he could not help seeing some long-lost silhouettes through the torrential rain.
description.zh: 他长久寻索，他仍在原地。为一柄临光家剑枪的消息进入莱塔尼亚的前夜，透过雨幕，他无可避免地看到一些阔别已久的身影。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/W Dali. Młynar's attire as a knight-errant, wandering Kazimierz's plains and endless forests, the words engraved on the hilt of his sword not yet covered by useless trinkets.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE子品牌 [昔时/Passe]系列精选款/远路。玛恩纳以游侠身份走遍卡西米尔平原与林海时的装束，剑柄镌刻的一行小字尚未被冗余的装饰遮盖。

description.en: 'If you wish to go, they cannot stop you, but you wouldn't be able to live with yourself, would you? You cannot sit idly by while darkness becomes the master of all. So go, show them how a spear forged of light shall never break.'
description.zh: “如果你想走，他们拦不住你，但你就是无法忍耐，不是吗？你无法真正坐视黑暗成为一切的主宰。那便去吧，告诉他们，光铸成的枪，永远无法被折断。”

dialog.en: Iteration Provident/Roar Against the Wilds. Młynar's iteration from decision point F/3019226. The Black Riders have finally arrived at the Forgotten Plains, but the Hermit Knight chooses not to leave. Instead, he bars the way, alone.
dialog.zh: 命途迭代系列/苍茫怒号。玛恩纳在决策F/3019226中的迭代。黑色铁骑终于踏足被遗忘的原野，隐居的骑士没有选择离开，而是独自拦在他们面前。

description.en: A parting is not always caused by cruelty, just as a record does not always stem from remembrance.
description.zh: 告别未必因为残忍，记叙也未必全然是出于缅怀。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Scribing. The dust settles, the noise stops, and Nuova Volsinii finally quiets down. Here, the judge sheds her robes of the law, and with pen in hand, she writes of the turmoil that once rocked Siracusa.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/记叙。尘埃落定，喧哗止歇，新沃尔西尼终得一隅幽静。在这里，法官褪去司法者的衣装，她的笔下记录着叙拉古曾经的风云。

description.en: A judge must be ever vigilant and rational, but sometimes Lavinia allows herself to get lost in her cup. In her inebriated dreams, her mailbox is filled with letters and gifts of appreciation.
description.zh: 法官需要绝对的清醒与理智，但偶尔，拉维妮娅也会放任自己在杯中寻觅幻景。在醉梦中，她的门廊堆满了信笺与礼物，那是人们对她的认可与答谢。

dialog.en: Penance's casual outdoor wear/Occasionally Flushed. Sometimes, Lavinia will tolerate a hint of aqua between her otherwise pure black skirt and white coat.
dialog.zh: 斥罪独自外出时穿着的私服/偶尔醉陶。偶尔，在纯黑的长裙与纯白的外衣之间，拉维妮娅也愿意容许一抹明亮的水绿存在。

description.en: Highmore searches along the seashore. The warm light of the lantern shines upon countless tiny carapaces and bleached bones. They are stranded in the shallows, far, far from home in both distance and time. Highmore stops to listen to the sea breeze, and the nostalgic song it carries.
description.zh: 海沫在海滩上寻找着。温暖的灯光照亮了许多小小的甲壳、洁白的骨架，它们被困浅滩，远离家乡很久了。海沫驻足聆听，在海风中找到了她怀念的歌声。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Stranded. Recreation of clothes Highmore wore in her hometown. Custom-made flexible support materials keep the skirt puffy, while ribbons of pure white gently sway, giving form to the unknowable sea breeze.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/搁浅。再现了海沫居住在故乡时的穿着，特制的柔性支撑材料可以使裙子始终蓬起，洁白的飘带轻柔摆动，给无法捉摸的海风赋予了形状。

description.en: I arrive there as I arrive here when wandering mount and sea. The sun, moons and full blossoms gift their scents to you as they do me.
description.zh: 山海及身，行至他处亦此处。日月与华，馥赠卿心亦我心。

dialog.en: 0011 Custom Brand [Magnificence Curation] Series Collection/The Land With Me. Handmade by a Lungmen craftsman, inspired by Yanese landscape paintings. Thanks to weaving and dyeing techniques rarely seen in the modern age, mounts and seas emerge from the nichang's fabric, blurring fantasy and reality.
dialog.zh: 0011定制品牌[群瑰博辑]系列珍藏/及山海。龙门手工匠制，以炎国的长卷山水画为灵感，所用织染工艺如今已不常见，霓裳之间山海浮现，真幻难辨。

description.en: Raindrops drown out footsteps, the crowd comes and goes, and no one notices that she has stopped. It is an unremarkable city, but she remembers how long it took for her to cross the ruins and wastes to set foot here.
description.zh: 雨水淹没足迹，人群行色匆匆，无人留意她的驻足，这只是一座普通的城市。可她记得，从荒野到废墟，她走到这里用了好久，好久。

dialog.en: 0011 Tempest Series/The Road to Here. Loose-fitting coat that can envelop a young girl. The waterproof fabric makes it suitable for a rainy day.
dialog.zh: 0011子品牌，飙系列新款/来路。宽大的外套足以包裹住少女的身躯。由特种防水面料制作，满足都市雨天出行需求。

description.en: Stainless hesitatingly told his granny that he made these clothes 'all in his own time' with 'scrap materials'. Catherine didn't scold him, though. All she said was that his craftsmanship was still a bit shoddy.
description.zh: 白铁着急地向奶奶解释，自己是在“工作之余”，用“废弃的材料”打造的这些装备。凯瑟琳没有责怪他，只是告诉他，他的手艺还不够火候。

dialog.en: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Empty Crown. Outfit Stainless tailored for himself. With unique armor designs and bold weapon modifications, he has successfully recreated the image of a heroic knight in his heart.
dialog.zh: 音律联觉特供款/空心王冠。白铁为自己量身打造的套装，通过独特的铠甲设计与大胆的武器改装，成功还原了他心目中飒爽骑士的形象。

description.en: A seaside trip requires a speedboat, and a boat requires a trustworthy engineer. He's ready and waiting, so just say the word.
description.zh: 海边旅行需要一艘快艇，快艇需要一位可靠的工程师，他就在这里，等待着你的邀请。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Beach Guard Series GT003. Made with materials that are both durable and comfortable, this outfit ensures high performance in a variety of different conditions.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]沙滩护卫系列泳衣003款。采用耐磨材质，宽松舒适而又贴身透气。贴合人体，确保观赏性同时便于各种户外运动。

description.en: 'Just a quick spray here, here, aaand here. Purrfect! Yes, my graffiti's quite remeowkable, if I say so myself! Quick, snap a picture of us together!'
description.zh: “这里，这里，还有那里，都喷上喵。完成了，我的涂鸦果然非同凡响，快来一起合张影喵！”

dialog.en: Monster Hunter Collaborative Series/Fly Into the Street. The Felynes are amped with excitement for getting some Terra-style fresh fits on, and spray paint-filled cans especially pique their curiosity. Noir Corne senses something big and bad's about to go down.
dialog.zh: 《怪物猎人》合作服装/跃上街头。艾露猫们对于换上泰拉风格的新衣服感到格外兴奋，尤其对罐装喷漆充满好奇。黑角察觉到即将大事不妙了。

description.en: The new leaves float the boat, while the flower blooms on.
description.zh: 半池新叶载舟过，一点菡萏照云开。

dialog.en: 0011 Yun Series New Arrivals/Away From Dust. Made by expert Yanese tailors, the stylish, narrow-sleeved robe is cool and comfortable. Jieyun wore it while visiting Yan's rivers and lakes.
dialog.zh: 0011子品牌，韵系列新款/伴青莲。炎国巧匠设计了窄袖宽袍，采用时尚的拼接和剪裁，更注重舒适与清凉。截云穿着它游历到了炎国的水乡。

description.en: Lucilla hypothesizes that there are yet more marine species out there that are being driven to extinction by the Seaborn, but she does not have the leisure to grieve for them for long. She tries to dig up more information, all the better to make traps for capturing Seaborn. She's already got plenty of new ideas.
description.zh: 海霓猜想，也许还有更多海洋生物正在海嗣的影响下走向灭绝，她无暇为此哀伤太久。她尝试挖掘出更多信息，以制作诱捕海嗣的陷阱。她已经有了不少新设想。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Tidal Bore. Clothes Lucilla wore when looking around an exhibit about extinct marine species. The eye is led down the outfit by the changes in color mimicking seawater at different depths, punctuated by unique patterns to form a calm, tranquil ensemble.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/翻涌。海霓在参观已灭绝海洋物种主题展览时的穿着。服装整体以不同深度下海水的变化作为视觉线索，搭配独特的纹样点缀，显得宁静沉稳。

description.en: Even if no one knows, they silently gather knowledge and experience, never stopping their steps. Friends are the magic that keeps them going.
description.zh: 即使无人知晓，也要默默积攒知识和经验，绝不停下脚步，而朋友正是让她们能坚持下去的魔法。

dialog.en: MY LITTLE PONY Crossover Apparel - Magic of Knowledge. Late at night, they are still swimming in the magical world of knowledge. They shoulder their due responsibilities for themselves and for those around them.
dialog.zh: 小马宝莉合作服装/求知的魔法。深夜之时，她们还在知识的魔法世界中遨游。她们背负起应尽的责任，为了自己，也为了身边的人。

description.en: My gaze falls upon clearest ice and coldest jade, arrayed hither and tither. The Qionghua blooms of the celestial realm know my heart, and refuse to wither. —Inscribed in Lin Yühsia's study
description.zh: 望见多少冰清，多少玉寒，瑶台琼花知我意，未阑珊。——题于林雨霞书房

dialog.en: 0011 Custom Brand [Magnificence Curation] Series Collection/Heavenly Mirage. Recreation of a Lungmen VIP's childhood fantasy. She enters the Xians' abode, dressed in celestial garb, skirts dark as kohl, jade pure as ice, face austere, serene. Transcendent.
dialog.zh: 0011定制品牌[群瑰博辑]系列珍藏/列瑶台。复现了龙门一位大客户幼时的绮梦。少女步于瑶台之间，得仙人披戴，着裙似黛，见玉如冰，意趣超然。

description.en: 'Lin the Violet' handles her accounts, while 'Fins the Colorful' swim about in circles. You and I are neither Lin nor Fin, so how can we know of what joy and pain lie within?
description.zh: “紫色的林”处理账簿，“多彩的鳞”环绕游弋。你我既非林也非鳞，又怎能知道其中的苦乐呢？

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA137. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]夏卉系列泳衣137款。参考少女的身材和体质，采用天然材质制成。追求今夏最领先的设计潮流。

description.en: Warmy trudges onwards and onwards, all so she can have the best bread in the neighborhood, though she ends up lost. Falling snow flutters through the night sky, and the scent of the bread in her hand cutting through the chilly air proves irresistible. Forget it, let's sit down and eat it while it's hot!
description.zh: 为了买到这个街区最好吃的面包，温米越走越远，以至于迷失了方向。夜雪纷飞，面包的香气在寒冷中越发诱人，算了，先坐下来享受一口刚出炉的美味吧！

dialog.en: Cambrian 1100 Winter New Arrivals/Warm Velvet At the Corner. A warm coat, both thick and lightweight, winter boots for icy, snow-laden roads, and a white knit cap complete with a bright bow. Proof you don't have to sacrifice warmth for cuteness.
dialog.zh: 寒武纪1100冬季新款/街角暖绒。厚外套轻便温暖，雪地靴足以应对积雪结冰路面，搭配纯白毛绒小帽，以蝴蝶结作为特色点缀，保暖的同时也不失可爱。

description.en: Shapeless sword, formless air, sights of seasons also bare. Guests of groves and guests of tea, snow and wind shall come to thee.
description.zh: 剑无形，气无形，满目春秋亦无形。竹是客，茶是客，万般风雪皆是客。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Courtesy. Lungmen's latest trend, seamlessly blending ancient and modern Yanese charm. To Qiubai, the art of tea and the sword are the same in that both require full attention and to know when to stop.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/礼遇。龙门最新风潮服饰，完美融合了现代时尚与炎国古韵。仇白知晓仗剑与待茶的相通之处——既要全神贯注，又要懂得适可而止。

description.en: How long can an old tree stand in the wind and sand? How far can one little boat go? Put your sword away in your rucksack along with the autumn sights.
description.zh: 一株古木能在风沙中伫立多久？一叶小舟又能去往多远的地方？剑客暂且放下剑，将秋色一同装入行囊。

dialog.en: Brand Collaborative Series/Wine-flushed is Woods of Rime. Wind-proof and wear-resistant with a clean, slim fit that's easy to move in. Inspired by the northwest poplar forests.
dialog.zh: 品牌合作服装/霜林醉。服装选料十分注重防风性与耐磨性，剪裁利落合身，不影响活动。据说服装造型的灵感来源于西北部的胡杨林。

description.en: With a letter home, the bell's toll resounds; Across a thousand li, two moons share the same sky.
description.zh: 乡书已寄思铎声，千里长空共月明。

dialog.en: 0011 Yun Series New Arrivals/Moon under the Pines. Classic Yanese clothes, mixing tradition with modern craftsmanship. Wind Chimes leans against a tree, watching the moonlight shine in the water, her skirt like a shimmering ripple. What will you dream of tonight?
dialog.zh: 0011子品牌，韵系列新款/松间月。炎国经典服饰，传统意趣与现代工艺完美结合。铎铃斜倚青松，看月映水中，波光与裙摆微荡——今夜什么会入梦？

description.en: 'That expression on Ines's face—that crisp, cool distance—is simply a perfect fit for the dreamy ambiance this shoot needs. Just how does she do it?' 'Hah, bet she's thinking up ways to kill you all later.'
description.zh: “伊内丝小姐的表情，那股清冷的疏离感，简直完美契合了这个主题所需要的梦幻氛围，她是怎么做到的？”“哈，大概是她在盘算着怎么把你们杀干净吧。”

dialog.en: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Melodic Flutter. Clothes Ines wore when posing for a music-themed portrait. The magnificent dress is a perfect match for the music, as the butterflies dance to the melody, bringing the reverie to life in vivid detail.
dialog.zh: 音律联觉特供款/蝶舞华章。伊内丝受邀拍摄音乐主题写真时所穿的服装。华美礼服与音乐艺术完美结合，彩蝶与旋律一同舞动，将绝美梦幻的氛围展现得淋漓尽致。

description.en: The demon who manipulates shadow reveals herself amongst the drifting embers, inscribing fear above the wailing plains.
description.zh: 操控阴影的恶魔自飘散的余烬中显形，将恐惧印刻在哀嚎的原野之上。

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Under the Flaming Dome. As artillery splits the heavens, all is as it ever was. Ines arrives at the city, ready to rewrite Kazdel's once inevitable ending of destruction.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/燃烧天穹下。炮火弋空，崩天裂地，一切好似旧日重现。伊内丝来到城下，她将改写看似注定的结局，使卡兹戴尔免于被毁灭的命运。

description.en: Even during more laid-back days, Hoederer still takes the measure of his experiences.
description.zh: 即便是在那些轻松的日子里，赫德雷也在丈量着自己的见闻。

dialog.en: Misaligned Sightseer New Arrivals/Courtyard of Neka. Out of curiosity, Hoederer knocks open the door to an ancient courtyard. He stands before a tranquil pond, engraving the beauty he stumbled upon into his memory.
dialog.zh: 错位巡礼系列新款/沉思之庭。赫德雷怀着好奇之心叩开了一处古老庭院的大门，他站在平静的水池前，铭记这偶遇的胜景。

description.en: 'All my friends watching out there, this is your favorite Streamer U! Look! Check out where I'm coming at you live from! What do you think? This must be that 'cloud streaming' everyone's been talking about lately!'
description.zh: “观众朋友们早上好，我是大家的主播U哦！快看，我在哪里给大家开播呢？怎么样，这一定就是最近大家常说的‘云直播’吧！”

dialog.en: Brand Collaborative Series/Stream Above The Clouds. She wakes up atop a cloud in her favorite childhood dress, surrounded by all her friends, and through her daze senses a freedom she hasn't felt in a long time—wait, why's she streaming with her phone?!
dialog.zh: 品牌合作服装/云上直播间。穿着儿时喜欢的裙子在云上醒来，看见朋友们环绕着自己，她恍惚间感受到了久违的自由——但她为什么掏出手机开始直播了？！

description.en: The weather vane points to today's destination. Her felt friends escort her there, while every nameless roadside flower blooms among her idle thoughts. She may soon leave again, but her time here will be forever preserved in poetry.
description.zh: 风向标选出了今日的目的地，她的毛毡朋友们簇拥着她，沿途每朵无名的花都开满她的遐思。她或许很快就将再次离开，但诗歌会让这段岁月永不褪色。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Sent from Ognisko. Clothes Viviana wore on a short return trip to Ognisko, a pure linen dress paired with a knitted shawl. With these, she wanders the city of shady trees and the sounds of artisans.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/寄自奥格尼斯科。薇薇安娜重返奥格尼斯科小住时的着装。纯手工亚麻长裙搭配针织披肩，她就这样漫步在满城的林荫与匠作声中。

description.en: Finish up your workout, enjoy the gentle light of the sunset, have some fruit. Now that's what I call a good time!
description.zh: 运动结束，享受柔和的夕阳光照，再配上一份水果，真是太棒啦！

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA083. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]夏卉系列泳衣083款。参考少女的身材和体质，采用天然材质制成。追求今夏最领先的设计潮流。

description.en: Her gaze is not solely focused on a future of bitter frost. She also peeks at a warm day spent frolicking through the forest.
description.zh: 她不仅注视着凛冽的未来，也能窥见在林间休憩的一抹暖阳。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Midskog Fika. Celebratory dress prepared by Valarqvin for a rare day of melted snow. Adorned with bright grass and flower motifs, which are infused with beautiful meaning in Sami.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/林间暖阳。凛视为冰雪消融的难得时节准备的庆典服装，明媚的青草与鲜花纹饰，在萨米蕴含着美好寓意。

description.en: A sudden burst of daylight, and she dances with the dust.
description.zh: 天光乍现，她与飞尘共舞。

dialog.en: Striker Series/Dawnbreak. A product of Raythean Industries, made for mechanized combat, combining fashionable colors with punk style. Multi-purpose bandoliers ensure efficiency even in complex environments, providing absolute freedom.
dialog.zh: 推进者系列/破晓。雷神工业出品，为机动作战定制的服饰，新潮配色与朋克元素融合。多功能武装带保障复杂环境作战效率，干员行动时拥有绝对的自由。

description.en: Almond looks around her. Sesame balls, green peas, biscuits, jujubes... All in all, a very sweet dream. But she soon realizes she's at the center of the platter. 'Hey, am I one of the snacks—?!'
description.zh: 杏仁看向周围，芝麻球、青豆、饼干、甜枣……真是个香甜的美梦呀。但她马上发现，自己正位于食盒中央。“咦，难道我也是其中之一？！”

dialog.en: 0011 New Arrivals/Almond Platter. Outfit Almond wore during a field mission in Yan. Deep crimsons are a natural complement to the festive atmosphere, while the long skirt and wide sleeves bring out her latent cuteness.
dialog.zh: 0011新款/“杏仁”拼盘。杏仁在炎国执行外勤任务时的装扮。大红色调与节日喜庆的氛围互相映衬，长裙宽袖则充分挖掘出了杏仁的可爱潜力。

description.en: New day, new job. Enis rushes down. Nothing can stop him from meeting life head-on.
description.zh: 又是新的一天，又是新的工作。埃尼斯飞驰而下，没有什么能阻挡他迎接生活的脚步。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Vibrant. Clothes Enis wears when he's in a good mood. Specially chosen for him by his family. Close-fitting, snug and easy to move around in.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/动感。埃尼斯心情好的时候会选择的着装。这是他的家人特意为他挑选的服饰，贴身舒适，便于活动。

description.en: The fowlbeasts were flocking around the 'Scarecrow', so Verdant decided to rest a little in the plaza, taking in the bright sunshine and petals wafting in the wind. Not a bad combo, he thought.
description.zh: 羽兽群围住了“稻草人”，维荻决定在广场上逗留片刻。阳光明媚，花瓣飞舞，他不讨厌这种感觉。

dialog.en: Unveiling of Devotion Series New Arrivals/Rose Rider. Outfit Verdant wears when passing along the love of others. A casual and leisurely ensemble. The red jacket and the design on the jeans go well with the festive roses.
dialog.zh: 待予花冠系列新款/玫瑰骑手。维荻在为他人传递爱意时的装扮。整体风格休闲随意，红色的外套、牛仔裤上的图案都与节日的玫瑰相得益彰。

description.en: After the transfiguration of his tuba, Bassline lets out a rare smile of pure joy as he flies through the air with everyone's help. With a wave of his wand, stars appear in the sky.
description.zh: 低音号改造成功后，在大家的帮助下飞到半空的深律少见地露出了那种单纯快乐的笑容。他挥舞手中的法杖，于是短暂地出现了一小片星空。

dialog.en: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Grimoire of Dark Law' Custom Line/Starry Night Sky. He plays the role of the guide showing the hero the way. The Golden Movement has long since faded, but the stars he shoots will forever point true north.
dialog.zh: 巫异盛宴角色扮演剧本“暗律魔典”定制服饰/夜空星芒。扮演者将是协助勇者前进的向导。金色的乐章已然逝去，但他放出的星星永远会指明方向。

description.en: With fashion experts' guidance, Tomimi's trying a new style. We'll have to see—can it get something tickling in Gavial's mind?
description.zh: 接受了时尚达人们的指点，特米米正在尝试新造型。不知道能不能让嘉维尔眼前一亮呢？

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Silent Night Series DN04. The material is light, soft, breathable and durable. The latest design that is as enchanting as it is elegant.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]静谧午夜系列泳衣04款。材质轻便透气，舒适耐磨。采用尖端设计，神秘典雅，高贵。

description.en: In times like these, when ice and snow rage outside the window, you should get a cup of hot cocoa, write love-filled letters to your wife and daughter, and throw in a comment on how cute the souvenir pajamas you gave them are. In short, he is rather pleased with himself.
description.zh: 窗外冰雪融融，这时就应该喝一杯热可可，再给夫人和女儿写封情意满满的信，夸赞自己给她们挑选的纪念品睡衣套装是多么地可爱——总之他自己非常满意。

dialog.en: Harold's home attire/Inviting Snow. A burdenbeast neck pillow, burdenbeast pajamas, burdenbeast slippers. A full burdenbeast ensemble, very popular in Kjerag right now!
dialog.zh: 哈洛德的居家服饰/邀雪。脖戴驮兽颈枕，身穿驮兽睡衣，脚踩驮兽拖鞋。驮兽一切，谢拉格时下最流行！

skinName.en: The Shadow of the Dark Moon

description.en: It's rare to see Degenbrecher with such a furrowed brow and intense concentration on her face. After a long while, she finally finds the perfect angle, navigating the witch hat past her horns so it can sit atop her head. She breathes a sigh of relief.
description.zh: 很少能看到锏如此眉头紧皱，苦苦思索的样子。许久之后，她终于找到一个合适的角度，把魔女帽横过来又竖过去地穿过双角戴在了头上。她长舒了一口气。

dialog.en: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Grimoire of Dark Law' Custom Line/The Shadow of the Dark Moon. She plays the role of the witch guarding the grimoire. The tome is of no use to her. Instead, it is her sword that renders her unstoppable: 'Come, try to defeat me.'
dialog.zh: 巫异盛宴角色扮演剧本“暗律魔典”定制服饰/暗月的影子。扮演者将是保护魔典的魔女。魔典于她并无用处，她凭长剑便无人可挡：“你可以试着战胜我。”

description.en: Ray's not entirely sure what 'stage decorations' are supposed to be, but after consulting with Lanns and Potlid, she decided to use a mine excavator as the 'main visual' thingamabob.
description.zh: 莱伊不是很明白什么叫做“舞台布置”，在咨询了兰娜和小锅盖之后，她决定用矿场里的挖掘机来做那个名为“视觉主体”的东西。

dialog.en: Monster Siren Records Idol Project 'Shining Steps' Promotional Costume/Dreaming High. With high-grade sandbeast feed on a Rim Billiton regional audition's prize list, Ray doesn't mind taking on a new challenge.
dialog.zh: 塞壬唱片偶像企划《闪耀阶梯》特供服饰/梦幻高空。为了赢得雷姆必拓地区海选奖品单上的特别奖品高级沙地兽兽粮，莱伊觉得偶尔挑战一下新领域也不错。

description.en: The humid air brings the warmth of summer, and the faint chirping of insects colors the peaceful moment. Riding her bicycle from the bustling beach to a hidden resting spot, she lets her thoughts and memories flow quietly in the scenery.
description.zh: 潮湿的空气捎来夏日的温度，微弱的虫鸣渲染平静的时刻。骑着单车从人声鼎沸的海边来到隐秘的休息处，她任自己的思绪与回忆在景色中静静流淌。

dialog.en: MARTHE Coral Coast Series/Summer Flower FA098. Made from natural materials tailored to a young girl's figure and build. Pursuing this summer's top design trends.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]夏卉系列泳衣098款。参考少女的身材和体质，采用天然材质制成。追求今夏最领先的设计潮流。

description.en: 'Why is it that the crops Wanqing harvests always turn out so good?' 'They don't just get a lot of natural sunlight, they get the light of his pearly whites too. With that much sunshine, how can you not end up tasty as heck?'
description.zh: “为什么万顷种的作物总是长得那么好？”“作物们不仅吸收到了自然界的阳光，还吸收到了来自他笑容的阳光，能长得不好吗？”

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Tons of Sunshine. Clothes Wanqing wears for work. White singlet, tight-fitting yet breathable pants, and a dirt-repellent apron. A simple ensemble that becomes harmony itself on him.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/万顷阳光。万顷在工作时的打扮。纯白的背心、贴身透气的裤子、使用防污布料特制的围裙，简单的搭配，在他身上显得无比协调。

description.en: A chivalrous young swordsman has come to the Tianshi Bureaus. It is said he traversed the lands and learned much on his travels, but to hear a story from him, you must first duel him. Learning of this, the young Tianshis rolled up their sleeves, thinking of asking him for 'guidance'.
description.zh: 天师府来了一位少年侠客，据说走南闯北，见多识广，但若是想从他那里听一段故事，就得和他比试一场。年轻天师们于是摩拳擦掌，要去向他“请教”。

dialog.en: 0011 New Arrivals/Youthful Journey. Outfit Zuo Le wore when using the Tianshi Bureaus' training grounds. Integrated with elements of the Tianshi gown, enabling mobility while highlighting his youthful spirit.
dialog.zh: 0011新款/少年游。左乐借天师府的宝地练武时的装扮。在常服中融入了天师袍的元素，满足了方便行动的基本需求，也更显少年意气。

description.en: A humble piece on the board, his path diverged from all others. Adversity hardened him, gifted him growth; at the decisive moment, he would break the deadlock.
description.zh: 棋盘之上，他本是轻子，但在所有棋子之中，他的走法最为特别。时光困少年于逆境，亦赠少年以成长，关键时刻，他会是破局之子。

dialog.en: Test Collection Series/Quiet Move. A master move made by Zuo Le. He has played his own shadow across boards and grids. Over time, he learned that while the patterns are many, the wisdom behind them is one.
dialog.zh: 忒斯特收藏系列/无息破局。左乐走出的一步好棋。从纵横十九道至黑白六十四格，执刀者与己身对弈已久，他逐渐明白：棋局万殊，棋理一揆。

description.en: Fragrant dumplings of jade, lightly wound in brightest thread. Mount and stream bright and green, around orchids do we tread.
description.zh: 玉团流香，彩线轻缠。山水澄碧，闲步芳兰。

dialog.en: 0011 Yun Series/Fragrant Pace. A jacket and skirt woven by Dahuang's weavers for the festivities, gifted to Grain Buds to wear as she wanders the fields. Around her, the wonders of nature. By her side, fine friends to be sure.
dialog.zh: 0011子品牌，韵系列新款/步芳兰。大荒城织匠为佳节良辰新制的裙襦，赠予小满，随她去到田间漫游。山水在她身边，伙伴在她左右。

description.en: Safehouse, safe harbor, outlet for creativity and expression.
description.zh: 安全屋，避风港，创意与表达的一言堂。

dialog.en: Rainbow Six Collaborative Series/Safehouse. A set of clothes that Ela bought at the market. Light and comfortable, it is her favorite outfit in the safehouse. She particularly likes how the local hat looks on her.
dialog.zh: 彩虹六号合作服装/密室。艾拉在某地市场上购买的私服，她在安全屋中休息时已习惯了这套服装。轻便舒适，随心所欲。她尤其喜欢当地帽子在自己头上的样子。

description.en: Perhaps the world is a maze of mirrors, looking very different when a few rays of light go through it.
description.zh: 也许世界正是一座光学的迷宫，偏折几束光，它就会变得不一样。

dialog.en: Rainbow Six Collaborative Series/Mirrormaze. Iana's casual outfit for her free time. She has changed into a pair of shorts, hoping that the sun here is different. Perhaps she will not need her hood.
dialog.zh: 彩虹六号合作服装/镜廊。双月在闲暇时为自己准备的便装。她特意换了一条短裤，想要体验这世界那也许不同的阳光。若真能如她所愿，兜帽也可以不必戴上。

description.en: Time is the roadside exhibit. Visitors walk toward the exit, connected to the future.
description.zh: 岁月是路旁的展览，观众步向出口，出口通向未来。

dialog.en: Rainbow Six Collaborative Series/Exhibition. Picked by Doc based on practical requirements, offering protection against wind, dust, and cold as he goes to the next place that needs him. Of that, there is never a shortage.
dialog.zh: 彩虹六号合作服装/展览。医生根据实际需要挑选的服装。防风，防尘，保暖。他整理好行装，便去往下一个需要他的地方。这种地方实在太多，他很少能停下来。

description.en: Dressed in beautiful clothes, and flying a kite during a beautiful spring day. Now, these last wishes were complete. Lutonada wants to hop down from the wall, but she didn't expect a fowlbeast to nip at her bracelet. She hesitates for a moment, before deciding to stay a little longer.
description.zh: 穿上漂亮的衣裳，在春天放风筝——这样，这个遗愿就算完成了。露托想要跳下墙头离开，不曾想一只羽兽叼住了她的手绳。她犹豫了一会儿，决定为它逗留片刻。

dialog.en: 0011 Yun Series/Whispered Longing. Clothes Lutonada wore while taking a spring walk through Yan. An organic mixture of traditional and modern elements form a refreshing, graceful style that does not sacrifice charm. All sorts of accessories add to the cuteness.
dialog.zh: 0011子品牌，韵系列新款/寄遥思。露托在炎国踏青时的装扮。传统与现代元素的有机融合，风格清新优雅又不失活泼，各种配饰更是增添了可爱风味。

description.en: Red and black may be the typical Kazdel colors, but for some reason, after wearing these clothes, Odda finds his steps much, much lighter.
description.zh: 黑与红依然是卡兹戴尔的底色，但不知怎的，穿上这身衣服后，奥达感觉自己的步伐轻盈了不少。

dialog.en: 0011 Tempest Series New Arrivals/Candy Strike. Clothes Odda changed into to fit the neighborhood event's theme. Featuring bright colors and breathable materials, suited for anyone who enjoys outdoor exercise.
dialog.zh: 0011子品牌，飙系列新款/糖果暴击。奥达为配合街区的限时主题而换上的装束。色彩鲜艳明亮，用料贴身透气，非常适合喜欢户外运动的人。

description.en: 'I once danced, chasing the flame, but they feared me, and ultimately abandoned me. They have forgotten what sort of power hides in the dark. Come with me. If this thousand years without night has an end, I will cut down each and every sun myself.'
description.zh: “我曾逐火而舞，但它们惧怕我，并最终背弃了我。它们忘记了暗色苦痛中藏着何等力量。追随我吧，倘若这暌违千年的黑夜有个尽头，我将亲手斩落所有太阳。”

dialog.en: Iteration Provident/Phototaxis. Ascalon's iteration from decision point F/3019226. She bids it stay for the sake of the lives of countless unbelievers, but the Seventh Sun is still determined to fall.
dialog.zh: 命途迭代系列/趋光之暗。阿斯卡纶在决策F/3019226中的迭代。她以万千不信者的性命挽留，第七个太阳却依旧决然地落下。

description.en: Pain, rage, sorrow, joy... Logos silently sits at the peak of the spire, allowing the music to wash over him, allowing the emotions to envelop him. Finally, he picks up his pen, a composition rising from his heart.
description.zh: 苦痛、愤怒、悲伤、喜悦……逻各斯静静地坐在高塔之巅，任由音乐流经他，任由情绪包裹他。最终，他提起笔，一首乐曲已经在他的心中浮现。

dialog.en: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Radiant Serenity. Clothes Logos wore as a guest at the Liches' spire. Golden moons and stars adorn a base of blue-gray fabric, graceful yet profound.
dialog.zh: 音律联觉特供款/辉煌的静谧。逻各斯作客巫妖们的高塔时的装束。在灰蓝色礼服的基础上，融入星月之金辉作为装点，优雅而深邃。

description.en: Ere twilight's fall, we bid farewell in the darkness.
description.zh: 直到暮色垂落，我们在黑暗中告别。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Condolence. Attire worn by Civilight Eterna during her Deep Dive into Theresa's data. Through the veil of time, she spots memories sealed by the dead.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE子品牌 [昔时/Passe]系列精选款/追悼。魔王在特蕾西娅的数据中深潜时的装束。透过时光的面纱，她望见亡者已封缄的记忆。

description.en: 'What caused us to lose our voices is still unclear, but no doubt it has close ties to Originium. Go, my sisters, go to Aefanyl's side.'
description.zh: “让我们失声的源头还不明确，但它必然和源石息息相关。走吧，姐妹们，去哀珐尼尔的身边。”

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Primordial Ode. PhonoR-0 is draped in the lace veil her sisters embroidered with incantations, singing an ode above the Valley. The Banshees have finally found their voice once more.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/最初的颂歌。PhonoR-0身披姐妹们为她缝制的那条绣着咒文的蕾丝头纱，在河谷之上唱响颂歌。女妖们终于找回了自己的声音。

description.en: The curtain falls without a single mistake during the performance. Even without a pen, Underflow is able to freely analyze and connect all the details. She enjoyed this holistic work, and gives it her sincere admiration.
description.zh: 戏剧落幕，舞台上的每一个步骤都毫无差错。无需笔尖，深巡也能自如地将所有细节串联检阅，她享受着这无缺的美感，由衷地为之赞叹。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Laminar Flow. Clothes Underflow wore to the theater in Ægir. Lightweight armor and a tailored skirt come together to form a balance between comfort and defense.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/层流。深巡在阿戈尔观看戏剧演出时的穿着。轻质甲胄与剪裁得体的长裙拼搭结合，兼顾了穿戴舒适性与防护功能。

description.en: As you pass through the gloomy corridors of the Hospital of Horror and creep ever closer to its secrets, the roar of a chainsaw behind you reminds you that nobody can escape from its terrors.
description.zh: 恐怖医院的走廊笼罩在阴森的氛围下，当你一步步走近秘密的时候，身后响起的链锯声就会发出提醒，没有人能从恐惧之中逃离。

dialog.en: Storyboard Breaker Serialized Comic [Beyond Redemption] Final Character Art/The Chainsaw Nurse. Outfit of the nurse from the Hospital of Horror in the story. Her gigantic chainsaw and conspicuous sutures are proof enough that she, the first masterpiece, lives on to this very day.
dialog.zh: 破格视界连载漫画《无从救赎》角色定稿/链锯陪护者。故事中恐怖医院护士的着装。巨大的链锯和显眼的缝合线，正是她身为第一个杰作永生至今的证明。

description.en: Even when in trouble, they open their hearts and candidly reveal their truest selves. They have always been this honest.
description.zh: 即使身处困境，她们也会敞开心扉，坦荡荡地展露出最真实的自己。她们一直都是这样诚实。

dialog.en: MY LITTLE PONY Crossover Apparel - Straightforward and Honest One. They are passionate and reliable, like sweet-smelling apples under the sun, constantly infecting others with smiles and giving everyone courage.
dialog.zh: 小马宝莉合作服装/率直诚实之人。她们热情又可靠，像阳光下散发清香气味的苹果一样，时刻用笑容感染他人，给予大家勇气。

description.en: Though her journey to her next objective feels like it is endless, she believes every step she takes is infused with meaning.
description.zh: 前往下个目标的旅程似乎无穷无尽，但她坚信踏出的每一步都有着非凡的意义。

dialog.en: Achievement Star Collection/The Next Side Quest. Clothes Papyrus picked during character creation in 'Dark Age of Terra'. She never stops running about the game, recording all the stories she can find in this new world.
dialog.zh: 成就之星系列/下一个任务。莎草在游戏《苍影历年纪》中所创建角色的着装。莎草在游戏中不断奔走，记录着这个别样天地里的所有故事。

description.en: Time is not a thing you can buy with gems, no matter how many of them you offer. It is for this reason that Sand Reckoner is willing to enjoy this little break.
description.zh: 再多宝石也无法成为交换时间的筹码，正因如此，衡沙才愿意享受此刻的小憩。

dialog.en: Misaligned Sightseer New Arrivals/Horus' Rest. Lazvar understands that even clockwork fowlbeasts occasionally need a break from yellow sands and clamorous crowds, finding a moment's rest on branches.
dialog.zh: 错位巡礼系列新款/憩羽。拉恕尔明白，即便是发条羽兽，偶尔也需要远离黄沙与喧嚣，暂歇于枝头上。

description.en:
'Balanced Diet General Laios, Disciplined Lifestyle General Chilchuck, and Moderate Exercise General Senshi! Heed my command—Devour them!'
Marcille makes sure to practice her more dramatic lines before every performance.
description.zh:
“均衡饮食将军莱欧斯、规律生活将军齐尔查克和适当运动将军森西！听我的号令——吃掉它们！”
在正式演出之前，玛露西尔努力地练习情景剧的台词。

dialog.en: Brand Collaborative Series/Terra & Traveller. Clothes Marcille wears when telling stories of her adventures aboard Rhodes Island. She acts as she imagines the Lunatic Magician would, summoning several familiars with a wave of her hand. Some of them even look like our operators!
dialog.zh: 品牌合作服装/泰拉冒险。玛露西尔在罗德岛讲述冒险故事时的装束。她扮演了她想象的狂乱魔法师，挥手就能造出数只使魔，甚至还有干员模样的！

description.en: His body is Ægir's future taking form. That future may end up as his shackles... but Ulpianus does not hesitate.
description.zh: 阿戈尔的未来正在他身上成形。那未来或许会成为他的枷锁——但乌尔比安毫不迟疑。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Staring into the Abyss. Clothes Ulpianus wore when taking charge of the Abyssal Hunter Program. The consul's transformation is already complete, yet the ceremonial sword in his hand has taken on a great weight.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE子品牌 [昔时/Passe]系列精选款/注目深渊。乌尔比安刚主持“深海猎人”项目时的装束。执政官明明已经完成了改造，可手中的仪仗剑反而变得沉重。

description.en: Walking under the arches, crossing over the small bridge, and turning yet another corner amidst the shrubs. But no matter where she may be in the garden, she is always the most mesmerizing of the flowers.
description.zh: 穿过拱廊，跨过小桥，又在灌木林中走过拐角。但不管身在园中的何处，她都是繁花中最引人注目的那一朵。

dialog.en: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Blooming Reverie. Satin dress Nymph chose for herself. The fluttering hem complements her flower-shaped updo, turning her into an elegant fairy dancing in the garden, lively and graceful.
dialog.zh: 音律联觉特供款/繁花梦幻谈。妮芙为自己挑选的缎面礼服。飘然的淡色裙摆映着花朵状束发，让她像于花园中翩翩舞动的仙灵，轻盈而欢快。

description.en: After trying the desserts Nymph brought along, there is not a soul who is not wondering about the secret behind their incredible sweetness.
description.zh: 尝过了妮芙带来的甜点之后，没有人不好奇那甜至心底的奥秘。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Sweetness to the Heart. Outfit Nymph put together in preparation for the tea party. Light and comfortable, with just the right amount of sweetness. Maybe she has her own sugary secret recipe?
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/甜美配方。妮芙为即将到来的糕点派对做了精心的准备，轻盈舒适，甜度刚好。或许，她有什么独特的甜美秘方？

description.en: No need to rush to handle the sacrifices the nurse nabbed without a sweat. Once he's done with maintaining the mannequin, his exhilarating and delightful grand experiment shall begin again.
description.zh: 不必急着先去处理那个被护士轻松抓住的牺牲品，等维护完人偶，他那令人兴奋而愉悦的伟大实验，就会再一次开始。

dialog.en: Storyboard Breaker Serialized Comic [Beyond Redemption] Final Character Art/Under Surgical Lights. Outfit of the doctor from the Hospital of Horror in the story. With bloodstained bandages and a wrapped-up mannequin, the mad doctor picks up his scalpel, searching for the secrets of the human body beyond ethical reach.
dialog.zh: 破格视界连载漫画《无从救赎》角色定稿/无影灯下。故事中恐怖医院医师的着装。绷带上的血迹，裹带下的人偶，疯医生拿起手术刀，探寻着背离道德的躯体之秘。

description.en: With feet dipped in vibrant color, and a heart filled with blossoms, she gracefully opens her fan, singing a song of newborn hope.
description.zh: 脚踏一泓艳彩，心念一片花开，她轻轻展开折扇，将新生的希望唱于曲中。

dialog.en: 0011 New Arrivals/An Opera of Flowers. Costume Philae wore while taking part in a traditional Yanese opera. A pale pink robe boasts sleeves of pure white, drawing in even graceful butterflies, who flutter about and rest by her side.
dialog.zh: 0011新款/花绸曲。菲莱体验炎国传统戏曲演出时的装扮。着一件淡粉长衫，挥两条素色水袖，就连翩翩彩蝶也被吸引，在她身边环绕、停歇。

description.en: 'Been learning for so long. Now I can finally go take on all those strong guys. Yeah, relax. I'll be a little civilized about it.'
description.zh: “学这么久，总算能去会会那些强者了。嗯，放心，我会用文明点的方式的。”

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Gorgeous Flower. Flint's attire when she set out on a lone journey, a 'Catastrophe Messenger' by her own declaration. Before, her fists only knew Acahualla and Rhodes Island. Now, it's Terra's turn.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/绚烂夏花。燧石自认成为“天灾信使”独自踏上旅途时的装束。此前她的拳只认识到阿卡胡拉和罗德岛，现在，该轮到泰拉了。

description.en: A revenant's self-identity is ever-changing. The way they see themselves is often different from what we perceive.
description.zh: 时间不断重塑着死魂灵的自我认知，他们所想象的自我形态，往往与我们所看到的并不相同。

dialog.en: Test Collection Series/Phase Face. Clothes that show off both Tin Man's classical and surrealist sides. The final design was put together using Furnace illusions. A sense of strangeness blurs the line between illusion and reality.
dialog.zh: 忒斯特收藏系列/相位面容。展现锡人古典与超现实一面的服饰，经由熔炉幻景完成了最终设计，强烈的怪诞感让人分不清幻觉与现实。

description.en: Shadows of flitting feathers wi' golden osmanthus pluck'd, attend the gentleman who, with scissors sharp, shapes fair autumns' husks.
description.zh: 飞羽轻衔金樨影，与君共剪几度秋。

dialog.en: 0011 Yun Series New Arrivals/Autumn Shadow. Clothes Figurino made himself from Yanese materials after talking to local craftsmen. The craftsmen sent him some shadow puppets, and ever since, the silhouette of the one he cares for appears in the window.
dialog.zh: 0011子品牌，韵系列新款/桂影窗。裁度与当地匠人交流之后，使用炎国材料为自己裁剪的服装。匠人们送上了皮偶，窗棂间从此浮上了牵挂之人的剪影。

description.en: 'Gavial, I'll keep Rhodes Island safe in your stead.'
description.zh: “嘉维尔，我会替你守护好罗德岛的。”

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Forgemaster. Rhodes Island Engineering Chief Eunectes's outfit while refitting an experimental-model Raging Ironhide. Every point worked on all by herself, everyone saying she's much more reliable than Closure. Closure fiercely rolling her eyes.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/熔锻铸匠。罗德岛工程部长森蚺在改装试验型暴躁铁皮时的装束。每个项目都亲力亲为，大家都说她比可露希尔可靠多了。可露希尔猛翻白眼。

description.en: HP, restored! Consumables, plenty! Alright, enough dawdling, let's get that treasure!
description.zh: 生命值——健康，消耗品——足够，不必犹豫，朝着宝藏的位置出发吧！

dialog.en: Achievement Star Collection/The Starting Point. Clothes Rose Salt wears while playing an adventure game. Carefree, she sits in front of the game console, slipping on her headphones. She's ready to loot hoards of treasure in the realm of fantasy.
dialog.zh: 成就之星系列/冒险启程。瑰盐游玩冒险游戏时的装束。悠闲地坐在游戏机前戴上耳机，瑰盐做好了在幻想世界中豪取无数财富的准备。

description.en: At this moment, crossing a bridge formed by countless Fowlsbeasts, she will encounter the most breathtaking sky scenery.
description.zh: 此刻，跨过无数羽兽连成的桥梁，她将与最令人惊叹的天空景色相遇。

dialog.en: 0011 Sub-brand - Yun Series / Crossing Clear Skies. An outfit specially designed for Cloudrail by Yan artisans. The loose-fitting dress paired with a silk fan and ribbons allows her to feel at ease in whatever sky she flies.
dialog.zh: 0011子品牌，韵系列新款/渡澄空。炎国匠人为云迹特别设计的服饰，宽松款裙装搭配纨扇和飘带，让她无论在哪一片天空中都能怡然自在。

description.en: Welcome our cheerleader! With Molybdenum Lead around, the mood will never go cold!
description.zh: 欢迎我们的啦啦队长！有钼铅在，就永远不会冷场！

dialog.en: MARTHE Sportswear Series / Vibrant Beat. A cheerleader uniform made of special elastic fiber that guarantees lightness and flexibility while balancing breathability and comfort. Molybdenum Lead waving her pom-poms is destined to be the center of attention.
dialog.zh: MARTHE运动系列新款/跃动节拍。特殊弹力纤维制成的啦啦队服，在保障轻便灵活的同时兼顾了透气舒适性。挥舞花球的钼铅将注定是全场的焦点。

description.en: 'Move over a little, a little bit more... Okay, I'm taking the photo now! Thank you for going out of your way to come to my graduation ceremony. Can I keep this photo? I'd like to use it as a bookmark.'
description.zh: “你靠过来一点，再过来一点……要拍了哦！谢谢你特意来参加我的结课典礼，我可以留下这张照片吗？我想把它当作我的书签。”

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Spring in Her Lens. Clothes Xingzhu wore to her nutritional science course graduation ceremony. With a billowing deep blue robe paired with a lilac Yanese satin jacket, she is ready for the lens to capture her smile.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/留影。行箸参加营养学培训结课典礼时的装束。宽大的深蓝色斗篷搭配青紫色缎面小褂，她已做好准备，等待镜头记录下自己的笑容。

description.en: The hour has reached a quiet dusk. Here, he brings the rest they deserve to souls destined to depart.
description.zh: 时刻已至静谧的薄暮，他在此为终将离去的灵魂们，带来应得的安息。

dialog.en: Iteration Provident/The Spirit Farer. Nowell's iteration from decision point F/3019226. Among graves in the glimmer, the spirit farer stands upon a wooden bridge at dusk, guiding all souls into a new cycle.
dialog.zh: 命途迭代系列/幽蓝渡灵师。诺威尔在决策F/3019226中的迭代。微光中的坟茔间，渡灵师立在黄昏时的木桥上，万灵都将受他指引踏入新的轮回。

description.en: All of her bedtime stories are similar to the ones she's heard before. After you listen to them, your dreams tonight might end up showing you the same sights she's seen during her travels.
description.zh: 每一篇睡前故事都与她曾听过的那些相似，或许听完她的讲述后，你今夜的梦里也会现出与她旅途中所见一样的景色。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Bedtime Story. Brigid's 'housewear' she chose for herself. Even if there's rarely a warm room to enjoy oneself in, it can still grant the hasty a moment of calm.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/轻语入梦。水灯心为自己挑选的“家居服”。即使不常有在温暖室内停驻享受的时刻，它也能为匆忙的人带来片刻的宁静。

description.en: Through danger comes transformation; from clarity comes renewal.
description.zh: 冲破险途，迎接蜕变；拨开迷惘，拥抱新生。

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Sharpened Claws. Mon3tr's new uniform after the most important reunion. Once again breaking through the theoretical limits of evolution and reconstruction, redefining the highest levels of sharpness and resilience.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/锋锐。Mon3tr在经历最重要的重逢后换上的新制服。再次突破进化与重构的理论界限，重新定义锐利与强韧的最高水平。

description.en: Fearing not oblivion, she bears it all.
description.zh: 她会去面对一切，接纳一切。

dialog.en: Ave Mujica Collaborative Series/Master of Melodia. Tolling her decision, this stage costume is made manifest in the realm of dreams. She is the Creator of the Haven, Ave Mujica. She awaits in stilled elegance, that she would entice her audience unto this world.
dialog.zh: Ave Mujica合作服装/旋律的主人。少女下定决心后，梦境中显现的演出服。她正是这Ave Mujica世界之主。她会优雅地静候在此，为了每一位前来的客人。

description.en: Fearing not death, she confronts her each and every self.
description.zh: 她会平等地去面对每一个自己。

dialog.en: Ave Mujica Collaborative Series/Marionette's Id. Tolling her decision, this stage costume is made manifest in the realm of dreams. By her own fingers she will puppet the strings, unseal the closed box, and grant freedom to every doll.
dialog.zh: Ave Mujica合作服装/提线的本我。少女下定决心后，梦境中显现的演出服。她会亲自操控长线，打开紧闭的提箱，让每一个玩偶都获得自由。

description.en: Draped in lies, she confronts that for which she sorrows.
description.zh: 她会诚实地去面对她的悲伤。

dialog.en: Ave Mujica Collaborative Series/Caged Singer. Tolling her decision, this stage costume is made manifest in the realm of dreams. She will spurn not the cage but accept her shackles, so she might continue to sing.
dialog.zh: Ave Mujica合作服装/笼中歌者。少女下定决心后，梦境中显现的演出服。她不会拒绝牢笼，她会接受这牢笼，并背负着它歌唱下去。

description.en: Risking her all, she confronts that which she loves.
description.zh: 她会奋力地去面对她的热爱。

dialog.en: Ave Mujica Collaborative Series/Magician of Passion. Tolling her decision, this stage costume is made manifest in the realm of dreams. For as easily as she will scry your hearts, so one can scarcely scry hers.
dialog.zh: Ave Mujica合作服装/情热魔术师。少女下定决心后，梦境中显现的演出服。她总能看穿你们所想，但无人能看穿她的心思。

description.en: Baring her heart, she confronts that which she fears.
description.zh: 她会坦率地去面对她所恐惧的。

dialog.en: Ave Mujica Collaborative Series/Moonlight Executioner. Tolling her decision, this stage costume is made manifest in the realm of dreams. She will carry out her mission wordlessly, so she might protect the place where she truly belongs.
dialog.zh: Ave Mujica合作服装/月下执行者。少女下定决心后，梦境中显现的演出服。她会不发一言地完成每一项任务，为她真正的归宿付出一切。

description.en: Who will remember the names erased, who will watch over the times long buried, who will cradle the sincerest hope, and who has always listened for the people?
description.zh: 谁来记住被抹去的名字，谁来守望已湮灭的光阴，谁来捧起最诚挚的希望，谁又始终在为世人聆听。

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Purification of the Past. All history is destined to fade like smoke. The millennia past have turned to a handful of dust, and Gracebearer leans by forgotten waters, wishing only to wash away all the clamor of bygone days.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/追想涤尘。一切历史都逃不过变为云烟的宿命，过去的千百年月都化作一抔泥土，聆音倚靠在被遗忘的水边，只愿涤净所有过往的喧嚣。

description.en: Today, Tibi isn't a staff member busy behind the scenes. In this set, she is the one and only protagonist.
description.zh: 今天的蒂比不是在幕后忙来忙去的工作人员，在这个布景里，她是唯一的主角。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Series / Fresh Set Design. Outfit worn by Tibi when participating in a mini-play performance. Cool summer attire paired with a straw hat smelling of sunshine, capturing the girl's most natural poise on camera.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/清新布景。蒂比参加迷你剧演出时的着装。清凉的夏装，附带一顶带着阳光味道的草帽，让镜头捕捉下少女最自然的姿态。

description.en: Quietly listen to her prayer: may all living beings be granted the radiance they deserve.
description.zh: 静听她的祈祷：为一切生灵，赐予其应得的光辉。

dialog.en: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Requiem Vesperis. Robes for Vespers specially made for Lemuen. May her pure light be as the twilight stars, granting all a blessing of peace amidst the interplay of light and shadow.
dialog.zh: 音律联觉特供款/暮星安魂曲。为蕾缪安特别设计的晚祷服。愿她身上的纯洁光芒，一如那暮色之中的星辰，在光影交织中为世人送去安宁的祝福。

description.en: You are the light of the innocent; you are the night of the guilty. Though you walk upon the earth, you bear the majesty of the heavens.
description.zh: 你即是无辜者的光，你即是有罪者的夜，你虽行于大地，却是天穹之威。

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Series - The Dawn Sky. Crisis and hardship never cease in just a single moment; true guardians protect the eternal alternation of day and night without a moment's rest. Faith Blender was born for this exact purpose.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/天穹肇始。危难与困境从来都不会只停留在某个瞬间，真正的卫士守护着永恒交替的昼夜，一刻不休。信仰搅拌机，正为此而生。

description.en: Electrical signals flow around her endlessly. These fundamental laws of the game world, she perceives, and she manipulates.
description.zh: 电信号在身边不断地流淌，她感知着，她操控着，这种构架起游戏时空的基本法则。

dialog.en: Achievement Star Collection/Lorem Ipsum. Raidian's character in the alpha test of 'Dark Age of Terra'. The witch floats leisurely past the valley, her giant unrendered companion the incarnation of her awesome might.
dialog.zh: 成就之星系列/乱数法则。电弧参与游戏《苍影历年纪》初版测试时的角色形象。魔女悠然地飘过山谷，身边那只未经渲染的巨型伙伴，是她超凡力量的体现。

description.en: When the shawl draped over his shoulders, Yun Qingping, invited to perform, finally realized the weight this garment bore. He raised his lantern and took the pose of actors he saw in his childhood, drawing thunderous applause from the audience.
description.zh: 当披肩搭在肩上时，受邀出演的云青萍才意识到这身衣服承载的重量。他举起提灯，摆出儿时所见演员的动作，台下便是满堂彩。

dialog.en: 0011 Sub-brand - Yun Series / Illuminating the Realm. A stage costume made by tailors in Baizao for classic Yan opera. Intricate yet elegant tailoring paired with a softly glowing lantern highlights the solemnity of the festival.
dialog.zh: 0011子品牌，韵系列新款/照寰瀛。百灶的裁衣师傅为炎国经典戏曲所制的戏服。繁复而典雅的剪裁，配合一盏盈盈的提灯，更显节日之厚重。

description.en: The night sky on a joyous day is low-key, hidden, and warm like soft underfur. Miss.Christine makes a quiet entrance, capturing every gaze. Only elegant guests are invited tonight; please be sure not to use flash photography.
description.zh: 欢乐之日的夜空如同底绒一般低调、隐蔽和温暖。Miss.Christine悄然出场，俘获一众目光。今夜被邀请的均是优雅之士，请务必注意，不要使用闪光灯。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Series / Underfur Ball. Attire worn by Miss.Christine when attending evening balls. Hazy light gauze paired with golden star-like pendants fully displays her elegant and languid temperament.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/底绒舞会。Miss.Christine出席晚间舞会时的装扮。朦胧轻纱搭配金色星芒挂饰，将其优雅慵懒的气质展露无遗。

description.en: He smiles facing the gun muzzle, but whether composure or helplessness lies behind the corner of his mouth, not even he himself can tell.
description.zh: 他面对着铳口露出微笑，但那嘴角之后藏着的究竟是从容还是无奈，就连他自己都无从知晓。

dialog.en: Test Collection / Dusk's Gemlight. Attire worn by Mori Toru after acquiring endless wealth, only to step into solitude in the end. A tailored suit paired with a coat featuring a gold-purple lining; though its luxurious temperament is clear on the outside, it cannot hide his inner fatigue.
dialog.zh: 忒斯特收藏系列/暮时宝光。森内彻获得了无数财富，却最终步入孤独时的着装。修身西装搭配金紫色内衬的外套，虽然华贵气质外显，却藏不住内心的疲惫。

description.en: Flametail likes playing games, because the rules are reasonable and don't change at the last minute.
description.zh: 焰尾喜欢玩游戏，因为它的规则很合理，还不怎么会变动。

dialog.en: Achievement Star Collection/Sport For All. Sporty outfit worn by Flametail when playing VR games. The limited space is made even more cramped by the gaming equipment, but she has a great time nonetheless.
dialog.zh: 成就之星系列/小健将。焰尾游玩虚拟现实体感游戏时穿的运动装。游戏配件多少有些碍手碍脚，室内有限的空间也让她很难活动起来，但她仍旧玩得很开心。

description.en: A single instant here is countless days outside. Let the jeweled box she holds tell you the ending of the dream.
description.zh: 此处的一个刹那，却是外界的万千个日月，让她手中捧着的玉手匣，向你述说幻梦的结局。

dialog.en: Iteration Provident/Stranded in Utopia. Haruka's iteration from decision point F/3019226. Following the Goldfins' guidance, she presses on toward the sound of the temari song, finally beholding the princess waiting for visitors in the deepest reaches of utopia.
dialog.zh: 命途迭代系列/常世之幻。遥在决策F/3019226中的迭代。跟随金鳞的指引，朝手鞠歌响起的方向前进，终于得见理想乡最深处，静待着来者的公主。

description.en: The night is boundless, and the endless clamor recedes from her mind. The stars return to their places, all things fade into silence, and in this completely unfamiliar quiet, she finally falls asleep for the first time, and truly awakens for the first time.
description.zh: 夜色无边，永不停歇的喧嚷自头脑中远去。群星各归其位，万物各湮其声，而她终于在这全然陌生的寂静里，第一次真正沉睡，也第一次真正醒来。

dialog.en: Misaligned Pilgrimage Redefined [Phase Zero] Series Special / All Sounds Silenced. Inside the inner hall of the Indigo Palace, beneath elegant garments lies deep wisdom that conveys the path forward to audience-seekers without a single word.
dialog.zh: 错位巡礼新定义[第零位相/PhaseZero]系列特别款/万籁俱寂。靛蓝之宫的内殿里，雅致的服饰下，是无需言语便可让谒见者知晓前路的深邃之智。

description.en: Gather a wisp of dense, fragrant mist and store it in a basket, letting it accompany you from ice plains to mountains and lakes. When you pause to rest, you will find the mugwort leaves in the basket are still green and the dew has not yet dried.
description.zh: 采撷一缕氤氲香雾，存入篮中，让它陪伴你从雪原走向山川湖泊。等你驻足歇息时，会发现篮中艾叶尚青，水露未干。

dialog.en: 0011 Sub-brand - Yun Series / Gathering Fragrant Mists. Traditional spring outing clothing made from Yan silk. Even those raised in the cold northern lands can feel the warm atmosphere of midsummer mist.
dialog.zh: 0011子品牌，韵系列新款/撷香霭。以炎国产出的绸缎制成的传统踏青服装。在寒冷北地长大的人，也能感受到仲夏云雾的温暖氛围。

description.en: Be careful not to slip, stretch before entering the water, and swim properly. The gentle voice in the air helps newcomers find their way in the pool.
description.zh: 注意不要滑倒、注意下水前热身、注意动作标准。轻飘飘的语气游荡在空中，让初学者也能在水池中浮游。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA210. Brings out a girl’s figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer’s hottest trend.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]夏卉系列泳衣210款。参考少女的身材和体质，采用天然材质制成。追求今夏最领先的设计潮流。

description.en: Masamune's recent interest is researching new Bunny Dango recipes using Terran ingredients. As for the results, just look at Yoshitsune's expression to find out.
description.zh: 政宗最近的兴趣是用泰拉的食材研究全新的兔团子配方，至于成果，看义经的表情就知道了。

dialog.en: MONSTER HUNTER Crossover Apparel - Camp Time Meow! Tailor-made outfit for the Covert Squad who love outdoor activities in mountains and forests, featuring excellent mobility and breathability.
dialog.zh: 《怪物猎人》合作服装/露营时间喵！为喜欢在山野林间活动的隐秘队量身定做的服装，活动性和透气性极佳。

description.en: True glory needs no idolization; the generous and fair sun bestows it upon everyone.
description.zh: 真正的荣光无需仰望，慷慨公正的太阳将它洒向每一个人。

dialog.en: Persona 3 Reload Crossover Apparel - Witness to Glory. Costume worn by Makoto Yuki when performing at the campus drama festival. The executioner who rejected judgment walks out of the hall, where freedom and true glory await him.
dialog.zh: 女神异闻录3 Reload合作服装/见证荣光。结城理在校园戏剧节上演出时穿着的服装。拒绝审判的执行者走出殿堂，等待他的是自由与真正的荣光。

description.en: Some answers are worth pursuing for a lifetime, grown from daily morning watering and devotion.
description.zh: 有的答案足可追寻一生，是一日日清晨的浇灌与惦念让它长成。

dialog.en: Persona 3 Reload Crossover Apparel - Contemplating Truth. Costume worn by Aigis when performing at the campus drama festival. A monk's life is long and peaceful; she observes the growth of plants, seeking the answer to an unknown question.
dialog.zh: 女神异闻录3 Reload合作服装/静思真谛。埃癸斯在校园戏剧节上演出时穿着的服装。修士的生活漫长平静，她观察植物的生长，寻觅一个未知问题为何的答案。

description.en: Morning and evening, twilight and dawn, clouds flow and winds turn. White walls enclose many warm lives—that is what they call a city.
description.zh: 朝暮晨昏，云流风转，白墙将许多温热的生活围拢，那就叫做城市。

dialog.en: Persona 3 Reload Crossover Apparel - Guarding Twilight. Costume worn by Yukari Takeba when performing at the campus drama festival. A guard looks into the distance atop white walls; the peaceful dusk is her reward after a long journey.
dialog.zh: 女神异闻录3 Reload合作服装/戍卫晨昏。岳羽由加莉在校园戏剧节上演出时穿着的服装。戍卫队员在白墙顶端远眺，安宁的暮色是她在漫长旅途后获得的奖赏。

description.en: 'Hi, are you there? Can you hear me, Maggy? This is Aurora! I made it to the summit!'
description.zh: “喂，喂喂，听得到吗麦麦，我是极光，我成功登上山顶了！”

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Polar Catcher. The nations of Terra collectively sent a dozen or so survey groups to scale Sami's perilous peaks. Only Team Aurora funded by Karlan Trade Co. ultimately scaled the summits without hassle, planting their flags and beacons at the peaks.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/极昼捕手。泰拉诸国派遣了十几支科考团攀登萨米险峰，最终只有喀兰贸易集团资助的极光小队顺利登顶，在山峰上插下了旗帜与信标。

description.en: They all dream within a dream, waking up with a smile still lingering on their lips—that is what makes a good sleep.
description.zh: 他们都做着梦中之梦，醒来时嘴角犹噙着微笑，这便是一场好眠。

dialog.en: Persona 3 Reload Crossover Apparel - Soaring Over the Sweet City. Outfit Koromaru often wears in Laterano. All the desserts in the city flew into the sky around Koromaru, eagerly hoping he would take a bite—Wait, it was a dream?!
dialog.zh: 女神异闻录3 Reload合作服装/飞越甜蜜之城。虎狼丸在拉特兰时常穿着的服装。全城的甜品都飞上了天空，围绕着虎狼丸，殷切盼望他能尝上一口——什么，是梦？！

description.en: What dispels the mist like a golden light is not a sword, nor a shield, nor a staff, but the kindness deep in their hearts.
description.zh: 如同金色的光芒一般驱散迷雾的不是剑，不是盾，也不是法杖，而是她们内心深处的善良。

dialog.en: MY LITTLE PONY Crossover Apparel - Kind and Strong Heart. They all have times of weakness and fear, but in the end they will surely stand up and give their all for those who matter to them.
dialog.zh: 小马宝莉合作服装/善良坚强之心。她们都有软弱、害怕的时候，但是她们最终一定会挺身而出，为了重要之人付出自己的全部。

description.en: Everybody knows Blemishine isn't cut out to be the bad guy, but isn't that what makes it fun? Anyway, she and her family there are just out to have fun, they're not in it to win or lose.
description.zh: 任谁都知道瑕光不适合扮演坏人，可这不就是乐趣所在吗？反正她和两位亲属只享受游玩的乐趣，并不在意胜负。

dialog.en: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Horrorlair's Enigma' Custom Line/Moon Catastrborn. The actor plays the role of the heir of bane who descends upon Terra after rending the moon into twins. The hero stands no chance in a head-on fight.
dialog.zh: 巫异盛宴角色扮演剧本“魔城密令” 定制服饰/异月灾裔。扮演者将是分开双月、踏足于大地上的灾裔。勇者绝无可能在正面对决中获胜。
