description.en: Hailing from a fiery country, a heart of boiling blood mixed with the frigid cold. When wind and snow meet, all must seek safe haven.
description.zh: 来自一个炽热国度，心中混杂着热血与冰寒。风雪与之相遇，都要退避三舍。

dialog.en: Carnelian's winter outfit in Leithanien / Hohenlohe Chillysand. A traditional Leithanian women's trenchcoat with a pair of animal skin shawls and fleece gloves. Fear not the cold.
dialog.zh: 卡涅利安在莱塔尼亚过冬时的装扮/霍恩洛厄的寒沙。莱塔尼亚传统女式风衣，配以兽皮披肩与加绒手套一对，无惧任何低温环境。

description.en: Sandstorms should be no blanket presence this season, so she's curbing her temper for the time being and making friends with the tame pools of water. It's a fair thing, all told.
description.zh: 这个季节的风沙不应该遮天蔽日，所以暂时收敛心性，和驯顺的池水做朋友，倒也算是合情合理。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Shining Dew Series SD08. Tight-fitting, lightweight, breathable, and designed for the summer.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]灿阳朝露系列泳衣08款。贴身、透气、轻便，专为夏日而生。

description.en: He wanted to see with his own eyes the side of Siracusa that was not so Siracusan. When he noticed the gazes of those assessing him from the corners of the restaurant, he realized that such a Siracusa does not yet exist.
description.zh: 他想亲眼看看叙拉古不那么“叙拉古”的一面。当注意到餐厅角落里那些估量揣度他的目光时，他意识到叙拉古还不存在这样的一面。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/The Other Side of Siracusa. Does he not occasionally wear a plain jacket and hoodie instead of a tailored suit, and sit-down at a not-quite traditional Siracusan restaurant?
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/叙拉古的彼面。他偶尔也会从满衣柜精裁细剪的定制正装中抽出朴素的夹克与帽衫，去一家不那么遵从叙拉古饮食传统的餐厅坐坐吗？

description.en: She wants to catch the song of her homeland on the wind, but it always slips through her fingertips.
description.zh: 她想伸手捉住风中来自故乡的歌声，但风从不在她的指间停留。

dialog.en: 0011 Tempest Series/Hear the Wind Sing. New concept based on the theme of Wind, a collaborative work between multiple designers. The ever-present floating ribbons capture the shape of the wind.
dialog.zh: 0011子品牌，飙系列新款/捉风。以“风”为主题，多位设计师联手设计的概念服饰。飘荡的丝带无处不在，那是风的形体。

description.en: But of that moonless night, only these clothes and the lady of a lance born remained presentable. Everything else had taken on terrible, pitch-black forms.
description.zh: 但在那个没有月光的夜晚，只剩这套服装和这个本为枪所生的姑娘是得体的，其他东西皆已化为漆黑的噩形噩象。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Lances of Kaliskas. Ashlock's formalwear, worn when her family banished her. Traditional dress worthy of a Kazimierz knight, not entirely inappropriate on her.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE子品牌 [昔时/Passe]系列精选款/卡利斯卡群枪。灰毫被家族驱逐时所着的正装。一套无愧于卡西米尔骑士身份的传统正装，毫无不得体。

description.en: In screaming winds, all tremble mute. A dead branch tip, a drop of red.
description.zh: 寒风呼啸万物寂，枯树枝头一点红。

dialog.en: 0011 New Arrivals/Tremble Cold. Handcrafted by Lungmen artisans, the typical clothing assembly process was refined in accordance with Ægir bodily characteristics, and the outfit displays a uniquely streamlined effect in turn. Color choices are made independently by the client.
dialog.zh: 0011新款/孤寒峭。龙门手工匠制，根据阿戈尔人的体型特征对普通制衣工艺进行了改良，使成衣展现出独特的流线效果。选色搭配由客人独立完成。

description.en: Everyone unanimously agreed that Whisperain's character card was scarily well put together, and she herself looks shockingly fitting... Is this really her first time playing this game?
description.zh: 大家一致表示絮雨小姐的角色卡完成度高得吓人，造型也惊人地合适……她真的是第一次玩这个游戏吗？

dialog.en: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Dominions & Dogma' Custom Line/Priory of Abyss. This player shall be the sister in black, who has saved countless adventurers' lives. The people never ask who forgets the traumas of their mundane lives for them.
dialog.zh: 巫异盛宴角色扮演剧本“异域信条”定制服饰/幽邃隐修。扮演者将是隐修会的黑袍姐妹，挽救无数冒险者的性命。人们从不过问是谁在替他们遗忘凡命循环的创伤。

description.en: Like many other children, the first time Mizuki found a game he liked, his childhood was only just beginning. It was a naive wish, but he too once hoped these simple joys would never end.
description.zh: 和许多孩子一样，当水月第一次接触到自己喜欢的游戏时，他的童年就开始了。他也曾单纯地希冀这种简单的快乐永远不会有终结的时候。

dialog.en: Achievement Star Collection/A Player Forever. Outfit Mizuki wears when he plays games in Higashi. A perfect fusion of stylish street fashion and retro game elements, letting Mizuki show off his gamer style at max settings.
dialog.zh: 成就之星系列/永恒玩家。水月在东国玩游戏时的装扮。时尚的街头风格与复古游戏元素完美契合，将水月的玩家属性展现得淋漓尽致。

description.en: Summer, a party, an uneventful life, a drink in one hand, and a game in the other. What else can be called happiness?
description.zh: 夏日、晚宴、平凡的生活。一手饮料，一手游戏，人类对于快乐的追求或许就在于此。

dialog.en: Test Collection Series/Summer Feast. Mizuki wears this when feasting on the beach. The material is stain-resistant and provides plenty of room for extra appendages.
dialog.zh: 忒斯特收藏系列/夏日餮宴。水月在海边大快朵颐时的装束。轻透的材质让衣服不易被污渍沾染，也能为附肢留足自由活动的空间。

description.en: Pinecone is about to leave that small town once more. Knowing his daughter no longer has to worry about the future, the laborer suddenly stuffs a doll into her hands. She stares at it in a daze, but luckily the little guy waves a hand in her stead.
description.zh: 松果即将再次离开那个小镇。知道女儿已经不必为将来发愁的工人突然塞过来一个玩偶，她怔愣着接过，幸好这小家伙代替她挥了挥手。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Season of Travel. Pinecone's outfit while visiting family in Columbia. The jacket's jade trim outlines the simple dress with a vibrant aura. An unintentional pairing, yet perfect for spring.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/远行的季节。松果回哥伦比亚探亲时的着装。翠色的边饰将本来很简单的服装勾勒出生机，她没有特意搭配，却很符合春日的氛围。

description.en: A light-hearted nursery rhyme with simple lyrics that you never get tired of, no matter how many times you sing.
description.zh: 一首韵律轻快的童谣，歌词很简单，唱多少遍都不会腻。

dialog.en: Monster Siren Records Idol Project 'Shining Steps' Promotional Costume/Sing a Song. After passing her audition, Pinecone took to the stage with no especially strong desire to be an idol. She just wants to sing.
dialog.zh: 塞壬唱片偶像企划《闪耀阶梯》特供服饰/倾声歌唱。通过海选后，松果登上了舞台，她没有特别强烈的偶像意愿，只是想唱一首歌。

description.en: Here, far from the vagaries of human emotion, Windscoot forgets all those worldly struggles between good and evil and cracks open a cold can of soda. On this summer's day, he learns what is meant by content relaxation.
description.zh: 远离了道上的人情冷暖，抛开了世间的正邪纠缠，打开一瓶冰凉的汽水，此刻夏日中的骋风明白了什么叫悠然自得。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Cloud in Foreign Lands. Clothes Windscoot wears while enjoying a solo trip in faraway lands during a break from work. A comfy short-sleeved shirt paired with lightweight sneakers allows him to enjoy this moment of relaxing freedom.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/异乡的云。骋风暂时放下工作，独自在异乡旅行时的穿着。宽松的休闲短衣搭配轻便运动鞋，令他能享受这自在逍遥的一刻。

description.en: Spread out the picnic blanket, set down the honey and lemonade, and next, let the bubbles she blows keep dancing in the gentle breeze.
description.zh: 铺好野餐垫，摆上蜂蜜和柠檬水，接下来就让她吹出的泡泡，在和煦的微风中继续起舞吧。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Picnic Times. Clothes Aroma wore for a picnic. Light, elegant flower-shaped white trim paired with a denim apron makes the girl under the sunlight especially charming.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/舒心野趣。阿罗玛外出野餐时的穿着。用轻灵雅致的白色花边，搭配牛仔小围裙，让温暖阳光下的少女显得格外动人。

description.en: Within fledgling dreams leer cruelty unfit for such an age, but Honeyberry's mother is so glad to see the courage still there, still alive in her girl.
description.zh: 幼小的梦中蕴含着与年龄不符的残酷。但蜜莓母亲很高兴能看到女儿心中那仍未被磨灭的勇气。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Wildness Behind. The clothes Honeyberry envisioned during her studies as she described her own prospects to her sickly mother, their intricacies drawn from her mother's wardrobe.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE子品牌 [昔时/Passe]系列精选款/荒野之后。蜜莓求学期间为病重母亲描绘自身远景时想象的装束，衣物细节源自母亲衣橱里的衣物。

description.en: The gentle showers soak the city's green leaves bold. The rainbow half up the mount shines on village old.
description.zh: 连城灵雨洇新翠，半山飞虹照故村。

dialog.en: 0011 Custom Brand [Magnificence Curation] Series Collection/Saturated Within Rain. Handmade by a Lungmen craftsman, matching a scene of beauty and wonder recorded in an ancient tome. Remember to bring a paper umbrella, for within, the drops of ink now fall as gentle rains.
dialog.zh: 0011定制品牌[群瑰博辑]系列珍藏/洇灵雨。龙门手工匠制，以衬古籍所载的好时美景。记得捎上一把纸伞，书中点墨已化作灵雨洇开。

description.en: O lost traveler, no longer must you waver before the unseen roads ahead. Follow in her footsteps, and look towards her light.
description.zh: 茫然的旅人啊，从此不必再因看不清前路而彷徨，跟上她的脚步，注目她的光。

dialog.en: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/As Clear As Crystal. Necrass's dress for the musical. The inner lining bedecked with stars is the abyss of the past, the radiant outer surface the resolute present. Through crystal and steel, her will carries on.
dialog.zh: 音律联觉特供款/晶化信念。死芒在音乐剧中的着装。夜空图案的内衬是幽邃的过去，光芒流溢的外衣是坚定的如今。她的意志，通过水晶与剑刃继续传递。

description.en: The starlit sky reflects on the waves, while ashen bones scare away souls.
description.zh: 繁星映波，烬骨慑魂。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA161. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]夏卉系列泳衣161款。参考少女的身材和体质，采用天然材质制成。追求今夏最领先的设计潮流。

description.en: The movies tell us that there are three types of people in the world: the good, the bad, and the ugly. But as Robin knows, you don't judge a book by its cover.
description.zh: 影片里说这大地上有好人、坏人与小人。罗宾却知道，不要轻易给一个人下定论。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Gift of Wild. The choice of the Columbian pioneer, with a core emphasis on strong and durable design. The added details give this outfit that extra personal touch.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/原野的馈赠。哥伦比亚开拓区风格，以坚实耐用为主要设计思路，在细节处加强了这件衣服的个人色彩。

description.en: 'Whoever drew the privilege of getting to play with Peacake for a day... Remember to bring them back tomorrow!'
description.zh: “谁抽到了豆豆的一日陪玩特权……明天记得把它送回来！”

dialog.en: Beanstalk's personally coordinated casualwear / Gift Uncompleted. An off-white knitted sweater paired with light-green silk pajamas for a low-key aesthetic. When in the company of friends, comfort is the highest priority.
dialog.zh: 豆苗自己搭配的居家私服/未完成的礼物。米白针织衫搭配浅绿丝绸睡衣，淡化了风格。和朋友们聚在一起，舒适度就是最优先级。

description.en: There are plenty of ribbons for Peacake to play with, but the one actually bound by an eternal vow, she grasps tightly in her hand.
description.zh: 供豆豆玩耍的丝带还有很多，而真正缠绕着永恒约定的那一条，她会紧紧握在自己手中。

dialog.en: Unveiling of Devotion Series New Arrivals/Ribbons of Promise. Dress Beanstalk wore to the holiday party. A trailing dress of pure white is punctuated by a beautiful red, the fluttering ribbons highlighting the girl's vibrant charm.
dialog.zh: 待予花冠系列新款/红丝带之约。豆苗参加节日宴会时的礼服。纯白的拖尾连衣裙上点缀着瑰丽的红色，飘飘丝带让少女更加灵动可爱。

description.en: He presses down his bamboo hat, the scenery of his hometown becoming a silhouette behind him.
description.zh: 他压下斗笠，故乡的山水成了他身后的一纸剪影。

dialog.en: 0011 New Release / Pale Rising Moon. Inspired by the outfits Mr. Nothing uses to conceal others, with an improved design. Just as the moon waxes and wanes, some people occasionally decide to break character and act debonair.
dialog.zh: 0011新款/冷山月。灵感取自乌有用于掩人耳目的装束，改进了设计。月有阴晴圆缺，人也有不着调的时候和装帅的时候。

description.en: The best way to get to know a group of people is to blend in.
description.zh: 了解特定人群最好的方式便是融入其中。

dialog.en: Rainbow Six Collab Series/Ranger. This outfit, hand-picked by Ash herself, emphasizes both disguisability and sportiness. A specially-made hat conceals Ash's identity, facilitating intelligence-gathering and related work.
dialog.zh: 彩虹六号合作服装/游侠。灰烬亲手挑选的服装，伪装与运动性并重，特殊造型的帽子可以掩饰灰烬真正的种族，以便其进行情报收集和相关工作。

description.en: To rule is to merely protect.
description.zh: 统治是一种守护。

dialog.en: Rainbow Six Collab Series/Lord. A set of tactical armor that consists of the helmet Tachanka picked from the Lord of Long Spring's collection and a modified set of standard issue battle armor. It has exceptional defensive capabilities, which is further topped off with an imposing appearance that can be seen from afar.
dialog.zh: 彩虹六号合作服装/领主。战车在长泉镇领主收藏中挑选出的头盔，配上补给时加装的战甲组合成了这套防御性能绝佳的战术装备。远远望去，气势十足。

description.en: This is the first time Shana Moleman has left Rim Billiton. She takes off her hard hat for a moment. A survey drone flies high in the sky. This time, it illuminates more than just the darkness of the mineshaft.
description.zh: 这是夏娜·穆伊曼第一次离开雷姆必拓。她暂时摘下了矿帽。探测无人机向高处飞，这次照亮的不仅是矿井下的黑暗。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/New Business. Cement's survey consultant outfit. Snug and durable, the contrast of the hoodie and jacket brings out her vitality. She also gets herself a pair of goggles to match with them.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/全新业务。洋灰担任远行考察顾问时的着装。舒适耐穿，卫衣与外套的色彩对比彰显活力，她还专门配了副护目镜。

description.en: The specialties Qanipalaat hands out are often eccentric. Other operators may not be able to appreciate the terrifying dried totems or the pungent fermented food, but they recognize a gesture of friendship from an ancient civilization.
description.zh: 雪绒分发的特产颇具特色，罗德岛的干员们还不能很好地欣赏那些可怖的风干图腾，或是享受那些恶臭的发酵食物，但他们明白这是古老文明表示友好的方式。

dialog.en: Formal wear that Qanipalaat received while on holiday/Gratitude Gift. Always one to gift Sami specialties, he's now received a gift in return. He smiled to learn that Victorian garb went well with his tail.
dialog.zh: 雪绒在节日时收到的礼服/回礼。总在热情地分发萨米特产的雪绒收到了回礼。听说自己的尾巴与这件维多利亚风格的礼服相得益彰时，雪绒开心地笑了。

description.en: A serene day, the moon in her teacup, surrounded by indulgent flowers... It is rather difficult for Indigo to understand this scenery.
description.zh: 待晴日，烹泉煮月，肆意花间……理解这样的意境，对深靛来说有些困难。

dialog.en: 0011 New Release / Serene Day. Handmade in Lungmen. The fabric is light and comfortable, using the client's favorite purple color as a base and embellished with dark lines. Casual yet dignified, it is perfect for all sorts of occasions.
dialog.zh: 0011新款/待晴日。龙门手工匠制，面料轻薄舒适，配色选用顾客喜爱的紫色为底色，缀以暗纹，随性却不失端庄，适用于各种场合。

description.en: Perhaps due to Old Isin's influence, on occasion both Elliot and Passenger find themselves deep in a dream—one of what is to come, the other of what has been...
description.zh: 或许是受了老伊辛的影响，艾利奥特与异客偶尔也会沉入梦境，一个人梦见了未来，而另一个人梦见了过去……

dialog.en: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Dream In A Moment. Two sets of clothing held in Passenger's memories and casually put to paper, then realized as outfits by a snooping Operator.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE子品牌 [昔时/Passe]系列精选款/今昔须臾之梦。两套存于异客记忆中的装束，他信手画在稿纸上，被一位好事干员拿去做了成衣。

description.en: From seeding to harvest, Mulberry pays careful attention to every detail of her herbs.
description.zh: 药品最忌成分不明，因此，从嫩芽到成药，桑葚都盯得很仔细。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Series New Release/Plant Crude Drug. Practical outfit worn by Mulberry for both relief and horticultural work, with enough pockets for all her tools. Green trimmings adorn the simple fabric, representing verdant life.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/植药。桑葚进行灾害救助及药材培育时的简装，多口袋设计方便器具收纳。用色简单，浅绿镶边体现设计感，象征着盎然生机。

description.en: A drop of water on the lotus path, the full moon shining alongside the lantern.
description.zh: 莲步粼粼一点水，圆月与灯两相明。

dialog.en: 0011 New Arrivals/Reflection That of the Moons. Made by Lungmen tailors, inspired by the waterscapes of Jiangqi, the delicate cuts and soft gauze represent the reflection of the lotus in water when the moon is out.
dialog.zh: 0011新款/照冰轮。龙门手工匠制，设计灵感来源于姜齐城内的水景，通过特殊剪裁和轻软纱料，还原出了月圆时分莲花挺立水中的清新模样。

description.en: 'My fellow Ægir, no longer does the sea lies behind us. We have no other choice.'
description.zh: “阿戈尔的诸位同胞，身后再无大海，我们别无选择。”

dialog.en: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Return. Ægir Consul Gladiia's attire as she led her unit to return to the sea. Following sufficient exchange with the nations of dry land, the Ægir found themselves fully prepared to return to the home they'd left.
dialog.zh: 斗争血脉系列/返航。阿戈尔执政官歌蕾蒂娅率领部队返回海洋时的装束。在与大陆诸国充分交流后，阿戈尔们做好了重返家园的准备。

description.en: She may prefer the classics, but even she is not immune to change. At her team's recommendation, she changes her wardrobe and hair once more. There is no trace of coldness in her step, and her every movement is graceful, as she always has been.
description.zh: 她虽古典，却也并非一成不变。在队员的建议下，她重新打理了服装与秀发。鲜明的冷酷无处可寻，举手投足间的优雅倒始终如一。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/I Am the Tides. An outfit Gladiia often wears. With the tides, she comes and goes freely between land and sea. The hunter is at ease, for the hunter is the tide.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/我即潮汐。歌蕾蒂娅常着私服，凭借潮汐，自由往来于大地与海洋。猎人轻松惬意，猎人即是潮汐。

description.en: Swordplay lives not in books, but reading makes a general nimble of mind. Cling not to the cherry blossoms, nor to the sharpest edge.
description.zh: 剑招不在书中，但阅读能让武将洗练精神。不趋繁樱，锋芒其内。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Temperament. Adroit tailoring and a rich modern sense for color, contrasted with accessories detailed with classical appeal. Spectacles are custom-made as a gift by the brand, for the client.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/心性。利落的剪裁和用色极具现代感，装饰单品则在细节处保留了古典韵味，眼镜是品牌为顾客定制的赠礼。

description.en: The touch of the spring breeze brushes the blossoms on the branches. The touch of wine brushes the furrowed brow.
description.zh: 春意随风，拂开了挂在枝头的花苞；酒意阑珊，散去了藏在眉梢的无措。

dialog.en: 0011 New Arrivals/Fragrance From the Branches. Clean-cut, form-fitting skirt, given an extra touch with matching accessories. The soft felt jacket keeps the wearer warm in the chill of early spring.
dialog.zh: 0011新款/枝头馥。剪裁利落的短裙完美贴合身形，搭配独具个性的饰品更显层次感，柔软的毛绒外套兼具保暖性，抵挡了来自早春的寒意。

description.en: Light and Cart are engrossed in scoffing lotus seeds, and Helmet and Drill are piled atop each other for a nap. Blacknight's mind is far away, most likely reminiscing on summer in the barrens.
description.zh: 阿灯和车车埋头吃着莲子，小帽和钻头互靠着午睡。夜半发着呆，大概在回想荒野上的夏天。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA641. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]夏卉系列泳衣641款。参考少女的身材和体质，采用天然材质制成。追求今夏最领先的设计潮流。

description.en: "That tricolor ice cream shop I just went to was so good! I'll send the picture to Utage, gotta go back with her next time!"
description.zh: “刚才去的那家三色冰淇淋店真不错，把照片发给宴，有机会和她一起再去一次吧！”

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection/Casual Snapshot. Kirara's outfit while hanging out on the streets of Mishiro. With a comfortable knit vest, an eye-catching miniskirt, and cute colorful hair accessories, this snapshot is sure to be a huge hit.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/轻闲快照。绮良前往御机城街头游玩时的着装。舒适的针织背心，吸睛的迷你裙，还有可爱的多彩发饰，这张快照一定大受好评。

description.en: Bringing this stuff to Rhodes Island cost Kirara a pretty penny, but the number of times she's requested leave since then proves it was worth it.
description.zh: 把这个大家伙运到罗德岛花了绮良不少钱，但从她之后的请假频率来看，这套设备确实物有所值。

dialog.en: Achievement Star Collection/Trendsetting Player. A gift from the devs, thrown in when Kirara bought a complete set of gaming equipment. Customized just for her, a loose and comfortable outfit for around the home.
dialog.zh: 成就之星系列/前沿玩家。绮良购买了一体式游戏设备后厂商附赠的衣物，限量定制款，配色与款式都由绮良亲自确认，轻薄宽松，适合居家穿着。

description.en: War has taken its last breath. Blood and steel have been overgrown by vegetation, and bright flowers bloom in place of hate.
description.zh: 战争咽下最后一口气，锈铁血泪被植被覆没，仇恨化作肥料，鲜花正在盛开。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Series New Release/Appreciate Fragrance. Finely-crafted Victorian dress, handmade from the finest materials. An elegant and dignified outfit bound to garner attention anywhere.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/识芳。维多利亚贵族礼服，手工定制，强调修身和线条感。用料考究，设计精致，端庄优雅，引人注目。

description.en: She hopes for a day where everyone can have the right to freely enjoy the beach and sun.
description.zh: 她希望有那么一天，所有人都有自由享受沙滩与阳光的权利。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA317. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]夏卉系列泳衣317款。参考少女的身材和体质，采用天然材质制成。追求今夏最领先的设计潮流。

description.en: The pale models are lifeless, but the brushes and paints in her hand can give them a soul.
description.zh: 苍白的模型本没有生命，手中的画笔和颜料却能为它们带来灵魂。

dialog.en: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Granter of Colors. Roberta's work outfit. With the other operators' help and encouragement, Roberta finally found the time to design a look for herself as well.
dialog.zh: 音律联觉特供款/待绘的作品。罗比菈塔的工作服。在干员们的怂恿和帮助下，罗比菈塔终于空出时间，给自己也做了一套造型。

description.en: The waves brush away both her makeup and her troubles. If beauty requires decoration, then the ocean itself is embellishment enough for her.
description.zh: 浪花冲走化妆刷上的色彩，以及所有的坏心情。如果美丽需要修饰，那么此刻整片大海都是她的点缀。

dialog.en: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA374. Brings out a girl’s figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer’s hottest trend.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]夏卉系列泳衣374款。参考少女的身材和体质，采用天然材质制成。追求今夏最领先的设计潮流。

description.en: 'What we've inherited is much more than just these outfits, but the ideology, the principles, and the future as well.'
description.zh: “我们所继承的不仅是衣钵，还有思维、准则与未来。”

dialog.en: EPOQUE Line [Passe] Series Selects/Heritage. Traditional Minoan ritual attire, coordinated with modern themes, is once again in vogue among Minoans.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE子品牌 [昔时/Passe]系列精选款/传承。米诺斯祭祀传统服饰，在经过现代化搭配后重新成为了米诺斯人的着衣风尚。

skinName.en: A Drip of Orea and Potamous

description.en: The drunken traveler walks her homeland's mountains and rivers. A new epic is poured into the temple that the twelve heroes retook.
description.zh: 酣醉的远游者行遍故乡的山川，新作的史诗倾倒进十二英雄夺回的神殿。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/A Drip of Orea and Potamous. Designed for the climate of Minos, slim-fitting and easy to move in. The fabric is durable, waterproof, and resistant to the occasional spilled wine. Can be customized with extras to the customer's needs.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/山川的酿造。依据米诺斯地区的气候设计，版型修身，方便行动，面料防水耐磨，不惧酒渍。可依据客户要求增添辅助部件。

description.en: In Tequila's hands, every card is a trump card, and in that respect, he's a resident professional.
description.zh: 只要捏在龙舌兰手中，每一张牌都是王牌，在这一方面，他是专业的。

dialog.en: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Cardwinner. Tequila's formal stage outfit. Qualified hosts heat up the audience; excellent hosts strive to eliminate any errant possibility.
dialog.zh: 音律联觉特供款/开牌制胜。龙舌兰的演出正装。合格的主持人炒热氛围，优秀的主持人则致力于杜绝一切意外。

description.en: Though it was his first audition, Tequila's score shot far past the competition. The other idol wannabes wanted to ask how to be as charming as him, but within minutes found themselves won over by his smile and joining his fan club.
description.zh: 首次参加海选的龙舌兰得分已经断层第一，同组的小偶像只是想问龙舌兰，怎么才能和他一样有魅力，没想到几分钟后也被他的笑容折服，加入了粉丝后援会。

dialog.en: Monster Siren Records Idol Project 'Shining Steps' Promotional Costume/Top Tier Live. Always with a shining smile, a gentlemanly attitude, and impressive skills. Only just on stage, and Tequila's already mesmerized the crowd.
dialog.zh: 塞壬唱片偶像企划《闪耀阶梯》特供服饰/巅峰现场。永远清澈的笑容，永远有礼的姿态，还有不俗的能力，龙舌兰刚上舞台，所有人的目光就被他吸引。

description.en: Fruit cake. A quiet, relaxing mealtime. And a calming hug.
description.zh: 随果香蛋糕附赠：悠闲安静的用餐时间，还有一个令人安心的拥抱。

dialog.en: Rhodes Kitchen Collection/Heartwarming Baking. Sure, it might look a little messy, with a few things not going as planned along the way. But he will serve the cake to you with a smile all the same, just like the life he wishes to lead, one filled with an affectionate warmth.
dialog.zh: 罗德厨房系列/温情烘焙。也许会带着些忙乱，可能会有几次失误。最终他微笑着向你端上的成品，一定与他所期望的生活一样，带着温暖的情意。

description.en: The sun hasn't set quite yet, and the night breeze blows across the city, the refreshing wind taking away her worries and sorrows for the moment.
description.zh: 太阳尚未落下，晚风已拂过城市，这份凉爽暂时带走了她的烦恼和悲伤。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/To Rest in Night Breezes. Siesta welcomes back any and all weary wanderers. Fresh-off-the-truck Ann-Maier puts on her favorite ensemble to hit the beach, taking in the quiet sands as day turns to night.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/晚风休憩。友善的汐斯塔欢迎任何疲惫的归乡人，初来的安麦尔小姐也穿上自己最喜欢的私服来到沙滩边，享受天幕交替时的宁静。

description.en: 'I figured the acidity is suitably... corrosive? Please, as if I'd be boring enough to talk about work on such a nice spring afternoon! I meant this can of soda.'
description.zh: “果然，这样的酸度正合适……腐蚀剂？拜托，在这么舒适的春日午后还想着工作，也未免太无趣了吧？我说的是这罐冰饮料啊。”

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Leisure. The season's latest leisurewear in Columbia. Detachable straps and pouches let Corroserum show off the many delights of his spring travels.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/逸趣。哥伦比亚当季的潮流休闲套装。可拆卸的多孔束带与各式便携小包足以彰显蚀清春日出行的多种趣味。

description.en: In the past, he would sweat as he struggled to survive, but now, at this blazing street corner, only joy and hope flows.
description.zh: 过去为了生存而挥洒的汗水，如今在烈日炎炎的街角只为喜悦和希望流淌。

dialog.en: MARTHE Sports Line/Blazing Street View. Avant-garde clothes made for urban life. Lightweight and sweat-wicking yet durable fabrics help the wearer show off their street style.
dialog.zh: MARTHE运动系列新款/烈阳街景。专为街头活跃群体设计的前卫风格的服装。采用轻便吸汗的面料，兼顾耐用性，帮助顾客展现街头风采。

description.en: Five people enter an alley, one leaves alive. From here on, home is a distant thing, and the rootless trees are set to drift alone.
description.zh: 五个人走进小巷，一个人活着离开。家乡就此疏远，无根的树木将要独自漂流。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Distant Home's Guide. The plainclothes Quercus once wore on an infiltration mission. Principally serving to conceal her identity, so as to better facilitate combat in city environs.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE子品牌 [昔时/Passe]系列精选款/遥乡之径。夏栎过去参加潜入渗透任务时的便装，主要用以掩盖身份，更便于在城市环境下作战。

description.en: There are many who believe themselves dashing and humorous, more than enough to take on the role of a wandering bard, but Quercus's improvised performance is not something just anyone can learn.
description.zh: 有很多人觉得自己潇洒又幽默，扮演一位吟游诗人绰绰有余，但夏栎的即兴演奏可不是谁都能学会的。

dialog.en: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Dominions & Dogma' Custom Line/The Bard's Tale. This player shall be the one singing ballads for the heroes of old, livening up the tavern with her ditties. Come, listen close, who stole the melody that wends through the shadow-flickering breeze?
dialog.zh: 巫异盛宴角色扮演剧本“异域信条”定制服饰/树影吟游。扮演者将是英雄战歌的传颂者，酒馆小调的歌唱家。来吧，仔细听，是谁剽窃了这阵拂影微风中的旋律？

description.en: "Find her... protect her." The labyrinth gardener guards the only exit, the rosebud beneath her armor forever pointing toward the princess.
description.zh: “找到她……保护她。”迷宫的园丁把守着唯一的出口，盔甲下的蔷薇花苞始终指着那位公主所在的方向。

dialog.en: Star of the Chef Collection/Enigma of the Rose. The outfit Briar wore when shooting the poster for the game *Emerald Labyrinth* at a gaming expo. The princess she played completed the sword-dubbing ceremony, and the Rose Knight has possessed an emerald heart ever since.
dialog.zh: 成就之星系列/蔷薇之谜。刺玫为电玩展的参展游戏《翡绿迷宫》拍摄海报时的着装。她所扮演的公主完成了授剑礼，蔷薇骑士自此拥有了一颗翡绿之心。

description.en: Be it the remodeling of her 'Justice Knight' or the future of her Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub, she's overflowing with confidence.
description.zh: 无论是对改造后的“正义骑士号”，还是对未来的红松骑士团，她都充满信心。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Justice Maker. Attire of Wild Mane during repairs of 'Justice Knight.' Cozy and breathable, while wear and stain resistant. Detailing and accessories in contrasting colors coordinated to embody that sense of planning.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/正义缔造者。野鬃在修理“正义骑士号”时的着装，面料透气舒适，耐磨经脏，搭配的异色饰品于细节处体现设计感。

description.en: As Cantabile's slender fingers pluck at the strings, a melodious song begins to play across the lake. Her holiday is not a long one, but at the very least, at this very moment, she wants to forget it all, and allow herself to soak in the tranquility.
description.zh: 随着晓歌修长的手指抚过琴弦，悠扬的乐曲开始在湖畔回荡。她的假期并不长，但至少此时此刻，她想忘记一切，让自己沉浸在这恬静的氛围之中。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Bard by the Lake. Attire Cantabile wore during her lakeside holiday. The white of the dress is in perfect harmony with the natural environment, creating a tranquil, dream-like ambience.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/湖畔歌者。晓歌在湖边度假时的装束。以白色为主色调的礼服与自然环境完美融合，营造出宁静与梦幻的艺术氛围。

description.en: Coolness of spring, touching the flames of life; warm evening breeze, touching the cheek's silver flower.
description.zh: 半点春寒，蘸向人间火树；一晚风暖，吹落腮边银花。

dialog.en: 0011 New Arrivals/Illumination That of Daylights. Made by Lungmen tailors. The gauze lining at the hem softens the lines, as does the matching white shawl.
dialog.zh: 0011新款/灯如昼。龙门手工匠制，短裙底摆衔接了一片薄纱，利落感被中和，搭配的乳白色披肩更增添了许多柔美的感觉。

description.en: Coupons, donuts! A food festival's not complete without some real dessert, right?
description.zh: 美食券，甜甜圈！美食节怎么能少得了真正的甜点？

dialog.en: Rhodes Kitchen Collection/Sweet Jackpot. You can't win the sweets competition by wearing a uniform! Insider put this on before diving head-first into the bakery, and he's about to present his creation. Don't worry, the sweetness has been adjusted to suit your tastes.
dialog.zh: 罗德厨房系列/甜品大奖。甜品比赛的大奖可不是穿着制服赢回来的！隐现换上休闲的服饰投身烘焙房，即将呈上新做的甜点——放心，甜度已为你做了调整。

description.en: Must-haves for a rare summer vacation: a hammock, a magazine, and an extra-sweet soda to beat the heat.
description.zh: 难得的夏日假期里这些东西必不可少：吊床、杂志，还有一杯二十分甜的消暑汽水。

dialog.en: MARTHE Coral Coast Collection/Relaxing Vacation HDm25. Male model. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and light. Allows you to enjoy the ultimate beach experience in a casual environment.
dialog.zh: MARTHE [珊瑚海岸/CoralCoast]悠然假日系列泳衣25男款。舒适放松，透气轻盈。让您可以在闲适的环境中享受最完美的沙滩体验。

description.en: Now that everything has been laid bare and the plan has run through his mind countless times, he knows what he must do next.
description.zh: 当一切都彻底清晰明了，这计划在他脑中演算过千遍万遍，他已经知道自己下一步要做什么。

dialog.en: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Sun Slant. After sorting through his attic, Diamante finally pieced together a web connecting the nobles to the mining accident twenty years ago. As he rubs his aching neck, the sunlight seeps in through the window.
dialog.zh: EPOQUE系列新款/斜照。在鉴定所的阁楼中，折光终于整理完了与二十年前那场矿难相关的贵族的关系网，揉着酸痛的脖子，窗外照射进来的阳光正好。
